description: A colourful song about pretending to be at the beach playing instead of at home with an illness.

title: Bear Special
description: We are back with a new video about bears. We spent eight months creating it in the Western Tatras with intensive observation. We hope you like it. So come with us to the forest - KuUL.

title: Bearkittens
description: Petra is an idealistic social worker and about to enter her favorite place, the forest, with a group of young girls who have to do community service for their misdeeds. Little does she know that this trip will end in disaster.

title: Beartales: The Adventure of Sammy Jay
description: Join Papa Bear and Baby Bear on their magical airship adventure, where they share classic bedtime fairytales. Beartales: Bedtime Stories offers a delightful way for kids to enjoy their favorite tales and drift off to sleep.

title: Beast Wishes
description: "Beast Wishes" is a 2012 documentary about Bob and Kathy Burns, the goodwill ambassadors of science fiction film fandom.

title: Beat Keepers: The Next Chapter
description: A group of female drummers-many of them breast cancer survivors-gather in Dallas, Texas, for a transformative music retreat where they build community, reclaim joy, and challenge gender norms in the world of drumming.

title: Beating Super Bugs
description: BEATING SUPERBUGS: CAN WE WIN?, a feature-length documentary, presents an accessible, in-depth, true-to-fact message with a touch of mystery and suspense throughout: CAN we beat superbugs?

title: Beats
description: A series of attacks terrorizes Munich. Max, having survived the first shots fired at the audience in the electro club Beats, hides in a storage room with his new friend Sefi and other party attendees. The immediate danger puts the humanity of all trapped people to the test and Max has to decide whether he wants to save himself or try to save a stranger, as well. Shortly before arriving at home, Alexa hears of the attack on the club she left her brother Max at. She decides to go back, accompanied

title: Beauty
description: "Beauty," a documentary by Christina Willings, delves into the lives of five gender-creative kids challenging societal norms. Witness their courageous journey of self-discovery and redefining humanity.

title: Beauty Water
description: Beauty Water looks like a common skin cosmetic. But unlike other cosmetics, people can sculpt their skin with it and change their appearance. An ordinary girl, Yaeji, comes across the Beauty Water by chance, and her endless desire to be the most beautiful woman brings her unimaginable disaster.

title: Beavers: Patagonia Invaders
description: Explore the damning legacy of forced species introduction in Patagonia. Uncover the ecological consequences in this insightful profile.

title: Become Her
description: Andréa decides to become a woman at 50. She will finally assume her true dimension: being a woman. Since she became a woman, transmitting has been necessary for her. Instinctively, she takes charge of the teenager who is still inside her. Through this echo between her and him, a balance is built, a harmony in the same body.

title: Bed and Breakfast
description: In the style of Neil Simon and the feel of "The Big Chill," two washed-up B movie producers coerce a young, naïve screenwriter into helping them convince a "money guy" to invest in a picture based on the writer's script. The three hopefuls and their families' caravan up North to an enchanting bed and breakfast where they all anxiously await the arrival of the man with the money - the man who will supposedly make all their dreams come true. This compelling story is laced with fears, tears, laughs

title: Bed of Nails
description: Goth kids cut through rural Florida where they are confronted by four rednecks. After accidentally killing one of the kids, the rednecks kill the remaining two kids but one of the kids returns from the grave to enact a brutal revenge.

title: Bedridden
description: In "Bedridden," a widowed single mother confronts a terrifying encounter and battles for survival. Trapped with her assailant, a deadly game unfolds.

title: Bee Geniuses: The Life of Bees
description: Join the educational adventure of Bee Geniuses Zip and Zap! Fly with them through the forest as they satisfy their thirst for knowledge, guided by the brilliant Queen Buttercup. Fun and learning for all ages!

title: Bee Team 2
description: Join Zip, Zap, Queen Eleanor, and Sabastian in the forest adventure of a lifetime! Witness the Bee Team's remarkable bond as they face challenges together.

title: Before Dawn
description: Troubled couple's getaway to mend relationship turns disastrous as they face an undead onslaught. Can they survive the walking dead?

title: Before Summer Ends
description: Arash, unsatisfied with life in France, plans to return to Iran after his studies. In a last-ditch effort, friends take him on a transformative journey across France.

title: Before the Dawn
description: A young teacher grapples with forbidden desires after an inappropriate encounter with a troubled student. Watch as she navigates the thin line between temptation and ethical choices.

title: Before the Fame
description: "Before the Fame" takes us down memory lane to the beginning of the careers of today's brightest stars, tracking their success to where it all began. Mike Sherman shows us never-before-seen footage of each celebrity's rise to the top.

title: Begone Dull Care
description: Experience an experimental masterpiece of shifting abstract shapes and colors, synchronized to mesmerizing music. Watch as the film strip becomes a canvas in this captivating short.

title: Behind the Bucket: A Garrison Story
description: Behind the Bucket is a documentary following members of the 501st Legion--Star Wars Enthusiasts--showing how they are much more than adults playing dress-up. The 501st are compassionate, charitable, and down to earth people doing what's right for those in need. There's a reason why their motto is "Bad Guys Doing Good"

title: Behind the Door
description: Risako Yamazaki lives with her 3-year-old daughter and husband. She is informed that is selected as an alternate lay judge in a criminal case. The defendant in the case is Mizuho Ando, who is also a housewife and about the same age as Risako. She is on trial for drowning her 8-month-old daughter in a bathtub. Risako feels hatred to Mizuho, but after the trial begins, Mizuho's situation reminds Risako of her own past memories.

title: Behind the Sightings
description: Two filmmakers from North Carolina set out to produce a documentary discovery of multiple clown sightings around the US lead us to an unforgivable homicide.

title: Behind The Wall
description: Behind The Wall: Unveiling life on both sides of Berlin Wall through citizens' eyes. Explore forgotten history pre, during, post-Wall. Celebrate 20th anniversary of 'Fall of the Wall' in this captivating documentary.

title: Being Brave
description: Bullied at school because of his father's sexuality, Beckett takes matters into his own hands.

title: Being Dead
description: The adaptation of Jim Crace’s award-winning novel, Being Dead follows two scientists’ return to a coastline where a species they discovered 25-years ago faces extinction. Hoping to rekindle passion that discovery brought them, they instead arrive at the point of their death.

title: Being Frank: The Chris Sievey Story
description: It's a documentary about the life of eccentric comedian Frank Sidebottom who wore a huge papier-mache' head and whose true identity was a closely guarded secret until after he died. The 2014 Magnolia Pictures film titled Frank was inspired by his sensational mystery.

title: Being Keegan
description: When a tormented naval officer returns home to Liverpool, the city becomes a landscape for atonement as he is forced to confront a traumatic childhood event.

title: Being Sascha
description: Sascha's name wasn't always Sascha. But now it is. Sascha doesn't identify as a man or as a woman, but as trans non-binary. A story about what it means to live in a society that wasn't expecting you. A glimpse into a life that allows us to question our own categories. And a film about what it means to be oneself.

title: Believe the Beat
description: A young dancer from the USA has a chance encounter with Xstyle, a lively crew of hip hop dancers who train in a grimy city park in Rio de Janeiro. The only place to go is towards their dreams; the only way to get there is together.

title: Bella
description: In the midst of Greece's shifting landscape, Anthi witnesses transformations in her country, the world, and her partner Christos during a pivotal era.

title: Beloved
description: Artistic behind the scenes of a nature/sports photographer Katja Pokorn.

title: Ben & Lacy
description: After receiving a camera as a graduation gift, 18 year-old Ben decides to begin vlogging his life. This vlog captures him reconnecting and falling in love with his old classmate, Lacy.

title: Ben Bailey: Road Rage & Accidental Orinthology
description: As host of Bravo's "Cash Cab" , Ben Bailey's following and popularity continues to grow. Now comes Ben Bailey's hilarious debut stand-up comedy special.

title: Beneath Clouds
description: Lena is the daughter of an Aboriginal mother and Irish father and Vaughn is a Murri boy doing time in a minimum security prison in North West NSW. Dramatic events throw them together on a journey with no money and no transport.

title: Beneath The Silence
description: Set in 1973, a family on the brink of the Yom Kipur War faces the disintegration caused by the father's PTSD.

title: Benza English
description: The classroom is a bar. The grammar teacher is a ghost. The lessons are about pickup lines and put downs. Welcome to "Benza English," where you will learn all the English you never knew you needed to know! Chris, Kyle, and the gang from "The Benza" all return to help host Kaori and an all new cast of outlandish characters teach English in this comedic educational spin-off series!

title: Beowulf & Grendel
description: In Denmark, during the 6th century, Danish king Hrothgar and his warriors kill a troll whose son, Grendel, vows revenge.

title: Bereave
description: Fatally ill, Garvey thinks he has figured out how to die alone. But when his beloved wife Evelyn goes missing on their anniversary, he must live to save her.

title: Berlin Calling
description: In an effort to confront her family's dark past a punk-chick from California traces her father's roots back to pre-war Berlin. Her journey takes her to Houston, Paris, Berlin, Prague and Theresientadt. During this voyage she discovers not only how she and her whole family were effected by Hitler's Final Solution but also that her family is larger than anyone imagined. She is finally able to leave a tribute to her family on the streets of Berlin and watch while her father is welcomed back to the

title: Bes
description: Asli, a young, Turkish, lesbian woman, returns to the village where she was born to attend the henna-party of her childhood friend. She fears not being accepted, but when she sees her old friends again, she comes to realize that she herself has the biggest prejudice.

title: Best Christmas Movies Ever!
description: Best Christmas Movies Ever is the ultimate look back at the greatest holiday films of all-time featuring commentary from legendary stars, writers, directors, producers, critics and authors as they talk about their favorite classics and the making of these beloved films from Miracle On 34th Street to Elf to Santa Claus Conquers The Martians to Santa Claus: The Movie to Love Actually and, of course, Die Hard.

title: Best Friend
description: A leader of the opposition party in 1980s South Korea struggles to outwit the government who, unbeknownst to him, has placed a surveillance team in the house next door. Based on the life of Kim Dae-jung, the 8th President of South Korea

title: Best Laid Plans
description: Directed by Kyler Wilson, 'Best Laid Plans' follows Remy a single mother, struggling to pay her bills. She gets the opportunity to make some extra cash when her boss calls her for a last-minute job. Reluctantly, she takes the job but finds herself taken hostage when she arrives. Now she must help the homeowner stay alive in this gripping suspense thriller that will keep you guessing every step of the way.

title: Best of Seven
description: A quiet man who suffer from multiple personality disorder is talked into stop taking his medications by his parents, who are sure he is fully healed. He agrees to stop taking them for a week, and that unleashes all his other personalities to destroy his life.

title: Best Wishes
description: Two young queer Chinese men who have feelings for each other connect over the phone just as one of them is preparing to be married to a woman.

title: Best Wishes from Millwood
description: A discontented housewife encounters a mysterious cyclist who offers wish-granting cookies.

title: Bethune
description: Experience the inspiring journey of Norman Bethune, a Canadian doctor transformed by TB. From the Spanish Civil War to aiding China in WWII, his relentless dedication made him a revered hero in Communist China.

title: Better Dead Than Red: Hollywood vs. Communism
description: An original documentary from Ballyhoo Motion Pictures about Communism in America. This documentary dives into the impact on Hollywood and some of the biggest names of the time. With the nation's emotions running on high, the atmosphere of Hollywood, even the themes of film produced, completely shifted during this time period of history.

title: Between Resistance and Community
description: Delve into a vibrant time capsule showcasing Long Island's pivotal role as a cornerstone and catalyst for DIY punk culture.

title: Between the Miles
description: Florence, a struggling musician, takes in three homeless teens from LA. To provide for them, she must conquer her own reckless ways and embrace responsibility.

title: Between the Shades
description: Between the Shades seeks to put faces to the letters that make up LGBTQI and how those letters have evolved. The film examines the immense power of labels and the transcendence of love. Among the many voices: Kathy Najimy, Beth Malone and Andrew Tobias.

title: Beware the Lake
description: There are secrets in the water.

title: Beyoncé & Jay-Z: Power Love
description: A merger of megastar music. Discover the story of multi-genre performer and fashion promoter, Beyonce Knowle sand the world's first hip hop billionaire, Jay-Z

title: Beyond Atlantis
description: A band of adventurers invade a native island determined to grab a reported fortune in buried treasure. The islanders are just as determined to keep their sacred treasure. Complications ensue.

title: Beyond Boobs
description: A hilarious and at times provocative film about a middle-aged American single-mother living in Switzerland and her quest to find out if she'll be invisible when she's no longer the woman with the biggest breasts in the room.

title: Beyond Borders, Five Souls of Asia
description: Explore five extraordinary countries in one unforgettable journey. Witness Laos’ timeless beauty, Bangladesh’s vibrant pulse, the Philippines’ tropical paradise, India’s grand heritage, and Nepal’s spiritual peaks. A breathtaking adventure of culture, history, and nature awaits!

title: Beyond Love and Companionship
description: Eleanor, an Israeli experimental musician living in Berlin, discovers what ruins her life.“I think that Germany is responsible for 9/11"

title: Beyond the Bridge
description: A mysterious drug sends art student Marla Singer into a dark trip between reality and delusion. Isolated in an old house, pushed by cryptic dreams, and haunted by a nameless thing, she soon realizes that denial won't end her nightmare.

title: Beyond the Darkness
description: Rich orphan loses fiancée to voodoo doll mischief by jealous housekeeper. He digs her up, preserves her, tests and disposes of young maidens with help from the disapproving housekeeper.

title: Beyond the Depths
description: The young Kiara lives with her mother Ariane. They both share a secret which has been buried for years. When Nathan, the son of Ariane's partner moves in, the secret comes to the surface.

title: Beyond Trainspotting: The World of Irvine Welsh
description: Welsh relays his own story and philosophy with characteristic, while a roll call admirers share their passion for the books.

title: Bible Town
description: Embark on a journey to BIBLE TOWN with best friends Jimmy, Sarah, and Tammy. Experience the wonder of inspirational Bible stories told by its extraordinary inhabitants.

title: Big Bad Bugs
description: Special ops sent to save missing soldiers face an army of giant scorpions, spiders, & snakes from another dimension on Earth. A thrilling battle begins!

title: Big Charity: The Death of America's Oldest Hospital
description: The death of America's oldest continuously operating hospital, New Orleans' Big Charity.

title: Big Fish Blues
description: Uncover Long Island's vibrant blues scene in "Big Fish Blues" documentary. Immerse yourself in incredible performances and personal stories of renowned musicians. Experience the "Blues way of life" firsthand.

title: Big Helium Dog
description: From Producer Kevin Smith comes this rarely seen, off-the-wall sketch comedy about the world's dumbest man who loses his best friend, gets fired from his job and almost causes the downfall of all that is good and just! Starring Kevin Heffernan (Super Troopers), Steve Lemme (Beerfest) & Michael Ian Black (Wet Hot American Summer), BIG HELIUM DOG is packed with laughs, cameos & pure indie chaos.

title: Big in Japan
description: A struggling Seattle Rock band, Tennis Pro, take one last shot at making it big as they embark on a comical musical odyssey in Tokyo with hopes to prevent their day jobs from becoming their careers.

title: Big In Sweden
description: We follow the New Zealand comedian Al Pitchers' search for what it really means to be big in Sweden. With a road movie and large portion of humor, Al discovers odd landmarks such as the world's largest cheese slicer and a big potato in Mjölby.

title: Big Noise Dispatches 06
description: Jeremy Scahill's exclusive report reveals the courageous figure standing against Blackwater's impunity for the Nisur Square massacre.

title: Big Noise Dispatches 07
description: Crisis in counterinsurgency, US forces in Iraq, Latino recruitment, Afghan tribal strategy, FBI's role in homegrown terror cases. Watch COIN's Last Stand, Enduring Presence, Yo Soy El Army, Million Dollar Militia, and Entrapped.

title: Big World
description: Liu Chunhe, a young man with cerebral palsy, overcomes physical and mental barriers while fulfilling his grandmother's dream and discovering his life's purpose, leading to transformation and a fresh start.

title: Bigfoot Exorcist
description: A demonic cult has summoned the ultimate beast, Bigfoot, to prowl the mountains and slaughter innocent victims. But when Claude is attacked by the creature, the curse of Bigfoot is passed down to him. Now Claude turns into a hairy, fanged beast at night, thirsty for warm blood. Only the power of a nun trained in exorcism can hope to set Claude free from this nightmare.

title: Bigfoot vs Krampus
description: Lucifer summons Krampus to terrorize survivors. Bigfoot, Van Helsing, Kali unite against them in post-apocalyptic world's fight for survival.

title: Bigfoot: The Movie
description: JS Pictures Corp presents Bigfoot The Movie, a hilarious comedy/horror flick. Join four locals as they take down Bigfoot in Ellwood City, PA. Starring Curt Wootton, Joanie Dodds, and more.

title: Bikini Bloodbath Christmas
description: In the true spirit of Christmas the girls put their rivalry and self preservation instincts aside and invite everyone to a big holiday bash. Mysteriously people at the party start disappearing to death. Who could be killing them' It could be anybody at the party! Who will live' Who will die' Who's top's will come off' And most importantly, who will win the epic eggnog wrestling match'

title: Bill Evans: Time Remembered
description: Discover the life and music of Bill Evans in this biographical film. Interviews with Tony Bennett, Jack Dejohnette, and more shed light on his journey. A must-watch for fans and music enthusiasts.

title: Bill Tilghman and the Outlaws
description: A movie company comes to Oklahoma to convince legendary lawman Bill Tilghman to star in a bank robbery silent film featuring real outlaws. Tilghman reluctantly agrees, not realizing everyone's lives will never be the same.

title: Billie Eilish: Unfiltered
description: With a style and attitude that defies conventions and a unique sound within the industry, it's hard to deny that Billie Eilish has become synonymous with the current culture. Her music resonates with millions of fans around the world, selling out arenas and stadiums, making her one of the largest artists today.

title: Binding
description: "Shibari is an erotic art, which consists in restraining someone by using thin ropes." This is how Claire, who's modeling in Japan, describes the subject to Chloé, a journalist who's come to Tokyo to write about it. The two women will soon grow attracted to each other.

title: Biohack Yourself: Lifespanning Our Vitality
description: Follows collaboration between biohackers, scientists, and experts to uncover longevity secrets. Initially one film, expanded to four due to increased participation, exploring ways to achieve healthy lives accessible to average households.

title: Birds of Neptune
description: Rachel (Britt Harris) navigates the challenges of growing up while confronting haunting memories, buried secrets, and spiritual practices. As her childhood home unravels, she finds solace in music and a newfound friendship.

title: Bisho
description: The neighbor’s dog won’t stop barking. Emilio and Susana can’t sleep—or stop fighting. The barking and howling, both the dog’s and the couple’s, will lead to their inevitable separation. Emilio will wrongly explode with anger, sadness, and insecurity. Overcome with guilt, he will have to face himself and make an unexpected choice.

title: Bitcoin: The End of Money as We Know It
description: For anyone who has not fully understood the controversial concept behind Bitcoin yet, this is an award-winning, concise, and informative crash course about the history of money, banking, and why Crypto Currencies such as Bitcoin matter.

title: Bittersweet Monday
description: When two longtime best friends say their goodbye before a big move, they find themselves holding onto more than just their friendship. Separately in committed marriages, the two experience an emotional shift, exacerbated by the circumstances that bring them together and alone again. Transitioning into adulthood is a long and arduous process. But people often feel they should have everything figured out by a certain age, which rarely happens, if at all.

title: Bizarre Murders
description: Bizarre Murders reveals a true and surprisingly strange crime story. These are not serial murderers evading the FBI, but Fargo-like capers with shocking twists and unusual characters.

title: Bla Bla Bla
description: Prepare for laughs in this hilarious short from director Alexis Morante. A ride-sharing driver's first customers deliver an unexpected experience. Buckle up for surprises!

title: Black Brigade
description: In a challenging mission, a prejudiced officer leads a squad of black troops tasked with capturing a vital bridge from the Germans.

title: Black Coffin
description: Bastian, famous rocker and leader of the Tucksons, is blocked from developing his new album due to the detoxification process he is undergoing. An unexpected accident happens while his manager pressures him to finish the album.

title: Black Dog
description: Two teenage boys from very different London backgrounds embark on a road trip North together. As they start to open up about their pasts, the boys learn they have far more in common than they first thought.

title: Black Garden
description: Black Garden, inspired by Dante's Inferno's 9th circle of hell, unfolds on a post-WWIII Christmas Eve. A lone survivor, Kate, defies death, seeking an enigmatic radio broadcaster's location on foot.

title: Black Magic Live: Stripped
description: This film explores the challenges the Black Magic Live show and its core group of dancers have experienced during their 4 years on the Las Vegas Strip.

title: Black Metal and Other Dark Music
description: In this all-encompassing black metal documentary, the metal style reigns with humor and offensiveness. Diverse topics abound as bands beyond the genre express their take on this captivating music.

title: Black Ruby
description: Jules and Louis, hustlers and jazz musicians struggle to create a hit when a black-Hispanic escort named Ruby interrupts their lives distracting their music and causing Louis to street fight his friend's debts away.

title: Black Scarab
description: An ancient meteor, now a mystical scarab, holds immense power. The villainous Sphinx seeks it, while a heroic archaeologist and their allies strive to stop world domination.

title: Black Smoke Rising
description: Jonah, a grieving blues musician, embarks on a ghostly scavenger hunt at the urging of his deceased brother Rafe. But it appears Rafe has joined him on the journey.

title: Black Sun
description: Witness the inspiring journey of Hugues de Montalembert in Gary Tarn's award-winning documentary, BLACK SUN. Experience his resilience after a life-altering attack.

title: Black Watch Snipers
description: Documentary with interviews about the Canadian black watch regiment in ww2

title: Blackbird
description: An alienated teenager's posturing online threat ignites a firestorm of fear in a small community.

title: Blackfly
description: In northern Ontario, a young surveyor faces relentless encounters with the notorious black flies. Their persistence becomes his constant companion.

title: Blackwoods
description: In the face of rising mental health challenges among black men, therapist Dillon leads 5 friends on a weekend retreat at a secluded cabin, where they confront their inner demons and rediscover the healing power of brotherhood in Blackwoods.

title: Blake & Gwen: Now & Then
description: Witness the offstage love story of country king Blake Shelton and pop princess Gwen Stefani. Together, they overcame challenges to create their own heartfelt love song.

title: Blaze Foley: Duct Tape Messiah
description: Texas outlaw music legend who was shot in 1989 while protecting an elderly neighbor. Blaze is an enigma, desperately wanting his music to be heard but rejecting the demands required for commercial success. He's now an authentic Americana music legend.

title: Blind Love
description: In this Cyrano-De-Bergerac-esque comedy of errors, a blind girl falls in love with a ventriloquist by merely being able to hear his voice. However, when she meets him, she mistakes his friend for the ventriloquist. She starts dating the friend without realizing it's the wrong man and not the man she fell for. This bittersweet Japanese film won lots of international praise for its bold performances

title: Blind Trust
description: Witness the inspiring journey of a blind boy determined to conquer obstacles and embrace life to the fullest. A tale of resilience and self-discovery.

title: Blind Turn
description: Samantha Holt is forced to confront her dark secrets when she is kidnapped and held prisoner by a man from her past out for revenge.

title: Blinkity Blank
description: Experience the captivating collaboration of Maurice Blackburn's experimental jazz and Norman McLaren's whimsical animation in a vivid and mesmerizing optical phantasmagoria.

title: Blood and Snow
description: Scientists find meteor in Arctic. It kills one, infects the other. Nearby base takes in survivor to investigate incident. Survivor's identity raises questions.

title: Blood Child
description: Bill and Ashely DiAngelo seem to have it all, an overseas posting to Singapore, life in paradise and a new baby on the way. But tragedy strikes when she loses the baby and sinks into a deep depression.

title: Blood Country
description: Blood Country: Gripping true story of murder and injustice in post-Civil War Mississippi. A high-caliber must-see film with compelling cast and Hollywood-level production values.

title: Blood Feast
description: After having moved to France, Fuad works night shifts at a museum for Egyptian culture. During long nights, he is repeatedly drawn to a statue representing the seductive ancient goddess Ishtar and becomes allured by her visions.

title: Blood in the Snow
description: Wilhelm and Pluto seek fame by filming The Faceless Lurch, a suspected shape-shifter. Wilhelm's rival Josh joins, leading the trio to doubt each other's allegiance as paranoia rises over who might be The Faceless Lurch.

title: Blood Money
description: When a robbery goes wrong, five friends find themselves trapped in a deserted holiday home, consumed by paranoia and fear, leading to tension and betrayal among them.

title: Blood Money
description: A bank executive's hidden past returns to haunt him as a vengeful prison escapee kidnaps his fiancé and her sister. Brace for a thrilling tale of redemption and revenge.

title: Blood Mountain Massacre
description: While on tour through the eerie backwoods of Georgia, a girl band becomes the target of a relentless escaped killer. With their opening act by their side, the two bands are thrust into a heart-pounding game of cat and mouse. As the night descends into chaos, dark secrets surface, and the sinister ties between the band's past and the killer's twisted motives come to light, revealing a chilling connection that no one expected.

title: Blood of the Tribades
description: A village divided by gender conflict and vampire superstition. Men fall ill, blaming vampire women. Forgotten lovers uncover the truth before Bathor's return.

title: Blood Punch
description: A young man escapes rehab for a drug score with a mysterious girl. Their love triangle turns into a supernatural cycle of carnage and mayhem in an isolated cabin. No end, no escape.

title: Blood Shot
description: Notorious terrorist plans deadly US attack with a nuclear weapon. Unlikely duo, a mysterious vampire & rogue cop, unite to stop his motley gang. Thrilling action conceived by WWBP.

title: Bloodlust
description: Bloodlust follows the story of Chad Ross, a boy who was born with a rare condition that causes his blood cells to infinitely regenerate themselves, as the government notices his potential. Kidnapped by a deranged drill sergeant, Ross is trained to become an American super-soldier and a cold-blooded and lonely killing machine. But when a formidable terrorist group commanded by their psychotic leader Reaper takes a nuclear weapons bunker hostage, he is forced to work with a squad who help him real

title: Bloody Moon
description: Tragedy strikes a language school in Spain as girls are brutally murdered.

title: Blu-Ray: Art of the Disc
description: The Blu-ray format was developed by a consortium of electronics companies, that was formed in 2002 to create a new disc format that could store high-definition video and more data than DVDs could.

title: Blue Bus
description: At 68, August Dupree contemplates life's final act. A surprise arrival of a worn-out blue Volkswagen bus brings unexpected possibilities to his doorstep.

title: Blue Call
description: Haylee, a local EMT suffering from PTSD, spends her days making split second decisions with lives that hang in the balance. One night on a routine call, she is faced with a moral decision, taking matters into her own hands and mercy kills a young woman. Her decision opens a pandora's box that leads Haylee to blur the lines of her job responsibilities and wanting to help those in need. Now, falling deeper and deeper into a rabbit hole, she gets caught up in a world of underground drugs and a sadi

title: Blue Christmas
description: Chicago 1941. Meet private eye Richard Stone, celebrating at his Christmas Even office party after beating the draft by way of a bribe. He's a disappointment to his secretary and main squeeze, Katie Crocket, whose brother Ben is fighting overseas; and his honest young employee joey Ernest is guilt-ridden over all the divorce-racket keyhole peeping. Worst of all, his equally sleazy partner, Jake Marley, was murdered a year ago tonight and Stone didn't bother solving Jake's ho-ho homicide.

title: Blue Desert
description: In search of answers, a tormented man follows his intuitions and dreams. Along his journey, revelations unfold, leading him to his soul mate and the mystical Blue Desert.

title: Blue Moon
description: Horace Jones is flat broke and working a dead boring night-shift. When half a million dollars of stolen drug money drops miraculously into his hands he makes a snap decision that will change everything.

title: Blue Summer
description: Teenagers pack a van full of beer and go on the road in search of sexual adventures.

title: Blue World Order
description: The film is set in a post-apocalyptic world in which civilisation has crumbled. A massive electromagnetic pulse has killed all children on the planet with the exception of Molly (Billie Rutherford), the daughter of Jake Slater (Jake Ryan).

title: Blueberry
description: Maya, an Iowa woman aspiring to be a dancer, meets Elsa. They decide to run away to Rapid City for a dance contest. On their journey through the Badlands, reality catches up with them, altering their plans.

title: Bluegrass Spirits
description: Bluegrass Spirits is a dramatic comedy, feature-length film about Kentucky, Kentucky Bourbon, Kentucky folks, and ghosts.

title: Bluff
description: A London police officer goes undercover as a heroin addict in a small town and manipulates an unsuspecting local junkie into working with him for a dangerous drug dealer.

title: Bob Dylan - World Tours: 1966-1974
description: Barry Feinstein was the exclusive photographer on Bob Dylan and The Band's legendary 1966 and 1974 World Tours. In this film, Feinstein and Director Joel Gilbert chronicle these epic Bob Dylan tours, featuring Feinstein's finest portraits.

title: Bob Dylan: Revealed
description: As Bob Dylan turns 70, a true portrait of the reclusive "voice of the generation" is revealed through exclusive interviews, and never-before-seen photos and films of Dylan's 50-year career.

title: Bob Dylan: Roads Rapidly Changing
description: Explore Bob Dylan's role in the Greenwich Village Folk Revival. This film delves into his entry, departure, and features new interviews, rare performances, and captivating footage from the era.

title: Bobbi and Sheelagh

description: A true story of resilience and transformation, this documentary follows Oscar "Randy" Swaim--Air Force aviator turned leadership coach--as he rises above life's storms. Through adversity, he found purpose and now inspires others to unlock their potential and soar.

description: Former Australian soldier, Mike Wheeler, returns to Afghanistan, seeking redemption from the family of a civilian man he killed during the war.

title: Joan of Arc
description: In the 15th century, both France and England stake a blood claim for the French throne. Believing that God had chosen her, the young Joan (Lise Leplat Prudhomme) leads the army of the King of France. When she is captured, the Church sends her for trial on charges of heresy. Refusing to accept the accusations, the graceful Joan of Arc will stay true to her mission.

title: Jobriath A.D.
description: Called "The American Bowie," "The True Fairy of Rock & Roll" and "Hype of the Year," Jobriath's reign as the first openly gay rock star was brief and over by 1975. Now, 35 years later, "Jobriath A.D." spotlights his life, music, groundbreaking influence and the new generations of fans slowly re-discovering him.

title: Johnny
description: Floyd is a child abuse victim constantly being tormented by voices and hallucinations in his head that lead him to a talking puppet with answers to his abusive childhood.

title: Jolly Fellows
description: A musically talented shepherd gets his big chance when he is mistaken for a famous conductor.

title: Jonestown: Paradise Lost
description: Using survivor testimony and dramatic reenactments, this documentary tracks the build-up to a horrific doomsday: the mass murder and suicides of Jim Jones’ cult followers in the jungles of Guyana, where over 900 men, women, and children lost their lives.

title: Jordan Clark: Machine In Girls Jeans
description: In 2015 Jordan Clark announced himself on the world stage of scootering and sent shock waves through the sport as he transitioned from amateur rider to World Champion in the space of just a few months.

title: Josep
description: A dying gendarme remembers his encounter with Catalan artist Josep Bartolí in a French concentration camp after the Spanish Civil War.

title: Joseph
description: A Jamaican doctor trained in Western medicine and in conflict with his family (all of whom are doctors) about his belief in the benefits of non traditional medicine, travels to Ghana to prove them wrong.

title: Josephine Doe
description: Josephine is a bright spark in Claire's recently darkened reality, but when the two women find themselves in trouble with the law, Claire discovers Josephine is not all she seems.

title: José
description: José lives with his mother in Guatemala. It's a tough life in one of the most violent and religious countries. When he meets Luis, he's thrust into new-found passion and pain.

title: Journey Of The Universe
description: Emmy-winning JOURNEY OF THE UNIVERSE explores cosmic evolution from Big Bang to now. Swimme and Tucker's elegant narrative highlights humanity's vital role in Earth's flourishing. A profound celebration of our contribution.

title: Journey Through Patagonia
description: Embark on a mesmerizing 'Journey through Patagonia'! Experience untamed wilderness, awe-inspiring peaks, rare wildlife, glacier adventures, and dramatic skies in this spectacular expedition.

title: Journey to a New Earth
description: Journey to A New Earth chronicles a bold vision to rid the world’s oceans, lakes, and rivers of plastic pollution.

title: Journey to the UFC: Joe Pyfer
description: Journey to the UFC: Joe Pyfer chronicles the relentless journey of Joe Pyfer, a man who rises from a harrowing past and confronts shattering obstacles in his quest to fight in the UFC.

title: Journeys Into The Soul
description: This is a transformative, 20-episode documentary series in which real people explore their hidden subconscious through regression sessions, uncovering answers to life's biggest questions and discovering meaning, clarity, and healing along the way. The series explores the work of Dr. Michael Newton, who developed Life Between Lives Hypnotherapy and Dolores Cannon who pioneered the Quantum Healing Hypnosis Technique (QHHT). Each episode features a CLIENT who tells us about who they are and why the

title: Joy: Inspired by the Book of Job
description: Joy, a successful business owner, has it all: Faith, Family, Friends and Finances. She goes through a series of significant losses that test her unwavering faith in God.

title: Joyland
description: Pooda Johnson is celebrating his last weekend on house arrest with a kickback (party) that could jeopardize the very freedom he's celebrating.

title: Juan and the Cloud
description: Juan, a friendless child, and La Nube, a cloud without cloud companions, form an unlikely bond. But as Juan matures, he becomes lost in the colorless realm of adulthood.

title: Juan Brito: Tamia
description: Juan Brito, a remarkable ethnographer, poet, writer, and master potter, left a profound legacy. His understanding of nature's elements and the human soul echoes through his pottery. Discover his wisdom and connection to the world.

title: Juan of the Witches
description: Juan de las Brujas: A testament to art's power, this film honors Juan Medellín's legacy in Ballet Folklórico. A vivid journey through dance and cherished memories.

title: Juca
description: Is Juca coming? On a full moon night, a group of friends must cycle away from the city lights in search of a place dark enough to watch a meteor shower.

title: Judy Collins & Jonas Fjeld - Winter Stories: Live From The Oslo Opera House
description: Judy Collins, Jonas Fjeld, and Chatham County Line perform a hootenanny at Oslo Opera House. Experience the live DVD and CD featuring classics, new tunes, and surprises.

title: Judy Garland: Property of MGM
description: The story of a legend, as never told before. Judy Garland: Property of MGM traces the rise and fall of Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer’s brightest star, revealing the cost of fame under Hollywood's studio system, with narration by Debbie Wileman and insight from historian Scott Brogan.

title: July Rising
description: When sixteen-year old Andy inherits her grandfather's orchard and becomes the ward of her aunt from the city, she must navigate the path to her future from a small town where choice and agency have never been options for young women.

title: June 9
description: What happened on june 9? On a search for some harmless fun at the end of the school year, 17 year-old Derek Boggman led his friends on a mischievous journey of caught-on-camera pranks. But on their quest to find even bigger thrills, something else found them first. The "Boston Mills 5" were never heard from again...until now. Witness the complete recording of the horrors surrounding june 9. The first scream was for fun. The second scream was for help.

title: Jupiter’s Moon
description: Aryan is a Syrian refugee trying to make his way into Hungary from Serbia, along with his father and many other wretched souls. They are all caught, and find themselves in a web of cynicism and corruption.

title: Jurassic Planet
description: Meet Oki, a baby human separated from his parents when a Tyrannosaurus Rex attacks his village. When Oki befriends a baby triceratops named Kona is friendship at first sight. But when the malevolent T-rex Snarl finds out about the cave boy, he demands the other dinosaurs turn him over to him. With Snarl close on their heels, Oki and Kona will have to find a magic stone or face the end of their beloved Dinosaur Kingdom. Enter the world of Jurassic Planet.

title: Jury of Twelve
description: Twelve jurors argue incessantly over a seventeen-year-old girl's guilt

title: Just 6.5
description: The police are after a drug lord named Naser Khakzad, but when they finally manage to catch him, he tries whatever he can think of to escape and save his family.

title: Just a Joke, Darling
description: Three women from different generations navigate dreams, family struggles, and societal pressures, their lives subtly intertwining in a quiet exploration of resilience and connection. It is a heartfelt, bold exploration of womanhood, weaving the struggles of three generations into a powerful narrative of resilience. From chasing dreams to confronting crime and unexpected motherhood, the film captures life’s raw complexities — all shot on an iPhone for an intimate, authentic touch.

title: Just Ask for It
description: Macy & Dave confront workplace gender inequality, affecting their relationship. Macy's facade crumbles while Dave defends his path to success. Gripping dynamics unfold.

title: Just Boys
description: Teenage ISAAC meets his friend ADAM in secret, one day after class. They meet on the playground, where Adam offers Isaac a joint to smoke. As the afternoon stretches into evening, Isaac is offered a dance and too many meaningful looks; or is it just his imagination?

title: Just Breathe
description: A troubled teen goes to live with her dad in a small town to reflect on her questionable choices. Unfortunately, she clashes with her father's new wife, who is pregnant.

title: Just Jim
description: High school outcast Jim befriends the charismatic Dean for popularity. But Dean's hidden dark secret makes Jim question the price of acceptance.

title: Just Say Goodbye
description: After enduring years of abuse from his alcoholic father and an unrelenting school bully, Jesse Peterson confesses his plan to commit suicide to his best friend, Sarah Moran. Feeling forced to keep silent about Jesse's intentions, Sarah embarks on the greatest trial of her life--to save her friend from his greatest enemy, himself.

title: Just Say Love
description: After what is supposed to be a no-strings hook up, two men discuss their dreams, what ideal happiness might be like, and maybe a future together.

title: Justice
description: A Black man , becomes a masked vigilante after his cousin's death at the hands of a racist cop. By day, he's a community leader; by night, he fights corruption. He seeks justice against a corrupt police force and systemic racism. His name is JUSTICE.

title: Justine's Flavours of Fuji
description: In an area filled with an extraordinary amount of tradition and culture, Justine meets local artisans and producers, visits amazing places and learns time-honoured cooking methods. Under the watchful eye of Fuji-san Justine will share dishes inspired by the journey and the produce that makes Shizuoka such a unique place in such a unique country.

title: Juug Gone Wrong
description: Two cousins with similar hustles but different methods work in the pharmaceutical field, one legally and one illegally.

title: K-11
description: A record producer comes around after binging on drink and drugs. He finds himself in a section of the Los Angeles County Jail reserved for homosexuals, which is ruled by a transgender woman named Mousey.

title: Kadara
description: After completing her Bachelor's degree, a young woman returns to her northern hometown to fulfill her national service, only to realize how much she's forgotten about her roots and culture. Struggling to reconnect with her heritage, she faces rejection and discrimination for standing against certain traditional beliefs.

title: Kafka
description: Franz Kafka, born in 1883, was a troubled, brilliant writer whose dark, intricate works reshaped 20th-century literature. Haunted by oppressive family dynamics and an unfulfilling office job, he wrote obsessively yet remained unsatisfied. Without his friend Max Brod defying Kafka’s wish to destroy his manuscripts, the world would have lost a literary genius. This film offers a surprising and intimate glimpse into Kafka’s complex mind.

title: Kamagra
description: A film by Mark Baris.

title: Kanari
description: In remote Iceland, a young couple's world is shattered by a life-altering head-on collision, forever changing their lives.

title: Kanehsatake: 270 Years of Resistance
description: Witness the Mohawk Nation's resistance to centuries of oppression in the Oka crisis. This film sheds light on their struggle for justice and sovereignty.

title: Karbala Memoirs
description: From India, a filmmaker retraces the historic journey to Karbala, capturing the peaceful march honoring Hussain's legacy, juxtaposed with their own poignant childhood memories.

title: Karma Bums
description: Fed up with modern American living, two vagabonds rob a psychotic drug dealer and decide to flee the country, taking a road trip and beholding the beauties of the great American West, en route for Canada where they plan to start new lives.

title: Kasala! (Plenty Trouble)
description: Taking place in a Nigerian slum, Tunji, a fast talking teenager, borrows his no-nonsense Uncle's car and gets his friends, Chikodi, Effiong and Abraham to join him on a Joyride around the neighborhood. Things turn sour when they crash the car and only have 5 hours to raise the required funds to fix the vehicle before Tunji's Uncle gets back from work.

title: Kathryn Upside Down
description: After an unexpected discovery, Kathryn's world is turned upside down.

title: Kayla
description: In the world of dementia care, Sarah (27) grapples with a decision as her employer Stanley (80) confuses her with his granddaughter. A poignant tale unfolds.

title: Keen
description: Afecto shows the relationship of a homosexual couple who share the same space but no longer see each other. Between the lines we talk about cutting, a disturbance that people cut themselves in the film, these cuts are symbolized by the track and editing. In the paradoxes of clean / dirty, repetition of movements and objects that do not belong to the scene, we perceive the disturbance.

title: Keep Busy
description: An inspirational MTB video made during lockdown.

title: Keeping Christmas
description: Every Christmas we put up the tree, pull out the ornaments and deck the halls, but have you ever wondered where those traditions started? Germany in the late 1800's was the epicenter for craftsmen making Christmas décor and ornaments. One such craftsman was Richard Mahr. Born on St. Nicholas day December 6, 1879, it would seem he was destined to build a life around Christmas and its traditions. Born at the dawn of a new century, a time of upheaval and change. This is the story of Richard Mahr an

title: Keeping Secrets
description: Determined to prove herself, a police officer must go undercover at a seedy lounge to catch a serial killer.

title: Kelsi Davies: Haunted Dolls
description: Kelsi Davies (and friends) experience otherworldly events in communion with haunted dolls.

title: Kelsi Reacts!
description: Psychic Kelsi Davies reacts to some of the internet's scariest videos.

title: Kensuke's Kingdom
description: Young Michael, shipwrecked on a remote island, must adapt to life alone. Over time, he feels another presence, learning that this world is home to both unimaginable danger and beauty.

title: Kepler's Dream
description: Eleven-year-old Ella (Isabella Blake-Thomas) is a city girl forced to spend the summer on the New Mexico ranch of her reclusive grandmother, Violet Von Stern (Holland Taylor), while Ella's mom (Kelly Lynch) undergoes chemotherapy in another state. As she tries to cope with her grandmother's strict rules and snooty friends, Ella longs for her mother and begs her estranged father for rescue.

title: Keteke (Expecting Delays)
description: It's the 80s rail service system, and the train is the only means of transport from the outskirts. A couple BOI (Adjetey Anang) and ATSWEI (Lydia Forson) is bent on delivering their first baby in Akete but misses their first train. A wrong decision finds them in the middle of nowhere. Will they make it on time for the delivery, or, risk losing the baby and mother?

title: Khazana
description: Haunted by abuse from her new family, a young bride grapples with her sanity. But when she resolves to fight back, everything changes.

title: Kid's Town
description: A funny family friendly show that follows father and son as they move to a new town, make new friends and clash heads with schoolyard bullies and an overbearing mayor.

title: Kill Teaser
description: Based on True Events: An Asian American Hacker investigates a website that creates torture videos. He becomes the unwilling sidekick for the sinister mastermind behind it, who changes his life in horrible ways.

title: Kill the Girl
description: When a sci-fi conspiracy unfolds in a single room, Kate learns her abductor isn't a psychopath but a pawn in a time-bending family feud. The only way to stop a global catastrophe is for her to endure a trauma engineered by her future self.

title: Killa Kafe
description: Killa Kafe is a dark comedy about a cafe with a twist: every shot of coffee comes with a shot at eliminating the troublemakers in your life.

title: Killer Crocodile
description: A group of environmentalists arrives at a faraway tropical delta where toxic waste is being dumped. However the water also hides a giant crocodile. The corrupt local officials don't help much either.

title: Killin' Time
description: A group of true-crime podcasters travel back to the scene of the Darien Cross cult killings to investigate what really happened a decade ago during the events of the first film.

title: Killing Anabella
description: Meet Anabella, a complex character haunted by a tragic past. In a gripping tale of survival, she confronts a Psycho Killer while seeking solace from her dark history. Will death be her ultimate escape?

title: Killing Poe
description: Killing Poe is a dark comedy about five students in a class on Edgar Allan Poe who teach their professor a lesson in true Poe style.

title: Killing Zelda Sparks
description: In the web of a toxic bond, Craig yearns to escape Zelda's grasp. When she resurfaces after years, he seeks help from Terry. Together, they plot a revenge prank, unaware of its potentially lethal consequences.

description: During a getaway to Killington, VT, a wellness influencer's weekend retreat with her Manhattan friends takes a sinister turn as tensions rise, and the creepy locals add to the unnerving atmosphere.

title: Killswitch
description: The Internet is under attack. This award-winning documentary explores the threat Internet censorship imposes on free speech, innovation, and democracy.

title: King Kong
description: KING KONG is a story about a 50 years-old man, working in the Zoo while taking care of his bedridden mother.  Unable to form any type of relationship and express his sexuality, he will go down the path of violence and despair.

title: King Lear
description: King Lear delves into love, power, and death, offering Shakespeare's message: "Hold not the gods or heavens accountable for earthly horrors. Lay blame on human inhumanity."

title: King Of Rocket Men
description: A deadly conspiracy unfolds as atomic researchers fall victim to a mysterious remote-controlled assailant. Can they unmask "Dr. Vulcan" before it's too late? Jeff stars in this thrilling 12-episode series.

title: Kingdom and Wisdom's Parables
description: Stories with important messages addressing personal and human growth. It is important for reflection and learning.

title: Kiran
description: This film is based on third gender life and his struggle. How his family and society insulting him. It shows the discrimination of society and after that he fight from the society and get success.

title: Kissinger
description: Over the past two years, Chimerica Media have been given exclusive and unparalleled access to conduct a series of interviews with Henry Kissinger and to film him on a series of foreign trips to China, Israel and Russia. This feature documentary will combine excerpts from the extensive interviews with extraordinary contemporary archive. The result will be a unique insight into the mind and personality of the man who, more than any other single individual, shaped the foreign policy of the United S

title: Kittie: Origins/Evolutions
description: Finding heavy metal stardom as teenagers, Kittie has been thrashing for the past 20 years. With 6 albums and over 2 million in sales, they have defied industry norms, fought against rock stereotypes, and inspired generations.

title: Kitty Kills
description: A young woman seeks vengeance for her murdered parents, returning on Halloween as a blood-thirsty pussycat. Watch her take souls in this chilling tale.

title: Klimt
description: A portrait of Austrian artist Gustav Klimt, whose lavish, sexual paintings came to symbolize the art nouveau style of the late nineteenth and early twentieth century.

description: An assassin is sent by his psychotic employer, to kill his ex-wife. In his quest to accomplish his task, he becomes familiar with his target, making his mission difficult. Now, he must face the consequences of his actions.

description:
Planetary alignment. Convergence of the struggles. Emerald, Jasmine and Indra predict the future of the lost souls on Psychic TV, one of the most secluded TV channel. Love,
work, luck, they bring support to all the people that society hurt. When Emerald receive a phone call from Christelle, a harassement victim who is convinced to be cursed, her own destiny swings.

title: Knocking on Heaven’s Door
description: Rwanda, 1994. When the president's plane is shot down, the genocide of the Tutsis ensues. Like many others, KESHAVA turns into a killer. Years later, he's among the beneficiaries of an amnesty and released from prison (as a response to overpopulated prisons, and with the aim to encourage reconciliation, the authorities granted amnesty to 'low key' killers who admitted to their guilt). Keshava has only one thing on his mind: to repair.

title: Know Fear
description: Donald Capel and his family unleash a perilous ritual from a demonic book after his wife's possession. Each family member must communicate with the demon in their own way.

title: Koko
description: Experience the extraordinary journey of Randy, a financial guru, who finds solace and unconditional love in his faithful companion, Koko the dog.

title: Konga TNT
description: After becoming injected with a formula derived from an alien ship, a lab gorilla escapes from his containment and befriends two young boys. The alien formula causes the gorilla to grow to gargantuan size and rampage throughout the city and the boys must find a way to save their simian friend before the army takes him down.

title: Korban
description: AISYAH, a sous-chef under renowned CHEF LOUIS, aspires to join his New Zealand restaurant and be with her Maori fiance ARI. But losing her mother disrupts her path.

title: Kumu Hina
description: Imagine a world where a little boy can grow up to be the woman of his dreams, and a young girl can rise to become a leader among men. Welcome to Kumu Hina's Hawai'i. Kumu Hina tells the inspiring story of Hina Wong-Kalu, a transgender native Hawaiian teacher, or Kumu, who brings to life Hawai'i's traditional embrace of Mahu - those who embody both male and female spirit.

title: Kung Fu Brother
description: In this action packed, international comedy thriller, three cops and a female reporter are in hot pursuit of a murderer whose quest is to acquire the Sacred Kuji Denjo Scrolls. As the team traverses across the globe in this perilous adventure, they can't seem to avoid hand to hand combat battles, white knuckle car chases, sword fights, and explosive gun fights. The crew must find a way to discover the murderer fast enough so they are no longer targets of ancient Thailand's Weirding Clan. Directe

title: Kung Fu Dog
description: The Kung Fu Masters return to battle as a chosen boy and his bunny sidekick embark on a quest to defeat the evil dog Trapper and recover an ancient talisman.

title: Kurt Cobain: All Apologies
description: Examining the tragic downward spiral into drug addiction and depression of musician Kurt Cobain, 20 years after his death.

title: Kylie Minogue: Pop Icon
description: This documentary chronicles the extraordinary life and career of Kylie Minogue, from her early days on the Australian soap opera "Neighbours" to her rise as a global music sensation. Celebrate her enduring influence, chart-topping hits, and resilience, offering an intimate look at the woman behind the pop phenomenon.

title: L.A. Macabre
description: Three filmmakers interview a former member of the defunct cult "The New Family" leading them down a path of mystery, kidnapping, and murder.

title: L.A. Wars
description: A trigger-happy ex-cop goes undercover in a mafia organization under the guise of protecting the crime boss's daughter from a new rival, which ignites a bloody war on the streets of L.A.

title: La Gunguna
description: The stories behind a .22 caliber pistol that brings bad luck and misfortune to any person that takes possession of it. "La Gunguna" tours the Caribbean underground leaving a trace of bad luck and unfortunate events, marked with tones of black humor.

title: LA Guns: The Hollywood Years: Live & Loaded
description: Come along on this wild, lust-fueled, gasoline-soaked, intoxicating rocket ride of pure 80's metallic mayhem! Tracii, Phil, Steve, Kelly and Mick (the original gunners) lay it on the line in this down & dirty tell all, a sunset strip concert with rare, never before seen backstage footage from the electric gypsies' early road ravages. Enjoy outrageous, interviews recounting the band's origins.

title: La Reserva
description: A rookie US Homeland Security Agent is assigned to an investigation of a large amount of dirty cash heading towards Mexico. The agent faces the brutal cartel in an attempt to confiscate their money, so he can keep it for himself.

title: La Soledad
description: Experience the Venezuelan crisis through the compelling journey of a young father fighting to protect his family from home demolition. A vivid and intimate portrayal.

title: Lace Crater
description: In search of a weekend escape, Ruth's Hamptons getaway takes an eerie turn when a stranger, Michael, enters her room. Their one night stand sparks supernatural consequences.

title: Ladies and Gentlemen, Mr. Leonard Cohen
description: NFB's Donald Owen and Donald Brittain team up for an imaginative profile of poet Leonard Cohen in this National Film Board of Canada production.

title: Ladies That Punch!
description: Watch as catwalk models, teachers, and nurses step into the boxing ring, defying stereotypes. Brace yourself for the fierce power of "Ladies That Punch!" - no ordinary lunch ladies.

title: Laduma: Benin's Journey
description: Join Benin's underdog national soccer team, The Squirrels, on their quest for the 2010 World Cup. Explore football's community impact and Benin's rich history, culture, and landscapes.

title: Lady Gaga: Glory
description: Lady Gaga's explosive career is driven by her outrageous fashion sense, elaborate videos, and spectacular stage sets. Yet, it's her music as 'Monster Mother' that has garnered fame and accolades.

title: Lady in the Urn
description: After returning home from a funeral, a couple discovers that Sharon's late mother's urn is at the center of a series of haunting disturbances, unraveling a chilling connection to a murder and a vengeful spirit.

title: Lady Psycho Killer
description: Slicing up men of questionable intent, a doe-eyed killer is on the loose in a small town.

title: Lady Trillion
description: Before she became Lady Trillion ( Rachanaa Jain) she is an alien from a planet called Trillion and gets attacked by an enemy so she escapes and miraculously lands on earth. She then explores and enjoys life on earth and becomes a Princess.

title: Lake Alice
description: The Thomas family goes out to their cabin in the woods to celebrate Christimas together with their daughter and her boyfriend, but their first Christmas together may be their last.

title: Lake Artifact
description: Five friends go on a weekend getaway to a cabin in Upstate New York, where time and space begins to function without reason, only to slowly turn them against each other one by one.

title: Lambing Season
description: An American woman named Bridget travels to the Irish countryside to track down her long-lost father while posing as a stranger. When things don't go according to her convoluted plan, Bridget and her father are surprised to learn how much they have in common. On a sheep farm full of secrets, nature has its way of delivering the truth.

title: Lamp Light
description: A man is forced to fight for his physical and mental survival when a tunnel collapse leaves him entombed in his car.

title: Land and Shade
description: After having left a long time ago, a humble country sugar cane worker returns home to meet his grandson and deal with the hardships his family has been put into.

title: Land in Flames
description: When everyone thought the nightmare was over, a new threat strikes the town, this time, wilder and bloodier.

title: Land of Broken Hearts
description: Huang Zhenkai, who hastily ended a relationship, move out of his girlfriend's house and find another place to live. In this way, he met Li Xiaole, a young girl who was also drifting in the city, and began to share a roommate life with her.

title: Land Of The Blessed
description: For generations, blood has stained the streets of this neighborhood, a relentless cycle where the only variable is who holds dominion. To safeguard the Land of the Blessed how deep into the abyss will a determined detective go?

title: Landing Up
description: When a young woman finds herself living life on the streets she learns the art of picking up men to put a roof over her head. But when she meets the guy of her dreams her secret threatens to ruin their perfect relationship.

title: LARPs
description: Six friends discover how their real lives affect the way they play - and vice versa.

title: Larry and the Grave in the Pines
description: For 200 years the secret of The Grave in the Pines lay hidden from the town's inhabitants until one man succumbs to the pressure of a tumultuous relationship, and unwittingly releases the evil that lie beneath during the season of All Hallows' Eve.

title: Last Days
description: Amidst the consumer world, four teens navigate the final school days in a shopping mall, seeking identity. "Last Days" labels echo their apocalyptic fear, lust for life, and the need for something new.

title: Last Days of Summer
description: In a neighborhood where nothing exciting ever happens, a teenage boy recalls the events of his life leading up to the disappearance of the girl next door.

title: Last Ferry
description: When a young gay lawyer arrives on Fire Island to explore his sexuality, he becomes witness to a murder after being drugged. A stranger helps him to safety, but he soon discovers his savior is friends with the killer.

title: Last Night
description: A model's last night in DC before moving in with her long time boyfriend is sidetracked by a chance meeting with an attractive stranger.

title: Last Ride
description: A young boy travels across Australia with his father, who's wanted by the law for committing a violent crime.

title: Last Seen in Idaho
description: A woman awakens from a coma after a car accident and begins having shocking visions of her future murder. It's a race against the clock as she tries to solve and prevent her own murder.

title: Last Summer
description: Two high school sweethearts, Luke and Jonah, spend their final months together over the course of a long, quiet summer in the rural South--a world of baseball, bicycles, church and green bean casserole--contemplating their uncertain future and the uncertain future of America.

title: Last Suspect
description: A female lawyer defending the murderer discovered a plot.

title: Laughology
description: Unveiling laughter's secrets! LAUGHOLOGY, a groundbreaking documentary, challenges Plato, the Bible, and your school's ban on laughter. Join this hilarious odyssey into the essence of laughter and its adversaries.

title: Laughter Has No Color
description: This documentary explores the first very Black Comedy Award show, the AHAAS. Created by Sir Frank Cooper the show was first put on in 1990. In 2021, there was a revival show. This is a tribute to Rudy Ray Moore and Eddie Murphy. These 2 Comedians along with Debbie Allen, Flip Wilson, Whoopi Goldberg, Reynaldo Rey and other entertainment legends were honored years ago at The very 1st Award Show for Black Comedians, The AAhA's Award Ceremony March 15th 1990.

title: Laura Gets a Cat
description: Laura, an unemployed writer in New York City, tries to juggle an unexciting boyfriend, an affair with a performance artist, and a vivid imaginary life.

title: Lawless Range
description: Two brothers, both with wife and kid, work on a Texas ranch. One's always getting into trouble and the other bailing him out. But this time it's a $6,000 debt to dangerous people.

title: Lawrence: After Arabia
description: Was a motorcycle crash an accident or attempt at assassination by the British Secret Service? "Lawrence: After Arabia" tells the story of the last years of the life of the 20th century hero, T.E. Lawrence - Lawrence of Arabia.

title: Laying Trap
description: Pedro Cancino transports a load bound for Houston, Texas, where his accomplices are waiting for them. However, something is wrong. There is information that does not match. Pedro and his partner prepare because this could be a trap.

title: Le Petomane: Parti avec le vent
description: Based on a true story set around turn-of-the-century France, it follows the lives of two men: Joseph Pujol and Dr. Marcel Baudouin. Pujol was an entertainer at the Moulin Rouge who was gifted with a unique backside, which could take in and release air in measured increments thus producing amazing and humorous noises. Dr. Baudouin was obsessed with Joseph's "instrument" and pursued him doggedly for many years, ultimately resulting in his undoing.

title: Le Week-End
description: A British couple return to Paris many years after their honeymoon there in an attempt to rejuvenate their marriage.

title: Lead Belly: The Man Who Invented Rock & Roll
description: The life story of Huddie "Lead Belly" Ledbetter.

title: Leaking Blue
description: A mother looks for her son in a hospital bed. In the midst of Sao Paulo’s ground zero areas, Catedral da Sé and the many people that circulate or live there, she finds her daughter. Among tides and shores, portraits of diverse times make and unmake in lines of blue that leak beyond the nails.

description: After a 12-year wait, the Chinese women's volleyball team returns to the Olympic final, marking their enduring journey through ups and downs over three decades.

Furthermore, it delves deep into the myth by exploring never before used scientific techniques to ultimately determine the truth behind the story. I have two lengths for the film at '52 and '60 and can supply either or both to you.

description: In a melting pot of confusion, unlikely friends Simon Murray and Pascal Dupont face their own battles. War tests honor, hope, and morality, revealing that one cannot desert everything... except themselves.

Both are in love - one is insane. Paul thinks he's losing his mind - but he has more to lose than that. One couple; one love; one tragedy.

description: Meet Leila Wayward, a little witch striving for perfection in the Magnificent Witchy Cake-off. With the help of her magical sisters, she embraces imperfections in this enchanting tale of acceptance and culinary adventure.

description: Samuel, a young Venezuelan, emigrates from his country in search of a better life and to help his family, without knowing the difficult situations that he will face as an immigrant.

title: Lembranza
description: Embark on a nostalgic journey through my memories. Walk with me into the past and experience moments remembered.

description: Desperate to step out of her famous mother's shadow and create her own legacy, an aspiring actress is taken under the wing of an eccentric film director who makes empty promises and surrounds her with reckless friends. An obsession with success leads her to a new, fast­paced lifestyle that eventually leaves her homeless, jobless and in the depths of a serious drug addiction.

She will have to start a new life, in-between troubles, friendship, news, disasters, parties. A deeply different life from the one she's always defended and loved.

description: Leo White is an ambitious young man with no sense of direction. His frustration with his mundane job causes him to have an explosive encounter with his manager Katrina. This otherwise uneventful skirmish leads to a series of unintended consequences. After being stalked relentlessly by a powerful and mysterious entity Leo must set aside his humanity and act in the interest of self preservation. It is survival of the fittest and Leo knows there is a predator lurking in the depths waiting to devour

title: Less Than 30
description: In her quest for a relationship, Alexa Cavender takes an unconventional approach, exclusively dating matches below 30%. Prepare for a unique romantic journey.

description: Christian is a dreamer who cannot find his place in this world; for the past 10 years he's been living in London, a city of a million opportunities, and training to become a professional in martial arts. At 35 years old, nothing he aspired to has become a reality. When he finds himself unemployed, his girlfriend (tired of his endless excuses) kicks him to the curb. Now he will be forced back to his birthplace, Genoa, where he will have to rediscover himself, reinvent himself, and above all else

title: Let The Wind Carry Me
description: This fascinating look into the mind and inner life of one of Asia's greatest cinematographers, Mark Lee Ping-Bing, features famous collaborators like Wong Kar-wei, Hou Hsiao-Hsien, and Sylvia Chang, and Shu Qi.

title: Let's Not Meet
description: A pizza delivery girl falls into a trap during her last stop. Trying to escape, she stumbles upon campers facing a terrifying nightmare.

title: Let's Not Meet in the Woods
description: Three sisters and their Aunt escape a stalker and a pandemic in the back country. But in the woods, they face a dangerous presence alone.

title: Letter to My Mother
description:
A film that addresses and a film that shows a processing through media: a fearless and strong autobiographical examination. LETTER TO MY MOTHER chooses a radically intimate
perspective. It is an examination that touches upon the centre of the pain and that dares to look precisely. It finds exact scenes for despair and cruelty and searches openly for ways of coping.

title: Letter to the Stranger
description: Eva grieves over her lost love. She is surprised by the ghost of her sister who consoles her by taking her into a wild rêverie, in the middle of desertic and industrial landscapes. Eva regains consciousness on a railroad bridge, when she suddenly hears the humming of a train.

description: When Brandon's faulty Ford Bronco dies in the middle of his escape to Colorado, he's forced to pick up Amber, an outspoken hitchhiker running from her small town.

title: Level 3

title: Level Up
description: When a Midwest couple receives a package meant for an organized spy operative, they are forced to run for their lives from hired assassins.

As Jones explores a nearby glacier and some Native American ruins, hunts moose, fishes for trout and observes the natural wildlife of the area, he comes across and befriends an abandoned bear cub, whom he names Li'l Scratch after the scared young animal scratches his arm.

description: In Liars, Fires and Bears, 9-year-old Eve and immature Dave embark on a cross-country road trip. As Eve seeks her brother and Dave evades trouble, their journey becomes a lesson in unlikely connections.

description: How the right to civil liberties was won on the streets of Britain by LGBTQ activists.

description: Embrace the uncomfortable truth. Amid a world filled with lies, Lies of Omission offers a documentary glimpse of hope for a better future.

description: A feature that not only celebrates the 1986 classic "Flight of the Navigator", but also looks at the life of its child star, Joey Cramer, and his roller-coaster life since that breakthrough role.

description: Carl, a computer programmer living in isolated existence in the remains of his grandparents basement, has activated the culmination of the past several years of his life's work: An animatronic head, complete with artificial intelligence.

description: In a warehouse in the middle of nowhere, two rival prostitutes held against their will join forces to help a 9 year-old girl escape her future as a child sex slave.

description: Explore the impactful yet brief existence of V66, Boston's UHF music video channel in the mid-1980s

description: Chatham, Ontario, 1998: Murder, family secrets, and devotion. John Kastner's gripping mystery captures the heartbreaking dynamics of a shattered family.

description: When a mother and son with a caustic history are reunited to pack up their old house, sparks fly as long-buried secrets are revealed…

They are small clippings of lives that, despite all the disharmony of the largest megalopolis in Latin America, find a thread of light to follow.

description: An anthology of coming-of-age stories exploring the journey of young love.

description: When Mark commits to falling back in love with Jonah, he is forced to look at himself with unprecedented courage and honesty.

description: Two strangers defend an eccentric estate from a caustic witch known as Lily Grace.

description: Join Peter Schultz on a transformative journey to Greece, exploring its rich history and culture. It's not just a vacation; it's an immersive experience that goes beyond the surface.

description: K is a bizarre girl who believes that the scent of pheromone could change the emotional feelings that exist between people, she tries to create her own perfume to attract her crush, Sean. However, their relationship remains as brother and sister. Eventhough they have become closer to each other than before, she gradually finds that there is something more difficult to conquer between their relationship.

description: Have you ever received a text message from someone you didn't know? Did something about it seem off or make you uncomfortable? More importantly how did you handle it? Lisa is a story about three different people getting the exact same text message and how they handle it could mean the difference between life and death. Karmas a B*tch...or a Demon.

LONGING portrays a human portrait of an introverted woman, who is losing her female image and is burning in her own desires.

description: Three London entrepreneurs embrace the micropub craze, bringing real ale, conversation, and community spirit to their local high streets.

description: Lenny Freeman is a straight-laced old-school accountant with a dream; to become a famous stand-up comedian. The problem is he's not very funny. Not even close. When his mother dies, leaving him nothing but debt and her '53 Oldsmobile, Lenny hits the road to chase his dream in Vegas and auditioning for Monte Guy's annual "Stand-Up Stand-Off". As the creature grows stronger, it drags buried childhood trauma to the surface, forcing her to confront a past she tried to erase. To survive, she must face the monster she created, or be consumed by it.

title: Midnight Runners
description: Two friends who are students at Korean National Police University, find themselves in an endless race against time after they witness a kidnapping and decide to use their knowledge.

description: Witness the haunting tale of a reclusive young man's love for a bartender, turning tragic when his sinister hunger for human blood emerges, making him a prime suspect in a string of horrifying murders.

description: Fifteen Migrants start their Journey for migration. They all have different reason. they confront hardships by starting immigration.

description: Two idiot stoners, Mike and Fred, are pulled away from their smoke session to pick up Mike's grandfather. What was supposed to be a quick favor for Mike's mother soon goes very, very wrong. Dazed and confused during a nationwide lockdown, they find themselves face-to-face with the undead.

title: Mike Case in: The Big Kiss Off
description: Mike Case, a car-dwelling detective, reluctantly accepts a wealthy socialite's offer to find her missing husband. Charm and money lead him on a captivating search.
