title: Vox Populi
description: Magdalena is a small-town theatre actress, playing unrecognizable roles. She travels to a nearby village to take care of her father-in-law, who has suffered a stroke. Due to a swine fever outbreak, the village has been blocked. After a long thought, she decides to save the pig, even though, if caught, she will face a fine that she is unable to pay. On her journey to save the pig, Magdalena finds the empathy of people in unlikely places.

title: Voyeur to the Paranormal
description: Maiya Kenick explores New Orleans' supernatural realm, venturing into haunted sites and consulting the city's Voodoo Queen. She also engages with Bloody Mary, renowned TV host of Travel Channel's Ghost Adventures.

title: Vulnerable
description: After giving birth prematurely, Carla returns to the old family country house, where she'll face her deepest fears.

title: Wabi-Sabi
description: This story tells about a woman in her mid-twenties who tries to revive her childhood memories. In order to relive the last moments with her mother. The story inquires, not judges, the imperfect soul. Beauty tainted by unusual parental love.

title: Waiting for a Train
description: In this emotionally gripping film two young adults face love and a health challenge. Heartwarming, tearful, and thought-provoking. Life's surprises at the train station.

title: Waiting for Fidel
description: A documentary explores a film crew's unsuccessful endeavor to interview Fidel Castro during their time in Cuba.

title: Waiting on the Warrior
description: Waiting On The Warrior is the story of David, a youth pastor, and his struggles with forgiveness for the accidental killing of his brother years ago, as well as his desire to help others. It also shows the importance of family and how sometimes it is God who is waiting on us to take the next step. It is a heartfelt drama full of tears, tragedy, warmth and happiness. Starring Erin Bethea (Fireproof) and Dr. Chad Costantino in his Actor/Director debut, Waiting On The Warrior is a story for the who

title: Wake the Witch
description: Deb and friends awaken a witch's curse by playing on her grave. As she seeks truth, they face unimaginable evil. A chilling journey awaits.

title: WALKA!
description: France: 2020s. PIOTR, a young Polish immigrant stuck in a string of odd jobs, crosses paths with STEFANO, a burly mover. Little did Piotr know, this encounter would soon draw him into the eerie world of nighttime fighting.

title: Walking
description: Director Ryan Larkin vividly captures diverse walking styles, from youthful swagger to elegant strolls, in a lively exploration.

title: Walking Through History
description: Tony Robinson embarks on spectacular walks through some of Britain's most historic landscapes in search of the richest stories from our past.

title: Walking with Elephants
description: Perfect for fans of The Elephant Whisperers and March of the Penguins, Walking with Elephants is a profoundly stirring account of one of Earth's most marvelous creatures. Featuring stunning footage and riveting narration, this profound film is essential viewing.

title: Wall
description: Join David Hare on a Middle East journey as he explores the profound impact of the Israel-Palestine wall on the region's inhabitants in the thought-provoking documentary WALL.

title: Walls
description: In Budapest, the lives of neighbors Mr. Istvan and Ms. Magdi unfold through the walls of their building. Discover their passions and routines in "A Day in Budapest."

title: Wally Got Wasted
description: 3 friends kill a guy, fail to dispose of the body, and must fake his survival while being chased across LA in a wild night.

title: Walnut Tree
description: Qader, a bricklayer from Sardasht in western Iran whose wife is pregnant with her 4th child, suddenly found himself amid a war crime perpetrated by the Saddam regime. On June 28th, 1987 Iraqi air fighters dropped mustard gas bombs on the city.

title: Wampler's Ascent
description: All people face challenges throughout their life and this is an unprecedented look at one man's journey of terror and sheer will to overcome all odds as he tries to conquer one of the biggest human feats ever attempted.

title: Wan Pipel
description: Roy is a handsome Surinam man, who studies in Amsterdam. He hurriedly left his Dutch girlfriend Karina to visit his dying mom in Paramaribo. Back in his homeland, Roy soon becomes obsessed with his own country and its culture. When he falls for the Hindu nurse Rubia, the conservative Hindu and Black communities are in revolt. One day Karina arrives in Surinam too.

title: Wanderer
description: An overworked accountant struggles to balance his work and home life. While on a weekend getaway with his wife, he wanders away from camp and becomes lost in the woods. His journey begins as he struggles to survive - hoping to be found.

title: War Cake
description: Judith, a small-town senior on the verge of graduation, struggles against the pressure of her strict religious upbringing and is pushed to extreme lengths when a terrible event brings her entire world crashing down.

title: War for the Woods
description: Thirty years after historic logging protests on Vancouver Island, the battle to protect old growth forests is still raging.

title: War in Academia
description: When a class of Master's degree art students are given an unfair assignment by their self-absorbed professors, conflict in inevitable. This film questions authority and authorship while highlighting artist's working conditions. Based on real events.

title: War in the USA
description: Franklin D. Roosevelt's rise from Depression-era president to WWII commander-in-chief transformed America. His leadership guided the nation through economic crisis and global conflict, establishing the US as a world power.

title: War Journal: The Incredible World War II Escape of Major Damon “Rocky” Gause
description: War Journal: The Incredible World War II Escape of Major Damon "Rocky" Gause tells the true story of one of the most impossible escapes in World War II. American airman Damon Gause escaped a prison camp on the Bataan Peninsula in 1942, swam to nearby Corregidor Island, and then sailed with serviceman William Lloyd Osborne in a leaky 20-foot fishing boat from the Philippines to Australia.

title: War of the Ninja Monsters: Jaron vs Goura
description: The ninja monsters Jaron and Goura appear in the city of Chichibu, and rival ninja clans manipulate the ninja beasts into a fierce battle.

title: Warboy
description: Fall of 1944. World War 2 is closing to an end. Nicu, a teenager, embarks on a journey through the wilderness of the Apuseni Mountains, trying to save the horses of his family.

title: Warlord
description: Revolt brews in ancient Lloris as a merciless Sheriff and Brute oppress citizens. A young human seeks elves' mystical aid to free the people, but secrets and hidden motives threaten an alliance that could doom all.

title: Warren Miller's Future Retro
description: Warren Miller's 71st feature film will stream across North America this November via regionalized events. Boulder, Colo. - October 8, 2020 - In the first-ever digital release of a full-length Warren Miller feature film, Warren Miller Entertainment (WME) is excited to bring its audience the digital release of the brand's 71st film, Future Retro. In Future Retro, progressive, young female skiers Lexi duPont and Amie Engerbretson journey to the heart of deep-rooted ski culture in Switzerland, and f

title: Warrioress
description: In a post-apocalyptic world, two fierce female warriors embark on a quest to battle in a ritual duel and fulfill an ancient prophecy. Journey with them!

title: Wasp
description: Olivier and James' romantic break in the South of France is interrupted by the sudden arrival of Caroline. Friendships are questioned; sexuality tested.

title: Waste: The Nuclear Nightmare
description: Explore the complexities of nuclear waste in "Waste of Power." Join the enlightening documentary as it delves into the science, politics, and dangers surrounding this global issue.

title: Wasteland
description: Wasteland is set in a world ravaged by a deadly virus and within that world is Scott Miller, a man who, against the odds, is trying to carve out some sort of life. The deadly infection that has ravaged the globe has almost totally wiped out the human race and Scott must spend his days finding water, food etc. Whilst trying to find uninfected people by radio, he must also avoid the many dangers that lurk in the outside world, while he waits for the return of the love of his life, Beth.

title: Wastelands
description: Alice is lonely and self-isolated; her reverent and compulsive behavior keeps the door shut to her demons. Then, one day, her father is thrust back into her life. Wilhelm is suffering from a terminal illness and is entirely dependent on his daughter.

title: Watch Out for the Automobile
description: A very good cop tries to catch a very insidious and extremely clever serial car thief. The bitter irony is that the thief is not very clever, absolutely not insidious, and moreover - a virtuous person and his friend.

title: Watching Amber
description: After the death of Amber's boyfriend Paul, she's determined to move on and continue with her new love, Chad. She tries to put her past behind her but is stalked by a mental neighbor who is determined to eliminate all competition.

title: Watching the Detectives
description: A film noir fanatic's life is upended when a quirky femme fatale leads him on a wild adventure. Love can be stranger than fiction in this captivating tale.

title: Watching This Movie Is a Crime
description: Amir is a young member of Basidj and his father is a martyr of war. But when Amir's pregnant wife is being beaten by a stranger in the street and loses her child he decides to take action.

title: Water for Life
description: Water For Life follows three Latin American Indigenous community leaders as they face death threats and murder to save their precious water resources from mining, industrial agriculture, and hydroelectric projects.

title: Water Is Not Enough
description: Water Is Not Enough (W.I.N.E.) explores the meaning of conditional family love and the all-out drive to become successful at any cost. Camille is an aspiring vocalist well on her way to fame and fortune. However, a devastating tragedy serves as the catalyst to reveal a family secret she has been hiding. This film shows that denial and living an un-truth can ruin the best of families and careers.

title: Waves 98
description: Omar, disillusioned with suburban life in segregated Beirut, is drawn into the city's depths. He loses himself in a disconnected world, battling to hold onto his attachments and sense of home.

title: Wavy
description: Two couples' beach day turns sour when a threesome confession sparks a storm of emotions and secrets. Unfortunately for all involved...the secrets become deadly.

title: Way Out Ahead of Us
description: A father keeps his terminal illness a secret from his daughter so he doesn't spoil her plans to move to the city. The man who plays the father has this illness in real life. He and his wife, who plays the mother, have been married for 25 years and have raised each other's kids from previous relationships together, but have never had a child of their own - so in the film we cast an actress to play the daughter they never had, but always dreamed of.

title: Wayward
description: In "Wayward," a 14-year-old girl navigates life at a mechanic's shop and with friends, pushing boundaries in search of identity. Consequences lead her to confront unexpected truths.

title: We Are All Human
description: A collection of short films that evolve around human rights and hope to raise awareness to make the world a better place.

title: We Are Boats
description: Lives intertwine and connect when Francesca navigates through the living world by encountering strangers at the exact moment she needs to.

title: We Are Not Content!
description: Kiseki moves to NYC, though he can barely pay rent. Luckily, he meets Clara, who helps him make a movie. As they continue, they realize that their goals do not match, and the artistic ideals that Kiseki has clung to may not be sustainable.

title: We Are Not Princesses
description: The heroic spirit of ancient Greek Antigone inspires four Syrian women residing in Beirut's refugee camps, igniting their own inner strength.

title: We Are Only Meat
description: A regular day for Bans and Uzu, little did they know a series of events would bring them face to face with an alternate reality and their chance to confront Dixon, a disturbed psychopath with blood on his hands and demons in his mind.

title: We are the Bulls
description: Follow the tale of five boys turned outlaws in their neighborhood, armed only with a BB gun.

title: We Don't Deserve Dogs
description: Embark on a reflective journey across our planet, exploring the profound impact of dogs on our daily lives, both ordinary and extraordinary.

title: We Go On: Remastered
description: Miles Grissom (Clark Freeman) offers cash to the first person who can show him a ghost, an angel, a demon - anything to prove that we go on after our deaths. He narrows responses down to three candidates - a scientist, a medium, and a worldly entrepreneur. And along with his fiercely protective mother (Annette O'Toole), he embarks on an adventure that will spiral into an unthinkable nightmare.

title: We Have Everywhere to Go
description: An embittered intellectual's drug heist scheme is disrupted by his ambitious nephew's London audition. A clash of dreams unfolds.

title: We Live
description: Differing opinions about the events of a George Floyd protest gone bad cause tensions to rise in a Black household.

title: We Live in Public
description: Delve into the captivating life of dot-com entrepreneur Josh Harris. This documentary explores his thrilling exploits of the past decade.

title: We Were Children
description: For 130 years, 100,000+ First Nations children attended Christian-run 'residential schools' in Canada, enduring brutality and cultural erasure. 'We Were Children' unveils the shocking true story of Glen Anaquod and Lyna Hart.

title: We Were Famous, You Don't Remember: The Embarrassment
description: Ignited by punk's invasion of the Great Plains, America's gawkiest and greatest lost rock band (The Embarrassment) battles conformity in Reagan-era Kansas. Their independence and refusal to sell out sparked tension within the group and kept mainstream success at bay. This documentary shows how the Embarrassment rose out of nowhere to become a post-punk legend that's almost been forgotten.

title: Weber's Grill
description: Join Justin Weber, a writer, entrepreneur, and cooking hobbyist, as he strives to recreate restaurant-quality dishes in this captivating cooking series.

title: Wedding Swingers
description: Alan's destination wedding in Palm Springs brings together college friends Kevin, Gabrielle, Amber, Ian, Mitch, Steven, and Laura with her French husband Jose. The reunion challenges Alan's upcoming marriage.

title: Weekly Horoscopes: The Rose Burnett Show
description: In this Entertaining Weekly Series, Psychic Medium Rose Burnett explores Relationships, Money, Career and General Energies for All Star Signs. With a mix of astrology, mindset coaching and straight talking Aussie humor, Rose helps viewers explore where they may feel stuck in life to grow and transform.

title: Weirdo: The Story of Five Eight
description: After being institutionalized for schizophrenia and manic-depression in his early 20s, Mike Mantione turned to songwriting as a way of dealing with his demons. For 30 years, loud guitars have kept those demons at bay.

title: Welcome Home
description: Returning home, three thirty-somethings face the realities of life as they discover the changes that have occurred since they last left.

title: Welcome to My Side
description: Chen Xiaozhou encountered an accident after his breakup, and since then, he has often seen a large group of rubber ducks quacking, which has brought a huge obstacle to Chen Xiaozhou's life. Until the appearance of a girl named Feng Jianan.

title: Welcome to the Darkness
description: In 2003, British glam rockers The Darkness took the world by storm with their hit single "I Believe In A Thing Called Love". Then at the height of their fame, the band split up and fell into obscurity. 20 years on, they tell their story.

title: Welcome to the Men's Group
description: A men's support group descends into chaos when longstanding conflicts threaten the trust among the men.

title: Werewolf
description: Blaise and Nessa are outcast methadone users in their small town. Each day they push a rusty lawnmower door-to-door begging to cut grass. Nessa plots an escape, while Blaise lingers closer to collapse. Tethered to one another, their getaway dreams are kept on a suffocatingly short leash.

title: West Point
description: West Point is an intimate thriller in Super8, a story of family and emigration. It is the Cabo da Rocha in Portugal, the westernmost point of the European continent. It is a metaphor of Ellis Island, of street dancing and the part of oblivion that Alexandre and his sister Jeanne must accept to get rid of an original crime, a feeling of abandonment and the color of wheat.

title: Wetlands
description: Two boyhood chums, separated soon after sexually awakening together, re-meet as young men with unspoken sexual tensions lying between them.

title: What Brings Us Together
description: A New Jersey family struggles to reconnect while dealing with unresolved issues, opportunities lost, and the death of a loved one.

title: What Goes Around Comes Around
description: Friends on a weekend trip find a menacing warning: "What goes around comes around." With no phone service and rising tensions, buried secrets emerge as they fight to survive. Is it a prank or revenge?

title: What It Was California Coast
description: Take a scenic and eclectic road trip along the California Coast. Spectacular views, historical information, and amusing stories.

title: What Love Looks Like
description: Experience the intertwining journeys of love in this heartfelt film as five stories unfold. Watch for free and stream online.

title: What Love Looks Like
description: Five interwoven love stories explore the ups and downs of finding love.

title: What Mama Want
description: Patrick got married to his mother's employee, Bernice, because that was what she wanted, but he had another woman he loved. After the death of Patrick's mum, Patrick sent Bernice out of the house but didn't know she was carrying his child, while the woman Patrick thought loved him turned out to be a prostitute.

title: What Other Couples Do
description: During a dinner party, four married couples from Los Angeles engage in a playful game of 'Seven Minutes in Heaven,' igniting an evening of kisses and excitement.

title: What We Don't Say
description: Ben, an aspiring cartoonist is closed off from a recent breakup. While lost in self doubt he meets vivacious and free spirited Juliette. They have an instant connection but she also has plans to move away soon. Regardless, the two decide to spend time together while they can. As their love for each other grows, their time together dwindles and they have to face that love may not be enough for her to stay.

title: What We've Become
description: When her mother suffers a heart attack, successful New York writer Stephanie Golden sets aside her job and fiancé to return to her hometown in Kansas. There she finds a family in turmoil and her younger sister Monica sinking into the dark world of drug addiction.

title: What's Going on with Wolves?
description: This documentary, which includes excerpts from sixteen interviews with people who devote a significant portion of their working life, if not all of it, to wolves, enables viewers to understand an issue that goes basically unreported in day-to-day journalism. It is as much about human interactions in relationship to wolves as it is about wolves themselves.

title: Whelp
description: Following a family of French Bulldog breeders in upstate New York, Whelp gives an intimate look into the breeding process against the polarized global debate surrounding this increasingly sought-after breed and the people who breed them.

title: When a Farm Goes Aflame
description: A filmmaker discovers that his father has a second family, kept secret for decades.

title: When A Tree Falls
description: Intrigued by a mystical Forest Goddess, a diligent Lumberjack is cautioned to refrain from disturbing her sacred woodland domain.

title: When Bette Met Mae
description: Bette Davis and Mae West come alive to discuss their careers. Using an audio tape made that night and actors to portray them, you are a guest at a party that no one knew about until now. Watch and laugh.

title: When Black Birds Fly
description: Heaven is a beautiful, clean suburban paradise. Every block is populated by lush trees and lovely row homes. People are free to roam and do whatever they please, as long as they follow one simple rule: DO NOT communicate with "The Evil One" that dwells on the other side of a giant wall that circles the town, which is under 24 hour surveillance by a team of soldiers wearing gas masks. The ruler of the town is a man named Caine, who plasters images of himself all around town, insisting that his ci

title: When Buying a Fine Murder
description: What if a killer is hired to kill himself?

title: When Cats Fly
description: Skateboarding kids unite to rescue a cat shelter by creating viral videos of the felines. 11-year-old Rennie leads the charge, with the mission to find homes for adult cats. Challenges arise as they race against the clock.

title: When Everything's Gone
description: Post-apocalyptic survivor Rory, grieving lost brother, journeys through wasteland. Meets Casper and daughter Rosie. Group searches for other survivors after devastating plague, finding hope to begin anew.

title: When I Walk
description: When I Walk is one man's emotional and inspiring journey during six years of life following his multiple sclerosis diagnosis. For Jason DaSilva, life's most challenging and joyous moments are yet to come.

title: When It Strikes Three
description: The oppression of organized crime and the blind eyes of the government, raging for years leaving people without hope. Pedro Ignacio and members of self-defense, are responsible for retaining the governor's daughter as a last measure to be heard.

title: When Jeff Tried to Save the World
description: When the manager of an old-school bowling alley discovers the owner's plans to sell, saving Winky's World means pulling himself out of the gutter, too.

title: When Love Prevails
description: A story of a couple that happens to fall in Love with one another hoping it will lead to marriage...Everything was going great then, drama unfolds. Will their Love for one another be strong enough to help them overcome and Prevail at the end.

title: When the Day Breaks
description: A rooster's breakfast, a pig's need for milk, and a chance encounter with a lemon transform their lives. Explore the unexpected in this captivating tale.

title: When the Moon Was Full
description: Love leads Abdolhamid and Faezeh to danger as they encounter his family's illegal activities and his terrorist brother in Pakistan.

title: Where are you going, Habibi?
description: Ibrahim falls in love with Alexander, a blond, blue eyed German criminal and show wrestler who is straight - an impossible friendship that surpasses the both of them.

title: Where Cars Don't Dare
description: Rediscover the gold rush trail in Mojave Desert on a thrilling dirt bike tour. 3 days, 460 miles, no roads. Unleash your adventure!

title: Where Hearts Lie
description: A young Brooklyn based real estate mogul in the making unwittingly gambles his success, sanity, and the safety of his young child, when he falls for the wrong woman

title: Where Love Found Me
description: A Hollywood director's world is turned upside down when he encounters a group of street kids living in the slums, leading to daring escapes, hilarious stunts, and unexpected danger.

title: Where There Once Was Water
description: A song for the sacred in all of us. An invitation to change our perspective, rewrite the story, and heal our relationship with water - one watershed, one meal, one raindrop, at a time.

title: Where's Dennis
description: With a sense of urgency, a man rushes to deliver a package to someone named Dennis.

title: Whispering
description: Anna is fed up with the flatness of the city and decides to take a journey back in time. She convinces two of her colleagues to go with her to the place where she used to spend every summer since she was a child: Sibari Lakes. On this occasion, she’ll meet a girl who seems to be hiding something and together they’ll push their own boundaries.

title: White Days
description: A family during the quarantine: the wife desperately and helplessly wants to be mother; her brother, a mentally ill man, lives in a never ending football dream. Franco seems to be the only one who still remains tied to the reality.

title: White Fire
description: The story of a young man's battle with bone cancer and his family's fight to carry him through.

title: White Guard: Aconcagua
description: The film is a documentary of a small Slovak expedition to the highest mountain of the southern and western hemisphere - Aconcagua 6962m in Argentina.

title: White Planet
description: Our South Pole: A groundbreaking documentary on the disabled conquering the South Pole, following Shackleton's path. A testament to the limitless abilities of the handicapped.

title: White Rabbit
description: A bullied high school student starts having visions of a rabbit that he killed when he was a kid, soon putting him in a state where his imagination threatens to cause him to carry out violent acts.

title: White Summer on Denali
description: The film is a documentary from an expedition to the highest mountain in North America, which took place in June 2008. A three-member team from Slovakia is trying in Alaska to climb the northernmost 6,000 peak in the world DENALI (Mt.McKinley) 6194m. The film won 1st place at CAMERA SLOVAKIA 2009, the Literary Fund Award for the best Slovak film at the Mountains and City Festival (Bratislava, Aupark, April 2009) and 3rd prize at the Horalfest Festival (Tatranská Lomnica, November 2009).

title: White Wall
description: In a post-apocalyptic wasteland surrounded by a towering white wall, the lone survivor of a cruel child internment camp reluctantly accepts a final bounty hunting assignment to safeguard his hard-earned peaceful existence.

title: Who Died?
description: A romantic comedy set in the most unlikely place- the oncology ward. Eran, newly diagnosed and downhearted, meets Michal, a vivacious long-term survivor. Their unexpected connection sparks a rollercoaster of love, laughter and fear, as they navigate life, illness, and joy together. Inspired by creator Eyal Eltawil's own story.

title: Who Farted
description: Are farts malevolent? Disgusting? Beneficial? Hilarious? What exactly is a fart? And how much does animal flatulence truly contribute to runaway climate change?

title: Who Is She?
description: Tech-obsessed Faye impresses classmate Jaye with AI facial replacement. Their prank reshapes their campus lives, bringing joy amidst technology fixation.

title: Who Killed Lawrence of Arabia?
description: Documentary investigating the crash on 13th May 1935 which resulted in the death of T.E. Lawrence (Lawrence of Arabia) six days later.

title: Who Killed the Neanderthal?
description: Uncover Neanderthal secrets in "The Neanderthal Enigma." Join the ambitious team as they investigate genocide, epidemics, climate change, and more.

title: Who Owns the Sky
description: Using an intersectional approach, the film combines the questioning of the binary concept of gender with questions about the connection between the cis-hetero norm, colonialism and capitalism. Interviews with activists in Argentina and Switzerland are embedded in performances and actions of the art-activist project "die grosse um_ordnung" (the big re_ordering), which place the body as a political instrument at the center of the debate.

title: Who's Annie
description: After jail-tme, 12-step programs and five marriages, Annie begins her acting career in her mid-fifties with the help of a young director she meets at a Burger King in Queens. fiies with the help of a young director she met at a Burger King in Queens.

title: Who's Ascot Eaton?
description: In The Sayrie Experience, comedian Sayrie masterfully blends music, vibrant visuals, and heartfelt storytelling to create an immersive performance. With humor and honesty, she delves into the intricacies of her life, family and sexuality.

title: Who's Watching
description: In a quiet coastal town, Annabelle Pyke lives her life unaware of the dark presence looming over her. Unbeknownst to her, a shadowy has been watching her every move. His obsession with her grows more dangerous by the day.

title: Why We Fight
description: Three fighters from three different disciplines explain why they fight.

title: Wicked Widow
description: The beautiful wife of a powerful drug lord starts a relationship with another man. Tired of the jealousy of her husband, she and her lover plan to murder him.

title: Wien for life
description: In this offbeat crime comedy, an unlikely friendship crumbles over a winning lottery ticket scratched at a border petrol station. Plus, discover the truth about wrong-way drivers.

title: Wigilia
description: A traditional Polish feast on Christmas Eve, Wigilia includes an extra place at the table should an unknown wandering pilgrim arrive.

title: Wild
description: An anarchist young woman breaks the tacit contract with civilization and fearlessly decides on a life without hypocrisy or an obligatory safety net.

title: Wild Honey
description: WILD HONEY is an offbeat romantic comedy about a lonely, down-on-her-luck phone sex operator who falls for one of her callers, and flies across the country to find him.

title: Wild Justice
description: An ex-military man Daniel Wilson and his wife Lisa share a life which seems perfect in an environment of family people and cozy surrounding of trees and greenery. When they head to a local pub for a drink, the barmaid is raped by a gang member Frankie Harris. Wilson intervenes, beats up the thug Harris and throws him out of the place much to the pleasure of the other patrons. Later, the thug brings his gang and they beat up Daniel in a park. Daniel and Lisa comfort each other in their home unkno

title: Wilderness to Table with Chef Bri
description: Join Chef Bri on Wilderness to Table, the ultimate cooking show for hunters and fishermen. Experience thrilling hunts and learn to recreate delicious dishes in every episode. Stream for free online!

title: Wildflowers
description: Mountain writer and historian Meghan J. Ward recruits a team of creative women to revisit Mary Schäffer Warren's 1908 expedition to Maligne Lake, in Alberta's Jasper National Park.

title: Wildlike
description: After conditions in her new home become unbearable, a teenage girl runs away and befriends an older man preparing for a hike through the Alaskan wilderness.

title: Will & Liz
description: A love story between a frustrated artist and a free spirited girl, set in colorful Venice Beach, Ca - told in four seasons.

title: Will Sampson
description: In the bustling city of London, hapless twenty-something Will Sampson embarks on a quest for true love, aided by his loyal best friend Niall.

title: Will There Be Meetings in Rastoul?
description: Wandering through the mechanisms of peasantry in the Cantal region, this film attempts to create a free space where the filmmaker and the peasant women engage in some kind of collaboration; the daily work of cheesemaking, the temporary labour of filmmaking and the love for both tend to form a poetic triangular relationship.

title: William, the New Judo Master
description: William, the New Judo Master portrays the universe of an eternal being that exists within a life cycle filled with disappointments and hopelessness. It's the chronicle about the search for love and the fight against oblivion.

title: Window Horses: The Poetic Persian Epiphany of Rosie Ming
description: A Canadian poet with Chinese and Persian roots embarks on a journey to Iran, where they showcase their talent at a captivating poetry festival.

title: WiseGirls
description: A new waitress in NYC gets caught in a mob-run underworld of drugs and murder while working at an Italian restaurant.

title: Wished
description: A man's many wishes come true, only to realize what he's wanted the most has been in front of him all along.

title: Witchmas
description: When Selma the Wicked Witch enlists an arrogant little elf named Grumper and his pet dragon Grus to transform Christmas into a whole new holiday known the world over as Witchmas, it sparks mayhem on the eve of the big day. Enter the ever-vigilant ELF Detective Agency - Jingle, Bingle, Tingle, Dorabelle and Cheer - to save the day in Witchmas.

title: With Love from Suffolk
description: The story focuses on multiple characters living in Suffolk as they navigate relationships, experiencing comedy, drama and romance. Through interconnected stories it explores love and human connection.

title: With Spirit
description: Using her feet to move through the grief in her heart, Chelsey Magness and Team BendRacing/Yogaslackers take on one of the wildest and hardest races in the world - the Patagonian Expedition Race.

title: Withdrawn
description: Short on funds, a guy hatches a plot to scam the owner of a lost credit card.

title: Wither
description: Ida and Albin are a happy couple. They set off to a cabin in the vast Swedish woodlands to have a fun holiday with their friends. But under the floorboards waits an evil from Sweden's dark past.

title: Without a Body
description: After moving into a run-down farmhouse with his two daughters, a skeptical author seeks to uncover a sinister past that haunts the house and terrorizes his family.

title: Without a Scalpel

title: Adventure Ocean Quest - Special
description: Adventure Ocean Quest: the documentary is showing stunning wildlife- and nature images exciting adventures and fascinating encounters between humans and marine life: A 90-minute dive adventure, developed by the Wiesbaden located film production company Sound & Vision together with the renowned French underwater filmmaker Christian Petron. Unlike previous underwater documentaries this expedition opens a new gateway to "the realm of depth": The famous underwater cameraman Christian Petron accompanies the former world champion in freediving, Frederic Buyle, with its exciting diving without breathing apparatus. Freedivers are "water people" who move silently and elegantly underwater. Frederic Buyle emerges without air tanks to depths of over 50 meters and stays there for several minutes. He uses his impressive skills to the "soft inquiry" of marine animals and their behavior. His ability allows him to approach the inhabitants of the ocean, without disturbing it - unlike normal divers whose diving equipment causing loud breathing noises and clouds of bubbles. The team also waived the usual "bait" or lures to observe only realistic and lifelike behavior of animals. In his dives Frederic receives exclusive recordings from the natural behavior of wild animals. In his collaboration with scientists creating new reliable portraits of many already known species. Christian Petron documented with masterful and extraordinary images marked by respect and honor these encounters between humans and marine life.

title: Animals that Changed History
description: Animals That Changed History is a six part documentary series that details the contributions of animals to human development throughout history. The themed episodes focus on food, shelter, beasts of burden, companions, plagues, and muses. When it comes to food, there was a time when humans stopped hunting it – and started growing it. We have since built complex food economies based on farming. Since the domestication of animals, we have bred them not just for their meat, but for their byproducts; fish, poultry, milk, honey – all staples around the world, and the domestication of animals for food has made our world what it is today. For most of our history, we’ve taken our shelter and warmth from the natural world in order to survive. Over time, what was once a necessity became a status symbol – from fur coats, to leather jackets. History has been shaped by the way we’ve used animals to stay warm and comfortable – so much so, that wars have been fought over it. From mouflon to alpaca hair, as we continue to use up these natural resources, we have begun to explore the use of synthetic materials. As we continue to do so, perhaps a time may come when we no longer use animals to keep us warm and sheltered. Throughout history, humans have also needed some extra muscle to get work done. From growing food, to heavy lifting, to transportation – before modern machinery, we relied on ‘beasts of burden’. Now, those days are largely behind us – but we wouldn’t be where we are today without the help of animals like oxen, horses, and camels.

description: Who still believes in the end of the world? These days, apocalypse announcers are no longer taken seriously. Yet, we have good reason to worry. How will we survive in a world that is overpopulated, overexploited and out of kilter?

title: Awake
description: While undergoing surgery, a wealthy young man experiences intraoperative awareness and discovers that the surgical team intended to murder him.

title: Awoken
description: A medical student attempts to cure her brother from a terminal sleep illness, but a more sinister reason for his condition is revealed.

title: Ax Men
description: Ax Men profiles rough-and-ready river logging crews from the mountains of the Pacific Northwest to the waters of the Deep South.

title: Baboon Bandits - Monkey Alert in South Africa
description: They steal handbags or open cars: the last baboons of the Table Mountain. A „Baboon Police“ follows the marauding animals, trying to chase the monkeys away. Is there still a chance for humans and baboons to live in peaceful neighbourhood?

title: Baby Animals and Friends
description: We look at a broad range of totally cute wild baby animals and show how they live their lives through the seasons. Joining them will also be some creatures who are forced to deal with extremes of hot and cold all year-round, in varied locations

title: Baby Animals Around the World
description: Baby Animals Around the World is a humorous narration driven series based on a day in the life of a broad range of extremely cute baby animals from a wide variety of natural, domestic and cultural environments around the world.

title: Baby Animals In Our World 2
description: In this second series we take a broad range of baby animals and showcase them in our homes, our zoos, our farms, our stations - in our world. We follow them in these familiar environments and highlight their behaviors and milestones.

title: Baby Animals In The Wild
description: We look at a broad range of totally cute, wild baby animals and show how they live their lives through the seasons. We also highlight milestones such as birth, grooming, playing, napping, exploring and learning with mum or dad.

title: Back Country Rescue
description: Bone-crushing avalanches taking down skiers. Wild grizzly bears mauling hikers. Kayakers pinned under boulders in rushing rivers. None of these people are getting out alive without the help of a fearless team of men and women, ready to deploy to save them

title: Back in the Day
description: Unsatisfied with his career as the face of a national ad campaign, Jim Owens heads back home to Indiana for his high school reunion.

title: Back to Nature
description: Eric Ruivo is on a mission to re-introduce endangered species into the wild. We follow him to China, Argentina and Gabon where he releases Pandas, Condors and Gorillas. And for the first time he will set free 2 zoo-born Langurs into the wildness of Java.

title: Backroad Bounty
description: Marty and Bam Bam search for hidden treasures, revealing unique back-stories about the items they uncover and the value they hold.

title: Backtrack
description: Psychologist Peter Bower's life is thrown into turmoil when he discovers that the patients he has been seeing are the ghosts of people who died twenty years ago.

title: Bad Impulse
description: In the aftermath of a traumatic event, a suburban husband and father buys a cutting edge home security system, only to find that it slowly destroys that which he most wants to protect.

title: Bad Match
description: Harris seems to have it all - a great job, plenty of friends and an active sex life. But that all changes when he meets Riley on a dating app. Riley seems a little clingy but he’s about to find out the truth is something far more sinister.

title: Bad Trip
description: If there is one thing we all look forward to, it's our next relaxing vacation. But what happens your trip goes horribly wrong?

title: Baking Mad
description: Master Patissier Eric Lanlard, explores the appetising world of baking. We follow Eric as he shows us his hot tips and easy to follow recipes, meets “baking club” enthusiasts and holds daily bake offs to find some home grown baking talent.

title: Ballad of Death Valley
description: An 'angel-faced' gunfighter is tasked with infiltrating a ranch overrun by Mexican bandits and saving their hostages, including the fiancée of the local sheriff.

title: Banana Joe
description: A man is living happily on an island with his family, growing bananas. When a local mobster with an eye on man's property tries to take it from him, he must go to the town for the first time to get some help.

title: Band of Bears - In the Forests of Scandinavia
description: The film takes us on a journey of discovery in Scandinavia's wild forests. Together with three brown bear cubs, we visit the home of mighty moose and smart wolves, rare forest reindeer and flying squirrels. An exceptional nature film for the whole family.

title: Bandidas
description: In turn-of-the-century Mexico, two very different women become a bank-robbing duo in an effort to combat a ruthless enforcer terrorizing their town.

title: Bandits
description: The suave Joe and his hypochondriac partner Terry have escaped from prison. Cutting a swath from Oregon through California, these fugitives rob banks in order to finance their scheme for a new life south of the Border.

title: Bang Goes The Theory
description: Cutting-edge developments in technology and scientific principles help shape the world.

title: Barbershop
description: Calvin, who inherited a struggling barbershop, views the shop as nothing but a burden and waste of his time. After selling the shop to a local loan shark, Calvin slowly begins to see his father's vision and legacy .

title: Barbershop 2: Back in Business (2004)
description: The Barbershop is threatened by the arrival of a hip, well-financed chain barbershop that's about to open next door.

title: Barbershop: The Next Cut
description: It's been more than 10 years since our last appointment at Calvin's Barbershop. Ice Cube, Cedric the Entertainer and the whole crew are back together for a quick trim, some good conversation, a little gossip...and to save their neighborhood!

title: Barely Lethal
description: While on a mission, Megan Walsh, an assassin, gets intrigued with the lives of the other teenagers who are her age. She decides to fake her own death and enroll herself in a school. Starring: Jessica Alba, Samuel L. Jackson, Sophie Turner, Jaime King

title: Barking Dogs Never Bite
description: In Bong Joon-ho's directorial debut, a couple is driven to distraction by a yapping dog located in their apartment complex. Determined to relieve their annoyance, they take extreme action against his tormentor.

title: Baroness Von Sketch Show
description: The all-female comedy series is created by and stars veteran Canadian actor Meredith MacNeill and Second City alumni Carolyn Taylor, Aurora Browne and Jennifer Whalen, who satirize modern life's everyday concerns.

title: Barter Kings
description: Barter Kings follows Steve McHugh and Antonio Palazzola, two of the best barterers in the business, as they level up low-value items into big-ticket wins in the thriving subculture of cashless trading.

title: Basil
description: A lonely young aristocrat in turn-of-the-century England struggles to gain the approval of his over-bearing, class-conscious father.  Tension rises when he falls in love with a woman whom his father will never accept. Starring: Jared Leto

title: Battle Beyond The Stars
description: A young farmer sets out to recruit mercenaries to defend his peaceful planet, which is under threat of invasion by the evil tyrant Sador and his armada of aggressors. Starring: George Peppard, Robert Vaughn, Richard Thomas
category: May the Farce Be With You

title: Battle Beyond the Sun
description: Two countries race to have the first successful landing on Mars.
category: May the Farce Be With You

title: Battle for the Bulge
description: The Battle for the Bulge was the last major German offensive move on the Western Front during the Second World War.

title: Battle of Britain
description: To commemorate the 70th Anniversary of the Battle of Britain Ewan and Colin McGregor take to the skies to discover how; against the odds, the RAF inflicted Hitler's first defeat of WW2.

title: Battle of Britain - Empty Skies
description: Tells the story of 19 men and women who were there. Through a series of filmed interviews their stories have been preserved, allowing them to tell the part they played in the nation's defence in their own words creating a unique collection of accounts.

title: Battle of Britain: The Race For Radar
description: On the brink of war the Germans mount a daring Zeppelin spy mission. Had the Luftwaffe spies discovered Britain’s greatest secret?'

title: Battle of Los Angeles (2011)
description: In February 1942 US forces engaged an unidentified flying object above Los Angeles. Now almost 70 years later, the alien invaders have returned.

title: BATTLEFRONT: WWII ROAD TO VICTORY
description: The fiercest battles of WWII come to life in this documentary series that takes you behind enemy lines and to the front lines of the campaigns of the Atlantic, Mediterranean and Pacific theaters where the soldiers, sailors and airmen fought.

title: Battling for Baby
description: After Katherine (Courteney Cox) decides to return to work to help pay the bills, her baby's grandmothers (Debbie Reynolds & Suzanne Pleshette) argue over who will take care of her child.

title: Bavarian Forest - Deep, Dark and Enchanted
description: After a bark beetle invasion in the Bavarian Forest, thousands hectares of old spruce forest were destroyed. But then, a new, healthier forest started to grow. Nature has come to life again without man’s guidance, as it has done for millions of years.

title: Be Cool
description: John Travolta is back as Chili Palmer in this sequel to "Be Cool." With an all-star cast that includes Uma Thurman and The Rock, "Be Cool" is the hilarious tale about a gangster-turned-music-mogul...and what it takes to be number one with a bullet!

title: Beak & Brain - Genius Birds from Down Under
description: These child prodigies of the animal kingdom have feathers and beaks – and very special skills! The Keas in New Zealand and the New Caledonian Crows – who will win the ultimate avian I.Q. test?

title: Beary Tales
description: Two orphaned bear cubs would’ve been destined to starve – if a man had not adopted them. The touching documentary shows the twins’ life with their new "mother", from their first steps to becoming cheeky teenagers.

title: Beast Buddies
description: Would you put your head in a polar bear’s jaws? Would you wrestle with a tiger on the sofa or live with a wolf pack? Welcome to the world of Beast Buddies!

title: Beauty and the Geek Australia
description: Stunning girls and genius guys live together and team up as they compete in hilarious and heart-warming challenges to test their intellect and social skills.

title: Beauty Shop (2005)
description: Gina is a long way from the Barbershop - she's moved from Chicago to Atlanta and buys a rundown salon and inherits a motley group of stylists and a colorful clientele. It's a rocky road to fulfilling her dreams, but you can't keep a good woman down!

title: Bedazzled
description: Elliot Richards is a hapless young man consumed by unrequited love, and desperate to change his life, he makes a deal with the devil who slyly promises to do just that — for a price.

title: Bedlam
description: George is haunted by the demons of his family's past and tortured by the voices inside his head. The doctor's orders; that he attend Bedlam hospital for a guaranteed recovery. Soon, he will discover that all is not as it seems.

title: Bee Season
description: An eleven-year-old girl from a dysfunctional family demonstrates a remarkable, almost mystical, gift for spelling when she wins district spelling bees and qualifies for the nationals.

title: Beer League
description: An unemployed slacker inspires his softball teammates to improve their game so they won't get kicked out of the local league.

title: Behaving Badly
description: Teenager Rick Stevens has a crush on Nina Pennington. They form a friendship and embark on a rock n' roll journey together while Nina deals with her overbearing boyfriend, Kevin. Starring: Nat Wolff, Selena Gomez, Mary-Louise Parker

title: Behind Bars: The World's Toughest Prisons
description: Imagine prisons so tough that even the hardest gang bosses and killers learn the meaning of fear. This series is an intimate portrait of crime and punishment that goes beyond the gates, walls, and cells of the world's toughest maximum security prisons.
category: True Crime to watch in a weekend

title: Behind The Palace Walls
description: An insight into the Royal’s world through interviews with royal watchers, including Andrew Morton and Anthony Holden, exclusive footage from cameraman Mike Lloyd, and film sources from all over the world.

title: Behind You
description: Two young sisters find that all the mirrors in her house are covered or hidden. When one of the sisters happens upon a mirror in the basement, she unknowingly releases a malicious demon that had haunted her mother and aunt years ago.

title: Belgian UFO
description: This episode includes: Belgian UFO, (Pts. 1 & 2), UD: I.D. Swap, Brenda's Fire and Philip Breen & UD.

title: Belle's Christmas Gift
description: Alesha hates Christmas so she reluctantly agrees to visit her Caribbean grandmother to help organize her annual Christmas charity function to save her clinic. When she arrives with her best friend, Alesha meets a handsome Brit, Garrett Graham.

title: Bells of San Angelo
description: A silver mine with a secret entrance along the Mexican border is the setting for this typical Roy Rogers western with music.

title: Ben Elton: Live
description: Era-defining comedian Ben Elton returns to stand up comedy. The 'Godfather' of modern British stand up is back behind the mic bringing his hilarious perspectives on the modern world.

title: Ben-Hur
description: A Jewish prince seeks his family and revenge against his childhood friend who wrongfully imprisoned him.

title: Benji
description: Two school kids strike up a friendship with an orphaned puppy named Benji. When danger befalls them and they end up kidnapped by robbers who are in over their heads, Benji and his scruffy sidekick come to the rescue.

title: Benny & Joon
description: Johnny Depp and Mary Stuart Masterson star in this quirky romantic Drama about two misfits who Comedye together as a result of an unusual poker game. Aidan Quinn and Julianne Moore co-star.

title: Berlin I Love You
description: Keira Knightley, Helen Mirren, Jim Sturgess, and Diego Luna head an all-star cast in this sparkling film.

title: Bernie The Dolphin
description: When Bernie goes missing and the kids go looking for him, they discover a real-estate development plan that threatens the baby sea turtles on their favourite beach. Can the brave duo stop the developers while racing to reunite Bernie with his loved ones?

title: Best Pets of the Month
description: The Pet Collective is home to the top trending clips, most entertaining memes, and funniest animal videos online. Simply put, we think animals are the best ever.

title: Betrayed At 17
description: Widowed mom Michelle is thrilled when her shy teenage daughter Lexi goes out with the high school football star Greg. Greg however has an ulterior motive: to win a bet by sleeping with Lexi on their first date and capturing it all on video…

title: Betty Boop
description: The adventures of the famous Betty Boop, who was described in a 1934 court case as: "combining in appearance the childish with the sophisticated—a large round baby face with big eyes and a nose like a button, framed in a somewhat careful coiffure".

title: Between God, The Devil and a Winchester
description: Between God, the Devil and a Winchester (1968) is a Spaghetti Western where a former gunslinger-turned-priest and a mysterious outlaw join forces on a perilous quest for hidden treasure, facing betrayal, bandits, and their own pasts along the way.

title: Beverly Hills Pawn
description: A look at the high-end world of fine jewelry and Hollywood memorabilia at a Beverly Hills pawn shop.

title: Beyonce: Beyond the Glam
description: Beyoncé is a true global mega star and is synonymous with talent and success. She is a pop sensation, winning over 16 Grammy Awards, a Hollywood actress and a breakout fashion designer.

title: Beyonce: On Top
description: Beyonce Knowles is without a doubt one of the biggest pop stars the world has ever seen. Her powerful female image has inspired millions all around the globe and her lyrics have helped spread the message of solidarity, independence and positivity.

title: Beyonce: Shine
description: The life and future plans of the singer.

title: Beyond Belief: Fact or Fiction
description: This cult anthology series presents stories that appear to defy logic, ghosts, the supernatural and the divine, and offers the viewer a chance to decide what is fact and what is fiction.

title: Beyond Suspicion
description: When a drug bust goes wrong, notorious ex-cop Danny Gallagher's (Karl Urban) quest for justice leads him to the car-bomb murder of a government official's wife. He finds himself under fire when he discovers the woman's secret lover.

title: Beyond The Boundary
description: In this new observational documentary series cricketer Pete Trego will be travelling around the world to meet passionate players and supporters of the game.

title: Beyond the Elements
description: Picking up where he left off in Hunting the Elements, David Pogue sets out on a worldwide quest to find the key molecules and chemical reactions that have paved the way for human civilization, life, and even the universe as we know it.

title: Beyond the Law
description: A former mobster turned businessman and a police detective must contend with a dirty ex-cop looking to bring the killer of his son to justice.

title: Beyond the Reach
description: A high-rolling corporate shark and his impoverished young guide play the most dangerous game during a hunting trip in the Mojave Desert.

title: Beyond White Space
description: The USS Essex is traveling in the furthest reaches of the known Universe when it encounters a gigantic creature. After being pirates steal their cargo and most of their supplies the crew decide to capture the creature.

title: Bible Conspiracies
description: The validity of the Bible has been debated and fought over for centuries. Stolen and adapted by other religions, it has spawned hundreds of sects and cults.

title: Biebrza - The European Amazon
description: Protected by Poland’s biggest national park, the Biebrza Valley is one of the most important nature refuges in Europe. Spectacular wildlife images underline this poetic story about the lives of rare European animals. Is Biebrza the European Amazon river?

title: Big Ang
description: Big Ang gives viewers a glimpse into the life of one of reality TV's most over-the-top and lovable characters.

title: Big Angry Fish
description: Big Angry Fish returns with Milan and Nathan chasing trophy catches across wild coastal waters. With monster hook-ups, big hits, and plenty of laughs, they share fishing techniques and explore breathtaking locations across Australia and New Zealand.

title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
description: World famous gardener and expert horticulturalist Monty Don joins enthusiastic amateur gardeners as they transform their small gardens into kind of the spaces that dreams are made of.

title: Big Easy Motors
description: In "Big Easy Motors," Charles Handler and his team search the bayous of Louisiana for long-forgotten piles of junk they can restore and turn into dazzling custom cars. These treasures can sell for big money, so there's a huge profit to be made.

title: Big Families
description: This series follows the everyday lives and huge family moments in seven of Britain's biggest families. This heart-warming and life affirming series asks the question 'Is bigger better?' and what drives these families to have so many children.

title: Big Jake
description: Big Jake and his sons prepare to meet the kidnapper but have no intention of handing over the ransom.

title: Big Momma's House
description: In order to protect a woman from a robber, a male FBI agent disguises himself as an elderly woman.

title: Big Momma's House 2
description: An FBI agent reprises his disguise as an old lady to become a nanny in a crime suspect's house.

title: Big Mommas: Like Father, Like Son
description: Malcolm Turner and his stepson Trent go undercover at an all-girls performing arts school

title: Bigfoot Encounters
description: Many believe Bigfoot does not exist but for those who have seen the creature face to face, there is no question.

title: Bigfoot Wars
description: A small town becomes the focal point of a brutal clash between man and a legendary beast.

title: Bigger
description: A rags-to-riches biopic of visionary Joe Weider, set in the world of fitness. Brothers Joe & Ben Weider were the architects of muscle.

title: Bigger Stronger Faster
description: When you discover that your heroes have all broken the rules, do you follow the rules, or do you follow your heroes? From the producers of Bowling For Columbine and Fahrenheit 9/11 comes a powerful documentary.

title: Bikini Nuns
description: A fearless trio of nuns is out for revenge. After being wronged by ruthless men, they trade their habits for high-powered weapons, taking justice into their own hands.

title: Bill & Ted's Bogus Journey
description: In this sequel to BILL & TED'S EXCELLENT ADVENTURE, the dimwitted duo travel to Heaven, Hell and points in between as they meet (among others) Albert Einstein, the Easter Bunny and the Grim Reaper.

title: Billable Hours
description: Billable Hours is a half hour dramatic comedy series that follows the office lives of three lawyers, Sam Caponelli, Robin Howland and Clark Claxton III who work for the fictitious Bay Street law firm of Fagan & Harrison.

title: Billi & Theodore
description: When aspiring puppeteer Billi joins her long lost best friend Theodore on a road trip to retrieve the remnants of his broken relationship, fate, mixed with a little bad luck, gives them the opportunity to rekindle what they once had.

title: Bite The Bullet
description: A disparate group of individuals enter a horse race through 700 miles of the Wild West to win a large cash prize. Starring: Gene Hackman, Candice Bergen, James Coburn

title: Bitten
description: In order to end a decades-old vendetta, Elena Michaels leads her family into a vicious war against the Russian Alpha and his Pack, who will stop at nothing to wipe out her bloodline.

title: Bitter Seeds
description: Bitter Seeds explores the future of how we grow things. The worldwide debate focuses on how farming is being drastically transformed by the demands of industrial agriculture.

title: Bizarre E.R. Series
description: The series mixes fly-on-the-wall footage of admissions to a busy A&E department with recollections of the most jaw-dropping cases from recent years, along with weird and wonderful medical facts and accident-related statistics.

title: Black Bear
description: In search of solace at a remote lake house, a filmmaker (Aubrey Plaza) pursues a new work of art through a calculated game of desire and jealousy.

title: Black Beauty
description: A 15 year-old girl who volunteers at a city pound convinces her Grandfather in the country to adopt a horse that was rescued from an abusive owner and they spend the summer rehabilitating 'Black Beauty'.

title: Black Box
description: Marcus is the only survivor of a space accident and he ends up trapped in a damaged escape pod, injured and experiencing memory loss. He contacts ground control, but he'll need to remember what happened if they are to help him make it back alive to Earth.

title: Black Dynamite
description: Black Dynamite is a 2009 American blaxploitation action comedy film starring Michael Jai White, Tommy Davidson, and Salli Richardson. The film was directed by Scott Sanders and co-written by White, Sanders, and Byron Minns, who also co-stars.

title: Black Knight
description: When a wisecracking black hustler from South Central L.A. finds himself transported back to medieval England, he leads the overthrow of an evil king and wins the heart of a proto feminist woman.

title: Black Sabbath
description: The anthology, Black Sabbath tells three short tales of horror. A woman haunted by menacing phone calls from a former lover, a vampire hunter whose family is stalked by the spirit of an ghoul, and a nurse who steals a ring from a cursed corpse.

title: Black Sea Mystery
description: A team of international scientists make ground-breaking discoveries in the Black Sea - a treasure trove of ancient shipwrecks that date back 2500 years to the Greek and Roman empires, and the most complete Roman wreck ever seen.

title: Blackthorn
description: Sam Shepard is Butch Cassidy in this thrilling western about the legendary outlaw's return from exile. After years of quiet, he embarks on his greatest adventure since his glory days with the Sundance Kid.

title: Blacula
description: The eternally cool William Marshall puts a fresh spin on the age-old legend of the vampire, condemned to wander the Earth with an insatiable lust for blood in "Blacula," often credited as the first African-American horror film.

title: Blind
description: Bestselling novelist, Bill Oakland loses his wife and his sight in a vicious car crash. Five years later Socialite Suzanne Dutchman is forced to read to Bill in an intimate room three times a week as a plea bargain for being associated with her husband's business.

title: Blind Ambition
description: Four Zimbabwean men form their country's first Wine Tasting Olympics team.

title: Blind Date
description: Single men and women test their chemistry on memorable first dates.

title: Blitz the Aftermath
description: With interviews and archive footage showing the sheer amount of devastation – from the loss of life to the immense damage caused to buildings across the country - The Aftermath looks at how the Blitz changed the face of Britain's cities and lives.

title: Blood
description: Jess moves her two children back to her childhood home where their lives quickly deteriorate into terror after the family dog bites her son.  Giving him a horrific infection, Jess's morals are tested when the only cure to keep her son alive proves deadly.

title: Blood on the Sun
description: A dedicated American reporter in 1930s Japan is determined to expose that government's plan for world domination.

title: Blood Star
description: A young woman is driving through the desert alone, when she is drawn into a deadly game of cat and mouse with a psychopathic Sheriff.

title: Bloodline Detectives
description: Using witness testimony, new interviews, archive footage and dramatic reconstructions, Bloodline Detectives is a compelling and highly watchable series.

title: Bloodlines
description: In November 1999, Dr Colin Bouwer, the Head of Psychiatry at Otago Hospital, put a murderous plan into action. A perfect crime, until Andrew Bowers, a young consultant physician, stumbled upon the murder in process.

title: Blue Iguana
description: Ex-jailbirds Eddie and Paul are on parole and working in a New York diner. Their lives are a dead end. That is, until English lawyer Katherine Rookwood walks into the diner with an offer they can't refuse. Feat: Sam Rockwell.

title: Blue Murder
description: Detective Sergeant Roger "The Dodger" Rogerson got fame because he knew how to take care of the most dangerous and violent criminals. His success was, however, also due to the sinister alliance with violent underworld figures like Neddy Smith.

title: Blue Shark Hash
description: When a raffle ticket sends two strangers on a spur of the moment weekend to Bermuda, they find falling in love is a little like being lost in The Triangle.

title: Blue Steel
description: U.S. marshal John Carruthers observes a robbery and Sheriff Jake thinks he may be the culprit. Meanwhile the town's leading citizen is planning to rob everybody blind.

title: Blue Whisper
description: "Blue Whisper" immerges into the ocean's fascinating underwater world and gets to the bottom of a widely unexplored field of underwater science: The communication amongst fish. What language do fish use? Do they make sounds or have a body language?

title: Bob and Margaret
description: This charming, witty animated series focuses on the ordinary lives of a middle class dentist and his foot doctor wife. Together, they tackle such traumas as being burgled, going on a package holiday and deciding whether or not having a child will ruin their lives.

title: Bob Marley: Behind The Music
description: Those closest to Bob Marley share his journey, pioneering Reggae music across the globe. He overcame hatred and hardship on his way to immortality. (S1, ep13)

title: Bob Marley: Roots of the Man
description: Robert Nesta Marley, known across the globe as Bob Marley, was the first and debatably only superstar ever to emerge from the third world.

title: Body In The Water
description: Investigations where a victim's body was found in water.

title: Bogus
description: When 7-year-old Albert's mother is suddenly killed in an auto accident, he and his imaginary French friend "Bogus" take up residence with his no-nonsense aunt Harriet.

title: Bolo
description: Two convicts get freed from prison and become lawmen in a corrupt village.

title: Bomber:Terror of WWII
description: In the history of warfare there have been a catalogue of inventions that have changed the way battles are fought. The catapult, the longbow, the cannon, the machine gun.

title: Bonanza Series
description: The adventures of Ben Cartwright and his sons as they run and defend their ranch while helping the surrounding community.

title: Boot Hill
description: A young gunfighter, wounded in a fight, is hidden and cared for by circus performers. The man is pursued by outlaws who want to seize his gold mine. When the bandits discover the gunfighter's hiding place, a long battle begins.

title: Border Invasion USA
description: Embedded crews follow elite law enforcement units as they take down smugglers on the US-Mexico border.

title: Bordertown
description: This Western drama series depicts the adventures of the inhabitants of a town that straddles the Canadian-American border.

title: Borg vs. McEnroe
description: The story of the legendary 1980s tennis rivalry between the placid Björn Borg (Sverrir Gudnason) and the volatile John McEnroe (Shia LaBeouf).

title: Born Naughty?
description: This series takes the audience on a detective trail – is the difficult behaviour of the 8 children featured in the series, the result of parental indulgence or is it in fact due to undiagnosed medical conditions such as ADHD or autism?

title: Born To Fight
description: Daniel Magder features as Matthew, the nerdy new kid in town with a passion for boxing. The school bully, Hector, is the resident boxing champion, dominating all opponents who stand in his way. After witnessing a few run-ins between Matthew and Hector, former pro boxer, now school janitor Dan Barnes (Steve Austin) trains Matthew for the biggest challenge of his life. What follows is a Rocky-esque tale of a young boy who forces everyone to change their preconceived notions of who he is and what he's capable of.

title: Born to Fly
description: We envy birds, watching them enjoy the freedom of a 3 dimensional space. Flight allows them to get to hard to reach places and preform aerial acrobatics in protecting home ranges and searching for food. But it’s not always easy – it takes a lot of effort to graduate air school and there is a new bunch of cadets arriving all hoping to get their wings. Thanks to their flying skills birds can go anywhere, often undertaking huge migrations. The Arctic tern is one bird that can even fly from pole to pole. But birds don’t come out of an egg ready to programmed for the air. Parent birds work tirelessly to nurture and train their young. As they get older the chicks start spreading their wings and experimenting with flight. Before long they can join their parents in the skies. All we can do it watch in awe and wish we could join them.

title: Born To Win
description: A smart-mouthed junkie and loser known as J.J. (George Segal) spends his days looking for just "one more fix".

title: Bottle Shock
description: The story of the early days of California wine making featuring the now infamous, blind Paris wine tasting of 1976 that has come to be known as "Judgment of Paris". Feat: Chris Pine, Alan Rickman & Bill Pullman.

title: Bowery at Midnight
description: Kindly soup kitchen operator and professor of criminology, Karl Wagner, uses his soup kitchen as a front for a criminal gang. When things get out of hand, Wagner kills his henchmen, who wind up as zombies in the cellar of the soup kitchen.

title: Boy Soldiers Of World War II
description: In Britain during World War Two, thousands of men over the age of 18 were conscripted into the army, but among them were hundreds of underage boys, some as young as 15, who lied about their age so that they could join up.

title: Boys On The Side
description: After accidentally committing a crime, three women embark on a cross-country journey that helps them develop something they've never known before.

title: Brakes
description: Brakes follows the tumultuous stories of nine couples, using London as their matchmaker; each of their stories is unique yet oddly familiar to us all.

title: Bram Stoker's Van Helsing
description: England, 1897. Van Helsing receives a letter requesting his urgent assistance in the northern town of Whitby and follows the trail to the coffin of Count Dracula himself. A fresh take on the legend of Dracula through the eyes of his greatest enemy.

title: Brazil
description: In the retro-future world, a government bureaucrat tries to correct an administrative error and quickly finds himself an enemy of the state.

title: Bread

title: Casanova - the Art of Seduction
description: Giacomo Casanova was born in Venice in 1725, to poor parents. Initially, he is expected to become a priest, but he is ultimately going to reject this career path. His destiny is governed by the love of women, and he challenges the most powerful institutions of his time: the Catholic Church and the Venetian Inquisition. For Casanova, life in decadent Venice is an on-going feast for the senses – until he is jailed for one and a half years in the notorious leads (piombi). With his spectacular escape from what was known to be the safest prison during his time, he becomes a legend. The power of his charms is a mystery to many. He converses with the great minds of his age and exchanges philosophical ideas with them. Madame de Pompadour and Frederic the Great are among the influential people on whom he leaves a lasting impression. Several times, he wins and loses a fortune in gambling. He converses with the Pope in Rome, establishes the first French lottery in Paris and makes a fortune. Enormous debt eventually causes him to flee London and Madrid, where he is threatened to be executed. He translates Homer’s Iliad and contributes to the libretto of Don Giovanni, Mozart’s opera. He survives several duels and works for the Venetian secret service. In the figure of Casanova, the entire 18th century comes alive. At the heart of his thought and action, there is always the love of women and the pursuit of happiness. His memoirs are quite likely the most sincere and erotically frank life report that has ever been written in the history of mankind. Perhaps this is why, even 200 years after his death, Casanova, the libertine, feels like a modern to us. With his uninhibited sensuality and sexual conduct, Casanova redefines the relationship between men and women beyond religion and convention in an almost revolutionary way. The film is a portrait of the man who became a myth. Adrian Becker plays Giacomo Casanova.

title: Crime Scene Eulau - The Mystery of the 13 Skeletons
description: This documentary focuses on a spectacular discovery made in a quarry near the village of Eulau, not far from the central German town of Naumburg. Neolithic graves contained the skeletons of three women, two men and eight children, buried tenderly 4500 years ago, some affectionately entwined. In 2008, for the first time anywhere in the world, it was possible to perform a DNA analysis on the earliest evidence of the existence of a nuclear family. This was a sensation - but why did these people all die at the same time? Were they the victims of a violent crime? Who were they, and how did this terrible drama unfold? Archaeologists insist that these victims will not be forgotten, since these days it is possible to do far more than simply date and record such finds. Modern scientific methods have revolutionised archaeology, enabling us to discover how and why the family from Eulau in the German state of Sachsen-Anhalt died 4500 years ago. By enlisting the help of a CID profiler, archaeologists and anthropologists employ state-of-the-art analytical methods to investigate this Stone Age crime. In the process we discover key information about an era before recorded history which has previously been shrouded in mystery - and astonishing information about the composition of the population here also comes to light. It seems that the third millennium before Christ saw two major waves of migration, from Eastern and Western Europe, which determine the composition of the population here. In the middle of what is now Germany these two migratory movements met. Could this be the background to the mysterious murders of Eulau?

title: Eagle Lakes
description: The Lauenburg Lake District is located between Lübeck and Lauenburg on the River Elbe. With more than 470 square kilometres, it is the third largest natural reserve in Schleswig-Holstein. Due to its extensive forest areas, 40 lakes and its proximity to Mecklenburg’s biosphere reserve Lake Schalsee, it forms the largest protectoral area alongside the former inner-German border. The ecological cultivation of land, field and water results in the resettlement of long-lost animals. Thanks to its being a biotope and its biodiversity, it is one of Germany’s 100 most important nature landscapes. 25 years after reunification, nature has healed the wounds caused by the Wall and now, even the scars are beginning to slowly disappear. Germany’s division, with its restricted zones, has had a positive effect on nature. The Lauenburg Lake District has become a centre for threatened species. Animal film makers Christoph and Almut Hauschild impressively present the natural wealth of Lauenburg’s lakes. After spending more than a year of shooting footage, they can now present exciting stories of hunting sea eagles, huge herds of deer and unusual cross-border "commuters". One example of just how sensitive this refuge has become, is the sea eagle. We experience sad moments when the king of the skies fights for its life in a clinic after suffering lead poisoning. We are part of it all when a crane acts as a midwife, when South American rheas conquer a landscape and cocks fight a bitter fight to win a females favour. After 130 years, ospreys return to Schleswig-Holstein and choose the Lauenburg Lake District as their habitat. In addition to its exciting stories, the documentary reveals the connection between careful use and biodiversity. All of this and more has been captured within a framework of peaceful solitude and fantastic aerial footage. From above, it becomes clear just how diversified the Lauenburg lakes are.

title: Expedition in the South Seas
description: He is one of the greatest German explorers of all time even though his name fell into oblivion: As luck would have it, in 1772 17-year-old Georg Forster was given the chance to accompany the greatest navigator of his time, James Cook, on his world circumnavigation. On this voyage, Captain Cook discovered islands and peoples, while Georg Forster focused on animals and plants, discovering more than 400 species that had been unknown to Europeans until then. “Terra X” follows German actor Robert Atzorn on his search for traces around the world. He gets to know a young man, whose philosophy and conception of the world still appear to be really modern. Sophisticated dramatic reconstructions bring the fateful sea journey to life.
