description: When Alice Klieg wins the Mega-Millions lottery, she immediately quits her psychiatric meds and buys her own talk show. Starring: Kristen Wiig, James Marsden, Linda Cardellini

title: Welcome to the Punch
description: When a notorious criminal is forced to return to London, it gives a detective one last chance to take down the man he's always been after.

title: Welcome to the Warzone
description: Disheartened when his story about Coalition snipers possibly mutilating corpses in Afghanistan is buried by his editor, journalist Luke Benning sets out on a surreal and perilous adventure across Afghanistan in search of the truth.

title: Werq the World LIVE
description: During the never-ending pandemic, what better way to lift our spirits than to watch our favorite Drag Race queens slay the stage, either at home or in the studio in Hollywood. Starring Aquaria, Asia O'Hara, Gigi Goode, Kameron Michaels, Kim Chi, Plastique Tiara, Vanessa Vanjie Mateo, Violet Chachki and Yvie Oddly. Hosted by the hilarious Lady Bunny and Drag Race season 6 winner Bianca Del Rio.

title: Werq the World: Battle Royale
description: In this highly anticipated second live streaming event, some of the biggest names in drag herstory battle head-to-head to raise money for local drag entertainers around the world. Starring Alyssa Edwards, Plastique Tiara, Aquaria, Kameron Michaels, Gigi Goode, Violet Chachki, Asia O'Hara, Brooke Lynn Hytes, Vanessa Vanjie and Yvie Oddly. Hosted by the hilarious duo Bianca Del Rio and Lady Bunny.

title: Wes Craven's Mind Ripper
description: A top secret experiment intended to produce a superhuman has gone terribly wrong. Now the creators, trapped in a remote desert outpost, are being pursued ruthlessly by their creation.

title: West Of The Divide
description: Ted Hayden impersonates a wanted man and joins Gentry's gang only to learn later that Gentry was the one who killed his father. He saves Virginia Winters' dad's ranch from Gentry and also rescues his long-lost brother Spud. Starring: John Wayne

title: Western World
description: When US Marshall Moses White goes to the town of Dogwood Pass to track down a ruthless killer, he runs into a lot more than he bargained for. A corrupt mayor and an unhinged sheriff stand in the way of justice and he might just have to shoot his way out.

title: What Doesn't Kill You
description: Two childhood friends from South Boston turn to crime as a way to get by, ultimately causing a strain in their personal lives and their friendship.

title: What Ever Happened to Baby Jane
description: Long-forgotten child star Baby Jane Hudson berates and abuses her wheelchair-bound sister Blanche after Blanche's fame sees a resurgence when her movies are played on TV.

title: What Happens In Vegas
description: Two strangers who drunkenly get married in Vegas fight over a huge jackpot.

title: What History Forgot
description: Hosted by history buff and veteran high school teacher Joe Moniaci, "What History Forgot" tells famously forgotten tales that shaped some of America's greatest icons, scandals and disasters.

title: What Maisie Knew
description: In New York City, a young girl is caught in the middle of her parents' bitter custody battle. Starring Julianne Moore, Steve Coogan and Alexander Skarsgård.

title: What On Earth
description: Hundreds of satellites orbit Earth and capture the world like it’s never been seen before, revealing phenomena that defy explanation. Explore these unusual images as scientists attempt to explain mysteries seen from space.

title: What Women Want: Gay Romance
description: The biggest readers and writers of gay romance books are women.  LGBTQ and m/m romance are the fastest expanding genres, seeing larger growth in readership than any other publishing segment.  The documentary attends Gay Rom Lit, to find out why.

title: What's the Worst That Could Happen? (2001)
description: Kevin is a thief who breaks into Max Fairbanks' unoccupied mansion. Kevin finds himself face to face with Max. And just as the cops arrest Kevin, Max claims Kevin's ring as his own.

title: What's With Wheat
description: What's With Wheat?' is a hard hitting investigation into the growing epidemic of wheat & gluten intolerance, and why after eating wheat for thousands of years, it has been linked to so many health problems.

title: What's Your Number?
description: Ally Darling embarks on a quest to find the best "ex" of her life, by any means necessary, when she reads a magazine article warning that people who have had 20 or more relationships have missed their chance at true love.

title: When a Man Falls in the Forest
description: A powerful psychological drama that embraces the story of four unlikely heroes, each consumed by a personal struggle to make sense of their lives.

title: When the Lights Went Out
description: The terrifying true story of one of Britain’s most haunted houses. A young family’s dream home soon descends into a panic-stricken nightmare when they find they are being terrorised by a violent poltergeist.

title: When the Party’s Over
description: Rae Dawn Chong, Elizabeth Berridge, Sandra Bullock and Fisher Stevens star in this powerful and intimate look at success, friendship and sex in the 90's. A group of young, sophisticated and beautiful friends is bent on having it all

title: Where Eskimos Live
description: Sharkey, part of the sinister world of child trade, picks up Vlado, an orphan of war, dreaming of freedom and a better life. They embark upon a strange and enlightening journey through war torn Bosnia.

title: Where Hands Touch
description: In 1944, a 15-year-old girl, daughter of a white German mother and a black African father, meets a member of the Hitler Youth. They become bound by the realisation of the horrors being committed around them.

title: Where the Devil Hides
description: Something very strange happened in the small village of New Bethlehem, a devout community kept under the tight reins of the town's vigilant Elders. Six girls born on the same day to different mothers. Perhaps a coincidence or as most believe a chilling omen of something yet to come. Now, on the eve of their 18th birthday, the young women are mysteriously disappearing one by one and feared dead. Terror has overtaken this quiet community. Could this be the work of a serial killer, one of the village elders or a horrific prophecy come true, born of the supernatural, The Occult?

title: White Fang
description: The exciting adventures of heroic wolf White Fang and his friends come to life in this timeless adventure series, set against the stunning backdrop of the Yukon during the Klondike Gold Rush.

title: White Vengeance
description: White Vengeance tells the story of two brothers contending for supremacy during the fall of the Qin Dynasty, which ruled Imperial China from 221 to 206 BC.

title: Whitney Houston The Greatest Love of All
description: In this film we pay tribute to one of the most gripping rags to riches stories ever told. Whitney Elizabeth Houston first showed the vocal range and star quality that would soon make her a legend in music. We talk to those who were close to her, retrac...

title: Whitney Houston: We Will Always Love You (2012)
description: In this film we pay tribute to one of the worlds most loved and best selling music artists of all time. Whitney Elizabeth Houston first showed the vocal range and star quality at the tender age of 11.

title: Who is Cletis Tout?
description: Finch and Micah are fellow inmates who successfully escape together from prison. Micah is a magician and illusionist who, some twenty years earlier, pulled off a remarkable diamond heist. Now, with Finch's help, he's going back for the jewels.

title: Whose Line Is It Anyway?
description: Clive Anderson is in the chair for the series of improvised mayhem alongside a top class selection of comedy guests.

title: Whose Line Is It Anyway?
description: Aisha Tyler hosts the legendary improv comedy show featuring comics Wayne Brady, Colin Mochrie and Ryan Stiles. Each episode, a guest star joins the cast to tackle a series of improvised sketches.

title: Wicked Tuna
description: Wicked Tuna follows a group of spirited fishermen from Gloucester, Mass., as they make their living the way it's been done for centuries - man versus fish, rod versus fin, one catch at a time.

title: Wicker Park
description: A young Chicago advertising executive believes a woman he sees in a café is his long-lost love. His belief leads to obsession, as he puts his life on hold in order to trail her. Starring: Josh Hartnett, Diane Kruger, Matthew Lillard, Rose Byrne

title: Wild & Wide Awake
description: It is the most exciting time of the year and we often await it eagerly during the long and gloomy winter months. We think we know what it is like, yet it has many appearances: the spring in Europe.

title: Wild About New Zealand
description: Wild About New Zealand explores the magic found in New Zealand’s national parks through the eyes of environmental specialist and adventure guide, Gus Roxburgh.

title: Wild Animals in South Africa: Rescue Centres Along the Garden Route
description: The movie focuses on committed animal rights activists, who fight for the lives of their charges every day, in diverse protection projects and rescue centres along the South African Garden Route.

title: Wild Animals on the South African Garden Route
description: The movie focuses on committed animal rights activists, who fight for the lives of their charges every day, in diverse protection projects and rescue centres along the South African Garden Route.

title: Wild Asia
description: A dramatic and poignant portrayal of the fragile alliances and desperate strategies for survival adopted by three species of animals caught in the no-man’s-land where the human and natural worlds of Asia collide.

title: Wild Assassins
description: Wild Assassins explores nature's smartest and deadliest creatures, from camouflaging cuttlefish and hidden hippos to ferocious sharks and venomous snakes. Each possesses unique weapons and skills aiding them in the relentless battle for survival.

title: Wild At Heart
description: The story of an English family who move to the South African bush to set up and run a game reserve – and  sort out the problems within the family itself.

title: Wild Baltic
description: The wide, often untouched wilderness of the Baltic hinterland is home to many animals. More than 35 brown bears live in the primeval forests of Alutaguse. In the spring, the Soomaa National Park transforms into a huge lake.

title: Wild Baltic Sea
description: The nature of the Baltic Sea offers many surprises as demonstrated in the three-part series Wild Baltic Sea. The first episode takes us from Denmark, via the Darss Peninsula and Lithuania’s Curonian Spit to Latvia. In June, hundreds of seals gather on a Danish island. In the autumn of 2015, an absolute rarity appeared: a Sowerby’s beaked whale. The Curonian Spit is home to many sea eagles. We end along Latvia’s coast. Grey seals, the biggest in the Baltics, live here. The second episode presents the islands between Estonia, Sweden and Finland. In Autumn the mating calls of the Moose can be heard everywhere. The largest gathering of Grey Seals in the Baltic Sea can be found in the bay of Riga. On Gotland Golden eagles breed in trees. Close by is the biggest guillemot colony. 300 kilometres further north is Finland’s Archipelago. Home to brown bears. The third episode takes us to the Bay of Bothnia. In winter home to ringed seals. 300 kilometres further south millions of fish head for the coast to lay their eggs. The Kvarken Archipelago is also the habitat of the flying squirrel. In the spring males begin looking for females. For the same reason brown bears roam through the Skuleskogen National Park on the other side of the Bay. Thanks to hidden cameras we come up close to witness the small and big drama of the Baltic wildlife. Underwater footage reveals a world that is hidden beneath the waves and spectacular aerials celebrate the breathtaking landscapes.

title: Wild Bear Rescue
description: A second chance at life in the wild.

title: Wild Berlin
description: Berlin has a natural wild side - a fascinating parallel world of wildlife wonders great and small, right on the doorstep. For every human inhabitant of Berlin there are at least two birds, and nowhere else are so many sparrows and nightingales to be found as in Germany’s capital. Swarms of bees harvest the honey from the city’s almost half a million trees, while badgers can be found scurrying across courtyards and praying mantises await their prey in strips of railway land. The metropolis of Berlin is an urban jungle, providing a habitat for thousands of racoons, foxes, bats, squirrels, hedgehogs and beavers - Berlin is wild in more ways than one.

title: Wild Card
description: Jason Statham stars as a Las Vegas bodyguard with lethal skills and a gambling problem. When he gets in trouble with the mob, he has one last play and it's all or nothing.

title: Wild Faces of Switzerland
description: In the heart of Europe lies Switzerland. It’s a special place: majestic mountains, lush green valleys, craggy rock landscapes and Mediterranean lakes – all together, they are home to unique and diverse wildlife. Discover the wild faces of Switzerland!

title: Wild Faces of the Andes
description: Extraordinary nature and animal stories – sometimes imposing and fascinating, sometimes funny or exciting – describe in a very touching way creation and fading of life and death in the spheres of the Andes, the biggest mountain range in the world.

title: Wild Galapagos
description: In the vastness of the Pacific Ocean, a world of its own exists that is one of a kind. Millions of years ago, new land emerged out of the ocean that would play host to some of the strangest creatures on earth. But there is more to it than meets the eye!

title: Wild Germany
description: Huge Mountains, picturesque rivers, magical forests and dreamlike coastlines at the North and the Baltic Sea - these are the most valuable treasures of Germany. Firm but still changeable, embossed by men but still natural, that is how Wild Germany presents its beautiful landscapes and animals. The series Wild Germany shows the country from a different perspective: extremely calm cineflex-aerials, spectacular tracking shots and astonishing slow-motions capture mountains, rivers, forests and seascapes in monumental pictures. In four episodes Germanys best wildlife filmmakers present the most pristine places in Germany and their unique fauna - where lynxes returned and black storks come to breed, where deer and ibexes are fighting for their females favour or fire salamanders and otters still feel at home. During the shooting the film crews pulled out all the stops: Due to long shooting times the teams could film extraordinary animal behavior, aerials made out of hot air balloons and extra stabilized helicopter footage offer beautiful and calm landscape views at every time of the year. Long-term time lapses show the constant change of nature - in a way you have never seen it before. High-resolution slow motion images reveal what the human eye is normally not able to see: marmots fighting for the mastery in their district, a river kingfisher diving for fish or the mating of the colorful bee-eater.

title: Wild Hungary - A Water Wonderland
description: "Wild Hungary - A Water Wonderland" is a wildlife documentary about a white-tailed eagle family, a young otter and a giant catfish that share the wetlands of this country in Central Europe. Hungary lies in the bottom of the huge Pannonian Basin encircled by the peaks of the Alps and the Carpathians. Countless rivers and streams run from the mountains into the heart of the basin like the Danube or the Tisza and the countryside is densely scattered with thousands of lakes as well. In such a water paradise it’s not surprising that wildlife is flourishing, often quite close to human settlements or well-known tourist destinations like the Lake Balaton or the Hungarian Puszta. "Wild Hungary" is also the story of a fisherman and a herdsman for whom the rhythm of the river and the moving of the water makes the yearly calendar. "Wild Hungary" offers a view behind the clichés that lives about this country. And there are much more to taste than the famous goulash soup.

title: Wild Iran
description: The Iran has a surprisingly spectacular landscape - deserts, large lakes, rustic deciduous wood, sparkling waterfalls and snow-capped mountains - and a unique mix of species from Africa, Asia and Europe. Most news about Iran are only about its controversial policies. Many people have only sketchy ideas of the Islamic Republic. Therefore the country is generally a blank spot in the minds of many Europeans. Benny Rebel, a German-Iranian internationally renowned wildlife photographer and environmentalist, will change this. He returns to his native Iran to document its little-known wilderness and extraordinary collection of plants and animals. His journey shows another Iran - an Iran that has been rarely known before.

title: Wild Italy
description: From the snow-covered Dolomites to the turquoise blue of the Mediterranean: the spectacular landscape of Italy is already a favourite for many people. But there’s a lot more to “Bella Italia” than first meets the eye - a wilder, secretive side! Away from the hordes of tourists and premium travel destinations rare species such as the Apennine chamois, greater flamingos and even basking sharks can be found in their natural habitat. The two-part documentary Wild Italy reveals the fascinating and unexpected wildlife to be found between the tip of Italy’s boot and the northern Alpine peaks in captivating pictures.

title: Wild Moments
description: Nature has many weird creatures to offer and often these animals fascinate us the most. There are ants in Australia's outback that use specialised workers as living honey pots.

title: Wild Poland
description: Where in Europe are bisons still to be found in the wild? And where do probably more migratory birds breed than in any other European country? The flora and fauna of Poland are full of surprises: the South is dominated by the 2000m peaks of the Tatra, to the North-East the Biebrza river forms one of the largest swamp regions of Europe, a paradise for rare birds like the ruff. Masuria is the breeding-ground for thousands of white storks, more than anywhere else on Earth. The much shier and rarer black stork also finds refuge in the large expanses of forest that stretch to the Baltic Sea. In winter, an icy wind sweeps Eastern Poland and only those with a thick skin survive in the region bordering Belorus. The cold doesn’t bother the bison. Thick coats protect these ancient cattle against the snow and icy wind, but lack of food in winter does present a problem. The bison here are among the last of their kind. Once upon a time, huge herds roamed most of the European continent, today the only bison in Central Europe living in the wild are located in Eastern Poland. Poland’s hard winters are no problem for otter and beaver, whose extremely dense coats protect them against the cold and enable them to swim and dive in the icy water. Although both animals are water-dwellers, they’re not rivals: beavers are vegetarians and in winter eat stores of leaves and bark. Otters are active hunters all year round and live on fish and crabs. As soon as spring arrives in Poland, the river Biebrza becomes a hive of activity: thousands of birds vie with each other to be heard as they use the vast area of swampland to rest and breed. White-winged black terns and black-necked grebes build their nests, then the mating season begins for the ruffs, with the males strutting their stuff for potential mates.

title: Wild Serbia
description: Serbia is in the heart of the Balkans, a “little Europe“ within Europe; with its rich variety of landscapes and natural beauties, it certainly does this name justice. This nature documentary presents Serbia's breath-taking, picturesque regions and unique wildlife on a journey to the most beautiful and wildest areas of the Balkan peninsula, from high mountains across gentle hills to the vast plains of the Puszta. Serbia is only about five times the size of Schleswig Holstein, yet here the most varied vegetation zones, animal kingdoms and cultures meet. And even today a large number of Serbian people live in close communion with nature. They are proud of the storks’ nests in the villages, the ancient species of livestock that have been preserved and the vultures that return to make their home here. In many places people are pleased to see bears, lynx and wolves, and even jackals are at home in the forests of Siberia. It is a country full of traditions and folklore, with deep influences from the Orient as well as the West. The Danube is the most prominent river in Serbia. As it makes its way through the Carpathian Mountains of Rumania it forms the most imposing gorge in Europe, the Iron Gates. Other striking features of Serbia's landscape include the archaic earth pyramids of Devil's Town, towering up in powerful red colours - and what must be the driest region of Siberia, the Deliblatska Pescara, which is also known as Europe's Sahara. Colourful birds called bee-eaters have settled on a rocky slope - a whole, noisy colony of them. They make their nests in caves which they dig themselves in the ground, and the inaccessible location means it is difficult for enemies to reach them. The more frequently the male brings the female insects it has caught, the more powerful is the bond between them later.

title: Wild Sex
description: Sex is at the heart of everything. It’s the only real way of leaving a legacy - in the genes of the future. But there’s more than just the act - it’s the build up to it when wildlife shows its incredible diversity. It drives touching courtships and fierce battles. Hormones and sex drive are forces that shape behaviour and can change an animal’s purpose and persona. This is the story of how wild things get sexy. Without sex, there’s nothing. It’s a driving force throughout nature. The act of sex is mostly to make babies, but let’s face it, its foreplay that really counts - it brings out the best and the worst in the animal kingdom. Pre-coital courtship can give pleasure, but also gives the participants the chance to check each other out and make sure they’ve found the perfect match. It affects us all. Birds do it, bees do it, all the way through the animals kingdom. From fire flies who mix up their own chemistry sets to fill the forest with mood lighting, to mayflies that emerge on mass, by the millions to mate. Their vast orgies attract predators of all sizes. Fish risk their lives climbing rivers from the sea, and a barrage of bears and other predators - just for sex - but the mission is so strenuous it kills them, as soon as their eggs are laid, they wither and die. Sex and the hormones that drive it can turn cute and cuddly into a sex beast. It turns out the koala is a sex maniac, more into rape than romance. Many mammals, from guanaco (wild llama) to hippos chase, wrestle and bite their way to a romantic interlude. Huge male red Kangaroos even box. When it comes to wild sex, mammals are amazing, but its birds that are the real show stoppers. From dazzling peacocks to booming bustards, fighting turkeys to dancing birds of paradise, birds go all out on foreplay - though you sometimes have to wonder if it’s worth it - after all that parading their sex is over in seconds; There’s a lot of effort for very little reward.

title: Wild Slovakia
description: Bears, wolves, lynx and eagles, untamed rivers running through endless forests where wildlife and rare flowers thrive… Where is this place? In Slovakia, untouched wilderness and astonishing fauna and flora still exist.

title: Wild Spain
description: Spain is one of the world’s most popular holiday destinations. But sandy beaches and world famous towns like Seville and Granada are just one side of Spain. Between the rugged Atlantic coast in the north and the sun-kissed Mediterranean coast in the south one can find a diversity of species rarely found in other regions of Europe. The two-part documentary Wild Spain portrays the extremely diverse nature from the green north of Galicia and the Basque Country to the south, between Andalusia and the Extremadura. The original filming on the Iberian Peninsula took place over a period of two years. Nature filmmaker Hans-Peter Kuttler used highly stabilised Cineflex cameras and Octocopters for the aerial views, camera rails, underwater and slow motion cameras to capture and portray the nature and the animals from the Atlantic to the Mediterranean as strikingly as possible. From the dreamlike Mediterranean and spectacular canyon landscapes of Andalusia, to the expanses of the Extremadura with its holm oak forests. Even in the south of Spain, highly popular with holidaymakers, there is still much waiting to be discovered. Genets hunt for prey under cover of night. And nowhere else in Europe are there as many vultures as here in Spain. Within a fraction of a second the European Chameleon shoots out his half-a-metre-long tongue to catch insects. The unmistakeable hoopoe is also pleased with the rich variety of insects on offer. But it’s underwater, where the wealth of animals reaches its zenith: weird sea slugs of almost alien appearance, graceful sea horses and elegant blue sharks all have their habitat here. From the reedy areas in the Basque Country, via the Cantabrian mountain range, to Galicia with its spectacular coasts: This is the North Spanish wilderness. The Cantabrian mountain range is habitat for around 140 Cantabrian brown bears - Western Europe’s greatest bear population. Above the timberline is the Kingdom of the Cantabrian chamois.

title: Wildest Europe
description: From mountain to sea, and from scorching desert to Arctic tundra, Europe’s great wilderness contains a stunning and surprising explosion of life.  Wildest Europe reveals the incredible beauty and diversity of wildlife in Europe’s major natural habitats.

title: Wildest Indochina
description: This 5 part series sweeps across the most diverse peninsular in the world. From Malaysia, Southwest China and Vietnam to Cambodia and Thailand this vast area includes outstanding landscapes, historic cities, tropical jungles and armies of animals.

title: Wildest Indonesia
description: The islands of Indonesia are a wild paradise of giant flowers and coral gardens, of dragons, tigers, giant apes and glorious birds of paradise. A staggering fifteen percent of all the world's species are found in this unique region.

title: Wildest Islands
description: Islands can be home to the most extreme examples of life, as nature evolves in the most dramatic way. Sometimes isolated for hundreds of thousands of years, pockets of individuals adapt to survive, fuelling a rapid and continuous evolution of new species.

title: Wildest Islands
description: Islands can be home to the most extreme examples of life, the wildest of people and the most dramatic landscapes. Natural selection fuels evolution in the most dramatic way

title: Wildest Middle East
description: Wildest Middle East reveals the remotest and most surprising corners of this ancient land, where you will find nothing is as it seems and where the natural world is fighting a constant battle to survive in an ever changing world.

title: Wildest Places: Antarctic
description: Wildest Places explores some of the most incredible natural habitats on earth & a diverse range of wildlife.

title: Wildest Places: Australia
description: Wildest Places explores some of the most incredible natural habitats on earth & a diverse range of wildlife.

title: Wildest Places: Pacific
description: Wildest Places explores some of the most incredible natural habitats on earth & a diverse range of wildlife.

title: Wildlife
description: Fourteen-year-old Joe is the only child of Jeanette and Jerry - a housewife and a golf pro - living a seemingly idyllic life in 1960s Montana. His family's carefully constructed façade is about to come crashing spectacularly down however, when Jerry loses his job - and his sense of purpose. In an attempt to restore his pride, Jerry takes off for the summer to help fight the wildfires raging near the Canadian border, a life-threatening job, for very little pay. An angry and bereft Jeanette must quickly learn to fend for herself, and does so with gusty, challenging cultural expectations and taking a quietly bewildered Joe along for the ride. An elegant adaption of the Richard Ford novel of the same name, Wildlife is an impressive directorial debut from Golden Globe nominee Paul Dano (There Will Be Blood, Love & Mercy), starring Carey Mulligan (Never Let Me Go, An Education, Shame, Suffragette), Jake Gyllenhaal (Nightcrawler, Brokeback Mountain, Donnie Darko), Ed Oxenbould (The Visit, Paper Planes) and Bill Camp (The Night Of, Loving, Midnight Special).

title: Will.I.Am: The Way I Am
description: The complete life story of songwriter, producer and entrepreneur- Will.I.Am.  From “being raised in the ghetto’ to forming the Black Eyed Peas, everything Will.I.Am touches turns to gold.  He has dabbled in fashion, technology, acting and business.

title: William Shakespeare
description: There’s no name better known in the world of Literature than William Shakespeare, and whatever your feelings about such dramatic offerings as “Romeo and Juliet”, “Twelfth Night”, “King Lear”,  “Othello”, “Julius Caesar”.

title: Windstorm
description: Rebel teen Mika encounters a beautiful, wild stallion named Windstorm at her grandmother's riding school and learns she can communicate with horses.

title: Windtalkers
description: True story about members of the Navajo tribe who proudly served the U.S. in WW II as code talkers by using their native language as a code to relay information to military leaders.

title: Winter Ridge
description: A young detective is torn apart after his wife ends up in a coma while hunting a serial-killer at the same time.

title: Winter's Bone
description: An unflinching Ozark Mountain girl hacks through dangerous social terrain as she hunts down her drug-dealing father while trying to keep her family intact.

title: Wipeout Australia
description: Twenty men and women from every state of Australia will compete in the world's largest extreme obstacle course.

title: Wipeout Canada
description: Each week on Wipeout Canada, 20 daring and energetic contestants of all ages, shapes and sizes go head-to-head through four rounds of demanding but painfully hilarious obstacle courses.

title: Wiseguy
description: In this thrilling crime drama series, streetwise Vinnie Terranova (Ken Wahl) works as an undercover agent for the FBI’s organized crime division, busting dangerous criminals while putting himself in danger.

title: Wish Upon a Star (1996)
description: In this cult classic, younger sister Hayley Wheaton (Danielle Harris) wishes to switch places with her popular older sister Alexia (Katherine Heigl) and the two bickering siblings awaken to find the wish has come true.

title: Witch Hunt in Salem
description: New England, 1692: religious hysteria infects the people of small-town Salem. One of the darkest chapters in the US history that fascinates scholars, artists and general public to this day as the cause of the collective mania remains a mystery.

title: Witches of Oz
description: Dorothy Gale writes children's books based on the Land of Oz created by her grandfather. Her life turns upside down when she learns that Oz is real and she must stop the Wicked Witch.

title: Witches Of Salem
description: Witches of Salem unravels the hysteria of the Salem witch trials, where 20 women were executed after young girls were accused by shadowy adults. Based on historical records, this docu-drama brings the real-life horror to life.

title: Witches: A Century of Murder
description: Dr Suzannah Lipscomb investigates the origins and events of a dark period in our history.

title: Wizards Of The Lost Kingdom
description: When evil screams throughout the world. When all the galaxies converge. When all that's fair and fine seems lost. A Hero will emerge.

title: Woman On The Run
description: Frank Johnson flees police after becoming an eyewitness to murder. He is pursued around scenic San Francisco by his wife, a reporter, the police, and... the real murderer.

title: Women Behind Bars
description: Journeying into the minds of women incarcerated in America?s prisons, this harrowing documentary series seeks to understand the unique methods and motives of female convicts.

title: Women on Death Row
description: This compelling docuseries offers an intimate look into the personal lives of women currently awaiting execution on death row.

title: Wonders
description: NOVA Wonders follows researchers on the winding paths of uncertainty and the unknown revealing how far we’ve come, how we managed to get here and the remarkable scientists who are transforming our world and the future.

title: Wonderwall
description: Oscar Collins, an eccentric, absent-minded professor, becomes obsessed with his new neighbors, Penny Lane and her boyfriend. He drills holes in the walls and ceiling to spy on her day and night, lost in fantasies and daydreams about the woman next door.

title: World Finals
description: The Monster Jam World Finals brings together the world's best drivers in one place where they compete to be crowned World Champion. It's the ultimate showdown.

title: World Poker Tour
description: The World Poker Tour ignited the global poker boom with the creation of this unique television show based on a series of high-stakes tournaments, and has broadcast globally in over 150 countries and territories. Televised WPT events turned Gus Hansen into the Great Dane and Daniel Negreanu into Kid Poker, and created dozens of poker-made millionaires.

title: World Poker Tour: Greatest
description: The World Poker Tour ignited the global poker boom with the creation of this unique television show based on a series of high-stakes tournaments, and has broadcast globally in over 150 countries and territories. Televised WPT events turned Gus Hansen into the Great Dane and Daniel Negreanu into Kid Poker, and created dozens of poker-made millionaires.

title: World War A - When Aliens Attack
description: Scientists are already looking feverishly for evidence of extraterrestrial life. With the ExoMars mission, ESA will soon find life on Mars. If there are only tiny microbes, there could also be life in other places in the universe. But can life in space exist at all? The exobiologist Jean-Pierre de Vera collects microorganisms around the world and tests them in his Mars simulation laboratory. Can they survive under the deadly conditions of Mars? Researchers believe there are planets on which alien life can exist. In 1991 the Swiss astrophysicist Michel Mayor discovered the world's first exoplanet. Since then, about 3,000 planets have been detected outside our solar system. Heike Rauer from the German Aerospace Center is looking for habitable planets. Will she find a second earth? The European Southern Observatory is also searching for life in space, building the largest telescope in the world. In the next 20 years the E-ELT should be able to prove the existence of life on distant planets. How would extraterrestrials look? Some scientists suspect that they may well resemble us humans. Under other environmental conditions, alien life could also arise completely differently. It could be formed from methane and silicon. Different gravity would form alien bodies completely differently. Could extraterrestrials send us messages? At the SETI Institute in California, alien hunters like Seth Shostak are listening to signals from alien civilizations. But mere listening is no longer enough. Some SETI researchers now want to send messages to the aliens themselves. They hope to finally get an answer. But would that be a bad idea? Many scientists warn of the dangers of establishing contact. The former SETI researcher and science fiction author David Brin also fears that it could be a devastating mistake. With well-meant news we could end up attracting attention from hostile civilizations. Should we really tell them that we exist and where they can find us?

title: World War I in the Trenches
description: Experience firsthand "the war to end all wars." World War I was the first war in history to affect most of the globe, with battles fought on land, at sea and, for the first time, in the sky.

title: World War II: Battles Won and Lost
description: Every battle is both a victory and a defeat; it depends which flag you fly. The battles of World War II were decided not only by strategy but by armies in their element. These battles won and lost would determine the course of the future.

title: World War Weird
description: Strange, unexplained events from the battlefronts of history’s biggest war. From supernatural encounters to bizarre military experiments, discover the oddities of WWII that defy explanation.

title: World's Greatest
description: The world is full of inspiring places. World’s Greatest goes on a breathtaking journey around the planet, revealing the best cities, natural wonders, animal encounters, journeys and adventures, monuments, and islands.

title: World's Wildest Encounters
description: Encounters of a very special kind are the hallmark of this documentary by the famous German wildlife filmmaker Andreas Kieling. He travels to the most remote regions of our planet in search of particularly fascinating creatures. He has the ability to amaze viewers on a regular basis by establishing close contact with the most charismatic creatures in jungles, deserts and a variety of underwater worlds, observing them in their natural surroundings and capturing their essence in unforgettable pictures. As a rule these are creatures which also attract our attention because of a rather menacing fact: they are among the last of their species and are in acute danger of becoming extinct. But there is some good news as well: due to intensive conservation measures, especially in Europe and North America, a number of species which were on the brink of extinction have increased their population numbers again, such as the steppes bison or the shy black stork in Germany. And Andreas Kieling also set off to track them down.

title: World’s Most Evil Killers
description: An in-depth look at the lives and crimes of some of the world's most evil killers, including Jeffrey Dahmer, Richard Ramirez, Cary Stayner, Leonard Lake, Dorothea Puente and more.

title: Worst Cooks in America
description: Some of the country's worst home cooks compete in this elimination series. The last two standing have the chance to cook for culinary critics and win a cash prize.

title: Worzel Gummidge Down Under
description: In Worzel Gummidge Down Under, the lovable, bumbling scarecrow embarks on whimsical adventures in New Zealand, where he encounters new friends and learns valuable life lessons while juggling his many different heads.

title: Wrangler
description: Ben is intent on building a life with Alice although he faces some competition from local cowboy Jack. When Alice's father dies, and a creditor plots to seize her land, Ben leaps to her defense - an act that could lead to their marriage or his funeral.

title: Wreckers
description: Wreckers is an evocative drama that examines the fragile relationship between truth, intimacy and betrayal.

title: Wrongfully Accused
description: Ryan Harrison is framed for murder and must prove himself innocent by finding a mysterious one-eyed, one-armed, one-legged man after escaping from a bus accident on the way to jail.

title: Wuthering Heights (1970)
description: A passionate adaptation of Emily Brontë’s superbly strange and hauntingly enduring classic novel, starring Timothy Dalton and Anna Calder-Marshall as the doomed and deathless lovers, Heathcliff and Cathy. Directed by Robert Fuest.

title: WW II in Color:  US Army Air Forces
description: This series tracks the US Army Air Force from preparation to WWII victory. Evolving to face European and Pacific threats, it aids in defeating Nazi Germany and Imperial Japan through strategic partnerships and relentless determination.

title: WWII Air Crash Detectives
description: Uncovering the truth behind the deaths of thousands of airmen in World War II is investigator Garth Barnard. His tenacity and determination to solve the mysteries is evident.

title: WWII Battles In Colour
description: Rare newsreel and amateur footage, newly colorised, take us inside Hitler's crumbling empire and onto the front lines of the firefight for the streets of Berlin, a battle that will determine the fate of World War II.

title: WWII In Color: From D-Day to Nazi Downfall
description: WWII In Color: From D-Day to Nazi Downfall is a gripping documentary series using restored color footage to chronicle the final year of WWII—from the D-Day landings to the fall of Nazi Germany.

title: Xploration Awesome Planet
description: Xploration Awesome Planet takes you on incredible journeys across our beautiful planet.

title: Yellow Couch with Jeremy Lynch - Ben Whittaker
description: "The Yellow Couch – with Jeremy Lynch" is a light-hearted, talk show designed to entertain and engage audiences with a dynamic mix of celebrity interviews, quirky challenges, and comedic storytelling. Hosted by Jeremy Lynch, the show blends humor, sports, and creativity in a vibrant studio setting centered around a signature yellow couch. Jeremy’s will tailor every show to his personality and to his style. He will bring his A-game to the studio and no matter how big the celebrity.

description: "The Yellow Couch – with Jeremy Lynch" is a light-hearted, talk show designed to entertain and engage audiences with a dynamic mix of celebrity interviews, quirky challenges, and comedic storytelling. title: Yentl
description: Barbra Streisand stars in this beautifully portrayed story of a young independent woman who is forced to masquerade as a boy in order to pursue her love of knowledge.

title: Yo! MTV Raps Classic
description: Popular rap music videos showcased along with live performances and interviews with notable rap artists.

title: York Witches Society
description: Amber Gray (Georgia Lock), a descendant of the Last Witch of England, catches the attention of an elite group of students during her first semester of university. During her initiation into their secret organisation, Amber's magical powers awaken, and she unwittingly releases an ancient evil upon the world that is hellbent on destroying her bloodline. The young women must now band together to lock this spirit away, for good.

title: You Stupid Man
description: A writer struggles to deal with the break-up with his girlfriend. It does not help with getting her out of his mind that she recently became a famous TV start.

title: You're Darn Tootin'
description: Members of a municipal band, Stanley and Oliver seem to be always following someone else's lead, rather than that of the temperamental conductor.

title: Young Bill Hickock
description: Bill Hickok, assisted by Calamity Jane, is after a foreign agent and his guerrilla band who are trying to take over some western territory just as the Civil War is coming to a close.

title: Young Buffalo Bill
description: Buffalo Bill, who bears virtually no relation to the real one, gets in a fight over mining lands in New Mexico. Indians besiege a Spanish rancho and the U.S. Cavalry rides to the rescue.

title: Yuma
description: A determined marshal faces corruption and seeks justice in a lawless Arizona town after being wrongly accused of murder.

title: Zapped
description: Zoey is having a hard time with her new step-family and new school, but suddenly a dog training app gives her control of all the boys around her.

title: Zelig
description: Leonard Zelig's neurotic insecurity forces him to mimic whomever he's with. Treated by Dr. Eudora Fletcher, Zelig is cured. But when misdeeds from his past resurface, Zelig is on the run, and Eudora must search the world over to find and save him.

title: Zinedine Zidane: Zizou The Great
description: FIFA World Player in 1998, 2000 and 2003, Zidane has been labeled the greatest player to ever come out of France.

title: Zoo Babies: Cute and Curious
description: We find out about the sweetest and most poignant animal baby stories. Whether on land, under water or in the sky - all of the babies in this series will conquer the hearts of all those watching.

title: Zookeeper (2011)
description: The animals at one particular zoo decide to break their code of silence in order to help their lovable zookeeper gain the attention of one particular woman.

title: $100 Makeover
description: Interior designer Leslie Segrete, master carpenter Rib Hillis, and professional organizer Robbie Laughlin show how homeowners can spend just $100 a room and come up with de-cluttered and redesigned spaces.

title: 1 Million Followers
description: When Karissa, an Idaho farmgirl, is flown to a luxurious mansion in Thailand to join a host of social media influencers, she soon discovers the dark world of fame.

title: 100% Wolf
description: Freddy Lupin is the heir to a proud family line of werewolves. Desperate to become a werewolf himself, Freddy is in for a shock when on his 14th birthday his first transformation goes awry, turning him into a ferocious - poodle.

title: 10th & Wolf
description: A tense and moody mafia thriller inspired by true events, from the Academy Award Winning Writer of Crash. A Marine Sergeant returns home from war to discover his family has become embroiled in a lethal mob war with the Philadelphia Mafia.

title: 13 Hours
description: Sarah Tyler returns to her troubled family home for a much put-off visit, joined by her brothers and friends. As a storm rages on under a full moon, the young group find themselves cut off from the world and completely isolated.

A man writing a book about the paranormal travels to New York and stays in a hotel room that has been said to be responsible for the death of all the guests that come to stay. Based on the short story by Stephen King.

Award-winning director Damon Gameau embarks on journey to explore what the future could look like by the year 2040 if we simply embraced the best solutions already available to us to improve our planet and shifted them rapidly into the mainstream.

title: 20th Century Women
description: Set in 1970s Santa Barbara, 20th Century Women is the story of Dorothea (Annette Bening), a single mother, and her son Jamie, as he comes of age at a time brimming with cultural change and rebellion.

title: 21 and Over
description: The night before his big medical school interview, a promising student celebrates his 21st birthday with his two best friends.

title: 21 Jump Street
description: The cases of an undercover police unit composed of young-looking officers specializing in youth crime.
A teenager on a ride along gets caught up in a bank robbery gone wrong, trying to tape all of the action on his cell phone as it happens.

title: 24 Hour Catwalk
description: In hopes of winning the $20,000 prize and the change to become the next big fashion star, two designers battle it out to complete their own line for a star-studded runway show in just 24 hours.

title: 400 Days
description: Four aspiring astronauts are sent on a simulated mission to a distant planet to test the psychological effects of deep space travel. Locked away for 400 days, the crew's mental state begins to deteriorate when they lose all communication with the outside world.

title: 500 MPH Storm
description: At 500 MPH disaster is inevitable. When an experiment goes disastrously wrong, a rash of massive hurricanes rips across North America. A scientist must get his family to safety before the hurricanes merge, creating a "hypercane" with the power to wipe America off the map.

What starts out as just another day on the job quickly turns into a life-or-death struggle for a soft-spoken American co-pilot when a group of terrorists attempt to take control of his Paris-bound flight.

title: A Cure for Wellness
description: An ambitious young executive is sent to retrieve his company's CEO from an idyllic but mysterious "wellness center" at a remote location in the Swiss Alps. He soon suspects that the spa's miraculous treatments are not what they seem.

title: A Family Man
description: From the Writer of The Accountant and Ozark comes an unforgettably moving drama with an all-star cast featuring Gerard Butler, Gretchen Mol, and Willem Dafoe.

title: A Good Old Fashioned Orgy
description: A Comedy About Old Friends In New Positions. A Good Old-Fashioned Orgy is about a close group of 30-somethings who spend every weekend of the summer throwing elaborate parties at the house belonging to group member Eric in the Hamptons.

title: A Great Divide
description: The Lee family leave the Bay Area for a fresh start in the rural expanses of Wyoming, only to encounter hostility and xenophobia in their new community. How they confront these issues will break them - or make them stronger.

title: A Haunted House
description: In this outrageous spoof of "found footage" movies, young couple Malcolm (Marlon Wayans) and Kisha (Essence Atkins) have just moved into their dream house. As they settle in, they quickly find they're not alone. But it's not the house that's haunted, it's Malcolm's girlfriend!

title: A Hologram for the King
description: A Hologram for the King follows businessman Alan Clay (Tom Hanks) on a journey halfway around the world, far from his American roots, to a rising Saudi Arabian city.

title: A Kid Like Jake
description: Alex Wheeler and her husband Greg (JIM PARSONS) are approaching a crossroads that is all too familiar to New York City parents - finding the "right" primary school for their son, Jake.

title: A Kind of Magic
description: Tom and Cindy have left the world of fairy tales for the real world, along with their parents; a carefree fairy, a repentant ogre and a terrifying witch-aunt who’s anything but repentant.

title: A Monster Calls
description: From the director of THE IMPOSSIBLE and the producers of PAN’S LABRYNTH, A MONSTER CALLS is a searing and fantastical story of one boy’s journey to confront the truth.

title: A Perfect Plan
description: Four notorious thieves wake up in a fortified warehouse and are forced to commit an audacious diamond heist to win their freedom.

title: A Prayer Before Dawn
description: Living in Bangkok, where he fights bare-knuckle in the local gyms, heroin addict Billy Moore (Joe Cole) is arrested and sent to Klong Prem jail for selling drugs...

title: A Private War
description: In a world where journalism is under attack, Marie Colvin (Academy Award nominee Rosamund Pike) is one of the most celebrated war correspondents of our time.

title: A Score to Settle
description: After a diagnosis of a terminal illness Frank is released from prison to live out his final days as a free man. He must quickly decide what is more important…family or revenge.

title: A Tooth Fairy Tale
description: In a magical land divided by tradition, a rebellious tooth fairy and a daring goblin girl join forces on an epic quest to unite the kingdom!

title: Abduction
description: A thriller centered on a young man who sets out to uncover the truth about his life after finding his baby photo on a missing persons website.

title: About Fate
description: When both of their engagement proposals are a bust, hopeless romantics Margot (Emma Roberts) and Griffin (Thomas Mann) find themselves together on New Year’s Eve after a bout of fateful events.

title: Above Suspicion
description: In ABOVE SUSPICION, three-time Emmy Nominee EMILIA CLARKE plays Susan Smith, a destitute single mother with dreams of escaping her remote Appalachian town. Susan's prayers seem to be answered when a handsome and married FBI agent recruits her as his paid informant, offering her a way out.

title: Absolute Boyfriend
description: Love is never easy, which is why Da Da (Minah) has sworn off men forever. The long-time girlfriend of a popular actor, Ma Wang Joon (Hong Jong Hyun), Da Da never had an easy love life.

title: Ace Crawford, Private Eye
description: Tim Conway stars as a hilariously incompetent private detective who can't stay out of hassles or accidents, all while trying to woo his dream woman.

title: Adrift
description: Adrift is based on the inspiring true story of two sailors who set out to journey across the ocean from Tahiti to San Diego...

title: Adventure Mouse
description: Dreaming of adventure, city mouse Gamba joins a crew of Ship Mice ready to set sail - just as young Chuta bursts in, pleading for help. Stowing away on a boat, the gang heads for Dream Island to defend Chuta's family of mice against Noroi the White Weasel and his wicked weasel clan.

title: After Life
description: After a horrific car accident, Anna (Christina Ricci) wakes up to find the funeral director (Liam Neeson) preparing her body for her funeral.

title: After The Wedding
description: Isabel (Michelle Williams) has devoted her life to running an orphanage in a Kolkata slum. With funds running dry, she lands uncomfortably in the sights of a possible benefactor, Theresa Young (Julianne Moore), a multi-millionaire media mogul. Theresa's life couldn't appear to be more perfect.

title: Ainbo: Spirit of the Amazon
description: Moana meets Brave with the hit new animation Ainbo: Spirit of the Amazon. The story of a young girl who was born and grew up in the deepest jungle of the Amazon.

title: Air
description: From award-winning director Ben Affleck, "Air" reveals the game-changing partnership between a then undiscovered Michael Jordan and Nike’s fledgling basketball division which revolutionized the world of sports and culture with the Air Jordan brand.

title: Air Bud
description: A lonely boy’s life is transformed when he befriends a “wonder” dog who teaches him to play basketball.

title: Air Bud: Golden Receiver
description: Buddy’s got a new trick up his paw – football. When Buddy’s owner suddenly becomes his school’s next quarterback, Buddy falls in with the huddle as well! The dynamite pairing of Buddy and Josh help carry the Timberwolves to the state championship.

title: Air Bud: Seventh Inning Fetch
description: With Josh off to college, Buddy joins the local baseball squad with his little sister Andrea. Once again, Buddy is a natural at anything with a ball! He is having a great season when suddenly, his puppies start to disappear from their homes!

title: Air Bud: Spikes Back
description: Buddy is taking his show to the beaches and getting into a whole new sport: beach volleyball! Life on the beach isn’t as relaxing as it sounds. A rash of mysterious crimes has been plaguing the town and paw prints at the scene seem to point all fingers at Buddy!

title: Air Bud: World Pup
description: Pup Star is back, and bigger than ever as the hit singing pup competition goes global! After achieving international stardom, Tiny the adorable Yorkie joins the inaugural Pup Star World Tour as a celebrity judge.

title: Air Buddies
description: The Next Generation in the famous Air Bud franchise is here!! This time it’s Air Bud’s five adorable puppies (The Buddies) and they’re off on a daring rescue mission to save their parents.

title: Alien Country
description: Reeling from the news of an unexpected pregnancy, Jimmy and Everly unknowingly release an alien invasion in their small town and learn to work together in order to save each other, their town and evidently, the entire galaxy.

title: Alien Hunter
description: In this sci-fi thriller, extraterrestrial and cryptology expert Julien Rome (Emmy winner James Spader) is brought in to investigate a mysterious alien object in Antarctica.

title: Alien Reign of Man
description: Earth has fallen! A small team of humans are stranded on an alien planet, light years from home. They must work together to battle aliens and activate a machine that will restore earth to a time before it was destroyed.

title: Aliens Abducted My Parents and Now I Feel Kinda Left Out
description: Itsy (Emma Tremblay) is the new girl in a small town, with dreams of returning to the big city to pursue her dream career as a journalist.

title: Aliens in the Attic
description: An adventure/comedy about kids on a family vacation who must fight off an attack by knee-high alien invaders with world-destroying ambitions. At the same time the youngsters try to keep their parents in the dark about the battle upstairs.

title: All Good Things
description: Two big-city teenage sisters are sent to their grandparents' farm for Christmas break against their wishes. While there, the sisters connect to their roots and help save the farm from foreclosure.

title: All Hallows’ Eve: Inferno
description: From an executive producer of Terrifier 2 comes All Hallows' Eve: Inferno, a new installment of the franchise that first introduced the world to Damien Leone's Art the Clown and the short film Terrifier.

title: All Hallows’ Eve: Trickster
description: When a lost traveler on Halloween night comes across an isolated rural gas station, she thinks she's found her way home. Unbeknownst to her, the eerie gas station is the residence of a family of degenerate, devilish creatures.

title: All Happy Families
description: The Landrys gather to fix up their family home. What begins as a benign family get-together ends up spiralling out of control.

title: All The Devil's Men
description: Jack Collins (Milo Gibson), a former Navy SEAL turned bounty hunter, tracks down terrorists in missions so hazardous that the CIA outsources them to private companies.

title: All the Old Knives
description: Two CIA agents and ex-lovers are brought back together years after a failed rescue attempt and forced to blur the lines between profession and passion in this deeply riveting tale of global espionage, moral dilemma and deadly betrayal.

title: Almost Love
description: Adam and Marklin’s 5-year relationship has gone from a passionate flame to a simmer, forcing them to reconcile with each other’s shortcomings while their friends endlessly search for love in New York City.

title: Aloha
description: A celebrated military contractor returns to the site of his greatest career triumphs and re-connects with a long-ago love while unexpectedly falling for the hard-charging Air Force watchdog assigned to him.

title: Alone In Berlin
description: Alone in Berlin sees a couple in Nazi Germany stand up to Hitler and the SS regime after their son is killed in action. By placing postcards around Berlin with revolutionary messages on, the Quangel's hope to rally other anti-Hitler supporters, and disrupt the slow creep of war.

title: Alpha & Omega
description: Kate and Humphrey are two wolves who are trying to get home after being taken by park rangers and shipped halfway across the country. Back home rival wolf packs are on the march and conflict is brewing. Only Kate and Humphrey can restore the peace...

title: Altitude
description: Five teenage friends – including rookie pilot Sara (Jessica Lowndes of TV's 90210) – rent a small plane for a weekend getaway. But shortly into the flight, something suddenly goes wrong. The instruments begin to malfunction. The plane won’t stop climbing.

title: Alvin and the Chipmunks
description: A struggling songwriter named Dave Seville finds success when he comes across a trio of singing chipmunks: mischievous leader Alvin, brainy Simon, and chubby, impressionable Theodore.

title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: Chipwrecked
description: The vacationing Chipmunks and Chipettes are turning a luxury cruise liner into their personal playground, until they become "chipwrecked" on a remote island.

title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Road Chip
description: Through a series of misunderstandings, Alvin, Simon and Theodore come to believe that Dave is going to propose to his new girlfriend in Miami... and dump them.

title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Squeakquel
description: The world famous singing pre-teen chipmunk trio return to contend with the pressures of school, celebrity, and a rival female music group known as The Chipettes.

title: American Dreamer
description: American Dreamer follows Phil Loder, an economics professor whose dream of homeownership seems impossible - until a widow offers him her estate for pennies in a life-changing twist.

title: Amsterdam
description: “Amsterdam” is an original crime epic about three friends at the center of a shocking secret plot.

title: An American Werewolf in London
description: Two American college students in London are bitten by a wolf with terrifying results -- one is killed while the other begins to have nightmares and starts to receive visits from his mutilated friend's ghost.

title: Anatomy of a Fall
description: When her husband Samuel is mysteriously found dead in the snow below their secluded chalet, Sandra becomes the main suspect when the police begin to question whether he fell or was pushed.

title: And So It Goes
description: A self-absorbed realtor enlists the help of his neighbor when he's suddenly left in charge of the granddaughter he never knew existed until his estranged son drops her off at his home.

title: Andromeda
description: Captain Dylan Hunt (Kevin Sorbo) and the crew of the Andromeda Ascendant set out on a mission to rebuild the Systems Commonwealth 300 years after its fall. Created by sci-fi legend Gene Roddenberry.

title: Another World
description: In a post-apocalyptic future, a biological warfare program gone wrong leaves only four survivors defending themselves from "the infected" - mindless killers. As they struggle to survive and make sense of what is happening, they find another survivor, intent on revealing the truth.

title: Anything
description: Grief-stricken over the recent death of his wife, Early Landry moves from Mississippi to Los Angeles in the hopes of starting a new life. Despite the objections of his overprotective sister, he moves into a run-down apartment complex in Hollywood...

title: Anything Else
description: Jerry Falk (Jason Biggs), a young writer in New York City, leaves his girlfriend for free-spirited Amanda (Christina Ricci). Seeking advice, Jerry turns to an older, struggling artist who helps him deal with his messy love life.

title: Apartment 1BR
description: What if your neighbours weren’t who you thought they were? After leaving behind a painful past to follow her dreams, Sarah lands the perfect Hollywood apartment.

title: Apex Predator
description: Let the hunt begin. Serving a life sentence for a crime he did not commit, Jim (Bruce Willis - Die Hard, McClane) is offered a chance of freedom. But the price of freedom could be his life as he finds himself face to face with the world’s greatest hunters…

title: Apocalypse Earth
description: When Earth is invaded by a militant alien race, soldiers and civilians are loaded onto arc-like spaceships, to flee to habitable planets beyond the galaxy. One such group of survivors lands on a mysterious and seemingly alluring planet, only to discover they're not alone.

title: Archenemy
description: Max Fist, who claims to be a hero from another dimension who fell through time and space to earth, where he has no powers.No one believes his stories except for a local teen named Hamster.

title: Arctic
description: Full of shock turns, moments of horrific injury, polar bear action and tense emotional scenes, Arctic will keep your hands clenched to your chair until its brilliant, breathless conclusion.

title: Are You Here
description: When Steve Dallas hears that his friend Ben Baker has lost his estranged father, the two return to Ben's childhood home to discover Ben has inherited the family fortune.

title: Armour of God
description: Asian Hawk (Jackie Chan) and his bumbling sidekick are sent on a quest through Europe to find a mysterious treasure held by a shadowy organisation of monks. Presented here in a Brand New Restoration.

title: Armour of God 2: Operation Condor
description: Jackie, a talented treasure hunter, is hired to recover 240 tonnes of gold that a German commander, Hans von Katterling, and his regiment buried in the Sahara Desert before the end of World War II.

title: Arranged
description: In "Arranged," three couples from different cultural backgrounds have one thing in common – the belief in arranged marriages. Viewers will follow each couple's relationship from the lead-up to their weddings through the months after.

title: Arrowhead
description: A tech is sprung from prison by a revolutionary leader who promises him an opportunity to save his father from a scheduled execution if he completes a data-stealing mission. But it goes awry, stranding him on a strange alien moon.

title: Ascension
description: In 1963, the U.S. government launched a covert space mission sending hundreds of men, women and children on a century-long voyage aboard the starship Ascension to populate a new world.

title: Astérix: Mansions of The Gods
description: In order to wipe out the Gaulish village, Caesar plans to have an estate built next to the village to start a new Roman colony.

title: At a Distance Spring is Green
description: The handsome son of a wealthy family, Yeo Joon (Park Ji Hoon) had what most people could only dream of having. Assigned to work together on a class project, Yeo Joon inexplicably finds himself drawn to his partner, Nam Soo Hyun (Bae In Hyuk).

title: At Eternity´s Gate
description: During a self-imposed exile in Arles and Auvers-Sur-Oise, France, Dutch painter Vincent van Gogh develops his unique, colorful style of painting.

title: ATM
description: After leaving their company Christmas Party together, David and Emily’s impromptu first date takes an unexpected turn when their co-worker, Corey, asks them to make a late-night stop at an ATM.

title: Attack of the Unknown
description: Like a cross between `Independence Day' and `Assault in Precinct 13'. A SWAT team transporting a high profile inmate through the streets of Los Angeles find themselves trapped inside a county detention centre as the world burns around them.

title: Automata
description: Fast forward fifty years into the future, planet earth is in the midst of gradual desertification. Mankind struggles to survive as the environment deteriorates and the slow regression of the human race begins in AUTÓMATA.

title: Awoken
description: A medical student attempts to cure her brother from a terminal sleep illness, but a more sinister reason for his condition is revealed.

title: Backtrace
description: Brought to you by the producers of 2 Guns and Escape Plan, action legend and three-time Academy Award® nominee Sylvester Stallone (Rocky, The Expendables) stars in this riveting crime thriller that hinges on memory, fury, and betrayal.

title: Bad Day for the Cut
description: A middle-aged Irish farmer, who still lives at home with his mother, sets off on a mission of revenge when the old lady is murdered.

title: Bad Ink
description: In "Bad Ink," tattoo artist Dirk Vermin and his sidekick Ruckus search out Sin City's most cringe-worthy tattoos and the strange stories behind them.

title: Bad Lieutenant
description: While investigating a young nun's rape, a corrupt New York City police detective, with a serious drug and gambling addiction, tries to change his ways and find forgiveness and redemption.

title: Bandidas
description: Two women become bank robbers to help the poor and seek revenge on a ruthless land baron.

title: Banksy Most Wanted
description: The infamous yet mystery graffiti artist Banksy has left his mark across the world. But behind the stunts, the stories and the political statements is one of art’s biggest unanswered questions... who is Banksy?

title: Barbie Dreamtopia
description: Join Barbie and Chelsea on magical adventures in Dreamtopia, as they transform into mermaids, fly over Sweetville with fairy bubble wings and take a ride on the back of the Elephant King of Sparkle Mountain.

title: Barbie Vlogs
description: Hey everyone, welcome to my vlog! I share information about my life, my inspirations and my favourite things! I love to do silly challenges with my friends Ken, Harper, and Ryan, and my sister Chelsea.

title: Barbie: Big City Big Dreams
description: Discover double the singing and double the fun in the all-new musical movie Barbie Big City, Big Dreams™.

title: Battle for Skyark
description: In the near future the earth has become desolate and dangerous. Now inhabited by by a mysterious race of creatures, humanity has been forced to find refuge in the Skyark, a man-made city in the sky.

title: Be Cool
description: John Travolta is back as Mafia loan shark turned Hollywood Producer Chili Palmer in this sharp sequel to "Get Shorty." With an unbelievably hip all-star cast that also includes Uma Thurman, André 3000, Steve Tyler, Christina Milian and The Rock, and bursting with the hottest music in the biz.

title: Bedazzled
description: Elliot Richards is a hapless young man consumed by unrequited love, and desperate to change his life, he makes a deal with the Devil who slyly promises to do just that - for a price.

title: Before Dawn
description: Jim Collins (Levi Miller), a young man from the outback, leaves his family-run sheep station to join the soldiers on the western front with hopes of making a difference. Soon, the realities of the muddy, ruthless, and entirely unforgiving war take their toll on a guilt-ridden Jim.

title: Behind The Line - Escape to Dunkirk
description: Occupied France, 1940. A Nazi Commander discovers one of his prisoners, Danny (Sam Gittins) is a champion boxer. He forces him to fight for his companies entertainment.

title: Belly of the Beast
description: In this action-packed flick, a former CIA agent (Steven Seagal) goes to Thailand to rescue his daughter from the clutches of an Islamic terrorist group.

title: Beneath Hill 60
description: A platoon of tunnelers fight to protect a tunnel system packed with enough explosives to change the course of the War.

title: Benjamin
description: Offering a recognisable vision of London, this sweet and intelligent film also stars Anna Chancellor (Four Weddings and a Funeral), Joel Fry (Game of Thrones) and Phénix Brossard (Riviera).

title: Benji: Off the Leash!
description: Lost on the streets of a small Mississippi town, Benji and some unlikely friends work together to rescue his sick mother, all the while evading two dopey dogcatchers.

title: Bernard
description: Bernard is a hapless anthropomorphic polar bear who always tries to fix the troubles that regularly occur in each episode, but only succeeds in doing even worse damage, often even physically hurting himself. The character does not speak, but expresses himself with gestures and noises.

title: Beyond the Sky
description: Chris is a filmmaker whose father was always convinced his own wife was abducted by Aliens and Chris now wants to expose the hoax about the alien abduction that destroyed his family.

title: Big Momma's House
description: FBI agent Malcolm Turner is known best for being a brilliant, master of disguise. Malcolm's latest assignment sends him to small-town Georgia, where he's assigned to trap a brutal bank robber who the FBI suspects will be coming down to visit his ex-girlfriend Sherry and her son.

title: Big Momma's House 2
description: Undercover Agent Malcolm Turner is back and this time he's out to expose the suspected designer of a deadly computer "worm" that would allow outside forces access to sophistical and critical government intelligence files.

title: Big Mommas: Like Father, Like Son
description: Big Momma is back — and this time he has big backup: his teenage stepson Trent (Brendan T. Jackson). Martin Lawrence returns as FBI agent Malcolm Turner and as Turner’s deep-cover alter-ego Big Momma.

title: Birdman
description: A black comedy that tells the story of an actor who struggles to mount a Broadway play. In the days leading up to opening night, he battles his ego and attempts to recover his family, his career, and himself.

title: Birth Days
description: An in-depth documentary series with gripping narratives and engaging characters, BIRTH DAYS captures the emotionally charged first days and weeks at home with the couple and their newborn.

title: Birth of the Dragon
description: In the world of martial arts, there is one man above all: Bruce Lee. San Francisco, 1965.

title: Black '47
description: Set in Ireland during the Great Famine, the drama follows an Irish Ranger who has been fighting for the British Army abroad, as he abandons his post to reunite with his family.

title: Black Bear
description: In search of solace at a remote lake house, a filmmaker pursues a new work of art through a calculated game of desire and jealousy.

title: Black Knight
description: The Middle Ages may never be the same after street smart Jamal Walker falls into a moat at the Medieval World theme park and finds himself transported back in time.

title: Black Warrant
description: A semi-retired special ops assassin and a DEA agent cross paths on separate missions to stop a cyber terrorist organization that has built a dangerous machine threatening to attack the power grid and bring catastrophe to the world.

title: Black Water
description: A faithful and longstanding CIA operative Wheeler (Jean-Claude Van Damme) has been drugged and brought aboard the Blackwater, a high security prison repurposed from a submarine.

title: Black Water: Abyss
description: Adventure-seeking couple, Eric and Jennifer convince their friends Yolanda and Viktor to explore an uncharted cave system in far North Australia, with the help of the unpredictable Cash as their guide.

title: Blair Witch
description: 20 years after his sister vanished in the Black Hills Forest while researching the legend of the Blair Witch, James and his friends venture into the forest in search of her.

title: Bleed for This
description: Based on the incredible true story of one of boxing's most charismatic and colourful champions, Bleed for This centres on Rhode Island native Vinny Pazienza (Miles Teller), AKA The Pazmanian Devil.

title: Bleeding Steel
description: Special Forces agent Lin Dong (Jackie Chan) becomes embroiled in a high-tech conspiracy as he attempts to protect a crucial witness. Just as he gets closer to discovering the truth, Lin Dong is lucky to escape with his life when he is pursued by a mysterious and heavily-armed militia.

title: Blind
description: Bestselling novelist, Bill Oakland loses his wife and his sight in a vicious car crash. Five years later Socialite Suzanne Dutchman is forced to read to Bill in an intimate room three times a week as a plea bargain for being associated with her husband's insider trading.

title: Blinky Bill The Movie
description: An adventurous young koala embarks on a journey across the wild and dangerous Australian outback in the hope of finding his missing father, but he soon discovers that there is more to being a hero than meets the eye.

title: Bliss
description: In this quirky love story, a divorced man meets a woman who is living on the streets and is convinced that the world around them is just a simulation.

title: Blitz
description: Jason Statham heads the cast of BLITZ as the tough, uncompromising and un-PC detective “Brant”, who is teamed with unlikely partner “Sgt Porter Nash” played by Paddy Considine to investigate a series of police murders.

title: Blood and Bone
description: Ex-marine and master martial artist Isaiah Bone (Michael Jai White), fresh out of prison, arrives on the inner-city streets of Los Angeles, looking to make his fortune in the underground fight scene.

title: Blood Ties
description: Violence erupts when two brothers on opposite sides of the law face off over organized crime in Brooklyn during the 1970's.

title: Bloodline
description: Violent thriller from the Producers of THE PURGE. New father (Seann William Scott), struggles to suppress his need for justice.

title: Bollywed
description: BOLLYWED is a heartwarming docu-series centred around the Singh Family, who have been operating the iconic bridal shop, Chandan Fashion, in Toronto’s Little India for the past 37 years.

title: Bonded by Blood 2
description: In the aftermath of the infamous 'Essex Boys' Range Rover killings, a group of younger, flashier criminals emerge to fill the power vacuum.

title: Bone Cold
description: A Black Ops sniper attempts to escape after a failed mission, tracked by enemy soldiers hellbent on revenge, and hunted by something monstrous.

title: Bonhoeffer
description: Bonhoeffer: Pastor. Spy. Assassin. As the world teeters on the brink of annihilation, Dietrich Bonhoeffer is swept into the epicenter of a deadly plot to assassinate Hitler.

title: Booker
description: In this "21 Jump Street" spin-off, a rebellious young cop becomes an insurance investigator for a multinational corporation. Starring Richard Grieco.

title: Boom & Reds
description: The Reds are tiny creatures who are part of a community that lives together in a tree belonging to a fantastic world. The Reds love to gather and draw pictures and in each chapter, the ogre Boom has to guess what the Reds are drawing on the ground.

title: Boon & Pimento
description: Boon (a lazy cat) and Pimento (a hyperactive rabbit) live in a quirky house in the middle of the desert. Fortunately, they have access to a website where they can order anything they want!

title: Borgen
description: Birgitte Nyborg fights for political survival, and her own ideals, in a cutthroat world of ambitious allies, opponents and media spinners.

title: Borley Rectory: The Awakening
description: In 1900, young Reverend Henry Bull and his sister, Kitty, are tasked with taking over the duties of their family home in Essex, a majestic Victorian mansion built on the site of an old monastery.

title: Borrowed Time: Lennon's Last Decade
description: A visionary documentary exploring the final decade of John Lennon's life in extraordinary detail.

title: Bottoms
description: In this refreshingly outspoken and raunchy comedy, two unpopular girls in their senior year of high school start a fight club to try to impress and hook up with cheerleaders. And their bizarre plan works! But are they in over their heads?

title: Boy Makes Girl
description: After the death of his mother, a software programmer on the autistic spectrum follows his own logic in creating a robot to help care for his mother’s final unruly nursing client…

title: Braven
description: When Joe Braven, a humble logger residing along the U.S./Canada border, is confronted by a group of deadly drug runners in his secluded cabin in the mountains, he must do everything in his power to protect his family.

title: Brazil
description: In the retro-future world, a government bureaucrat tries to correct an administrative error and quickly finds himself an enemy of the state.

title: Breathless
description: Unhinged comedy-thriller starring Gina Gershon, Wayne Duvall, Val Kilmer and Ray Liotta. After killing her bank-robber husband, a Texas housewife must dispose of the body and find his loot whilst avoiding the local sheriff.

title: Brides of Beverly Hills
description: Brides of Beverly Hills follows the day to day antics of bridal salon owner Renee Strauss and her colourful team of stylists as they cater to the most discerning of brides.

title: Brighton
