description: Derek, Dinah, Dave and Doreen are two retired couples who return to the seaside resort of Brighton after an absence of 40 years in an uproarious attempt to relive their youth. A chance meeting brings up old rivalries and lead to a hilarious clash between the old world and the new.

title: Bring It On
description: In this classic teen comedy packed with energy and sharp humour, a champion high school cheerleading squad discovers its previous captain stole all their best routines, and now must scramble to compete at this year's championships. Starring Kirsten Dunst.

title: Brothers
description: Brothers tells the powerful story of two siblings, thirty-something Captain Sam Cahill and younger brother Tommy Cahill, who are polar opposites.

title: Buckley's Chance
description: With the help of a wayward dingo, a young boy must journey through the Australian outback to find his way home to his grandfather (Bill Nighy).

title: Bugged
description: Follow our hero Murphy in his doomed quest to capture the ultimate prize: a bug called Puck. But, for Murphy, nothing ever works the way it should and he has big competition: Blat Jack, a super bounty hunter. Everything that can go wrong will go wrong! Relive the glory days of burlesque cartoons!

title: Bull Shark
description: When a young female swimmer is found eaten alive by the Sheriff, Spencer must track down and kill whatever is responsible for her murder – in this case, a hungry Bull Shark that has been brought up from the Texas coast by a local fisherman.

title: Ca$h
description: After a down-and-out couple finds a briefcase of money that solves all their problems, a menacing stranger forces them to commit a series of armed robberies to pay it all back.

title: Cage Dive
description: CAGE DIVE follows three friends from California who set out to film an audition tape for submission to an extreme reality game show. To ensure they stand out, they decide to travel to Australia where they will be documenting themselves taking part in a most extreme activity…Shark Cage Diving.

title: Calm With Horses
description: Douglas 'Arm' Armstrong has become the feared enforcer for the drug-dealing Devers family, whilst also trying to be a good father. Torn between these two families, Arm's loyalties are tested when he is asked to kill for the first time.

title: Camp X-Ray
description: Hoping to escape her small town roots and make a difference in the world, a young woman joins the military and is soon assigned a guard position at Guantanamo Bay. Surrounded by hostility on both sides of the fence, she discovers her mission is far from the black and white ideal she expected.

title: Can You Keep A Secret?
description: On a return flight from a botched client meeting, Emma reveals all of her deepest secrets to a handsome stranger when her plane hits turbulence and she believes she is going to die. Emma thinks she will never see the guy again.

title: Canopy
description: Wartime, 1942. Singapore. An Australian fighter pilot shot down in combat awakens suspended in the treetops. As night devours day, he must navigate through the heart of a war-torn jungle, abruptly abandoning hope of victory in favour of a search for sanctuary.

title: Car City Universe
description: Welcome to Car City, where cars and trucks live happily together. Follow the adventures of Tom the Tow Truck, always ready to help his friends,

title: Cara
description: Cara, a mentally troubled woman escaped from an institution, believes in a conspiracy against her. She plans horrific acts using her show's viewers, exploring mental health, abuse, and violence, leaving a disturbing trail.

title: Carrie
description: A sheltered high school girl unleashes her newly developed telekinetic powers after she is pushed too far by her peers.

title: Cash Out
description: Professional thief Mason attempts his biggest heist with his brother, robbing a bank. When it goes wrong, they're trapped inside surrounded by law enforcement. Tension rises as Mason negotiates with his ex-lover, the lead negotiator.

title: Casino Jack
description: CASINO JACK lays bare the wild excesses and escapades of Jack Abramoff (Kevin Spacey), a man hell- bent on acquiring all that the good life has to offer.

title: Catfish
description: Film-makers Ariel Schulman and Henry Joost sense a story unfolding as they begin to film the life of Ariel’s brother, Nev. They have no idea that their project will lead to the most exhilarating and unsettling months of their lives as they unravel an intriguing Facebook mystery.

title: Cell
description: When a mysterious cell phone signal causes apocalyptic chaos, an artist is determined to reunite with his young son in New England.

title: Champions
description: Champions' is a documentary series in which three generations of footballers, a senior, a current top player and a promising future player, come together in a unique experience to talk about what unites them: their passion for football.

title: Chaos
description: Two cops, a rookie and a grizzled vet, pursue an accomplished bank robber.

title: Charming
description: A hilarious and music filled animation from the producer of 'Shrek'.

title: Chef
description: When Chef Carl Casper suddenly quits his job at a prominent Los Angeles restaurant, he is left to figure out what’s next. Finding himself in Miami, he teams up with his ex-wife, his friend and his son to launch a food truck.

title: Child 44
description: When Leo Demidov, a war hero but now disgraced member of the military police, uncovers evidence of a serial killer, he must work against the all-powerful Soviet regime in order to track him down before he strikes again.

title: Child's Play
description: A contemporary re-imagining of the 1988 horror classic, Child's Play follows Karen, a single mother who gifts her son Andy a Buddi doll, unaware of its sinister nature. When the doll suddenly takes on a life of its own, Andy unites with other neighborhood children to stop the maniacal toy.

title: China Aspirations
description: After China’s 20th National Congress, the country’s roadmap for the future has been the main focus of the international community.  China Aspirations offers a fresh interpretation of how China’s change over the years is set to shape its vision for the future.

title: China through the Lenses
description: China through the Lenses is a documentary which tells stories from the perspective of foreign photographers who came to the People’s Republic of China in different periods.

title: Chosen
description: The year is 1944 and the Jews of Eastern Europe are being massacred by the thousands.

title: Cinderella and Four Knights
description: Ha Won (Park So Dam) loses her mother in a tragic accident, and her father remarries. When her cruel stepmother moves in with them, she steals Ha Won’s college funds.

title: City of Lies
description: A journalist follows a disgraced LAPD detective obsessed with discovering the truth behind the murders of Tupac Shakur and the Notorious B.I.G., and possibly bites off more than he can chew.

title: Class Rank
description: CLASS RANK is a funny and touching coming-of-age drama in the vein of Election, Easy A or Legally Blonde, from the director of Glee...

title: Classic Quotes by Xi Jinping
description: Through quotes from ancient Chinese literature, CGTN brings an entirely new avenue to discover the stories behind the classics and discuss the cultural foundation of the Chinese. The series will help viewers understand the Chinese wisdom to govern an evolving nation.

title: Claw
description: Two friends forced to spend the night in a ghost town find themselves hunted by a prehistoric predator.

title: Cleaner
description: Crime thriller starring Samuel L. Jackson as Tom Cutler, a former cop who now works as a professional crime scene cleaner. When he's called to sanitise a suburban home after what appears to be a routine homicide, Tom later discovers he may have unknowingly helped cover up a murder.

title: Clink
description: A drama set in the fictional women’s prison Bridewell, "Clink" focuses on the emotional heart of a community of women who are forced to confront their own realities.

title: Close Range
description: A rogue soldier turned outlaw is thrust into a relentless fight with a corrupt sheriff, his obedient deputies, and a dangerous drug cartel in order to protect his sister and her young daughter.

title: Coherence
description: Eight friends gather for a dinner party to watch a passing comet. Unbeknownst to them, this beautiful, once-in-a-lifetime astrological event is about to set off a catastrophic chain of events.

title: Cold Brook
description: One fateful evening, after working late hours at the museum, two maintenance workers see a man standing silently near a Civil War exhibit. Despite chasing him away, each night he returns.

title: Cold Skin
description: A young man who arrives at a remote island finds himself trapped in a battle for his life.

title: Colin And Justin's Home Heist
description: Hang on to your knickers…  Because Britain’s most outrageous decorating duo is determined to overhaul the country’s tackiest interiors...  And teach Canadians a thing or two about good design!

title: Coming home in the dark
description: A family's outing descends into terror when teacher Alan Hoaganraad, his wife Jill and stepsons Maika and Jordon explore an isolated coastline. An unexpected meeting with a pair of drifters thrusts the family into a nightmare when they find themselves captured.

title: Conan The Barbarian
description: The most legendary Barbarian of all time is back. A quest that begins as a personal vendetta for the fierce Cimmerian warrior soon turns into an epic battle against hulking rivals, horrific monsters, and impossible odds, as Conan realizes he is the only hope of saving the great nations of Hyboria.

title: Condor's Nest
description: A decade after the fall of Nazi Germany, an American aviator travels across South America in search of war criminals.

title: Containment
description: Neighbors in an apartment complex realize they were sealed inside by strangers in hazmat suits. The quarantined startturning against each other in an adrenaline-fuelled fight for survival.

title: Continuum
description: After the disappearance of a young scientist on a business trip, his son and wife struggle to cope, only to make a bizarre discovery years later - one that may bring him home.

title: Cooking with Love
description: Hardworking & optimistic television producer, Kelly, doesn’t have time for love. Along with her mentor Amanda, Kelly dives into another season of the Little Gourmet, a kids cooking show, when hot-headed Chef Stephen is dropped into Kelly’s life as a last minute replacement host.

title: Corneil & Bernie
description: Bernie, an eccentric teenager meets Corneil, a dog of exceptional intelligence. The dog is the brain of the two and has to continuously save his dogsitter from the trouble he lands himself in.

title: Crash
description: Los Angeles residents who live vastly separate lives collide in interweaving stories of race, loss and redemption.

title: Crazy Beautiful Weddings
description: Follow Wedding Planner Lynzie Kent as she and her team create one-of-a-kind wedding celebrations that capture the true spirit, personality and unique love story of every couple they work with.

title: Crossfire
description: Jonas ‘Malo’ Moldanado (Curtis ‘50 Cent’ Jackson) is a fresh faced recruit in the NYPD, taken under the wing of a corrupt police chief Sarcone (Robert DeNiro) Malo get dragged deeper and deeper into a world of drugs, violence and crime.

title: Curtain Call
description: Ja Geum Soon (Go Doo Shim) was born in 1930 in what is now North Korea. When the Korean War broke out in the 1950s, she escaped to what is now South Korea – and was torn away from her husband and young child.

title: Céline
description: Céline tells the unforgettable love story of one of the most compelling celebrity couples of all time and chronicles the rise to fame of the world's greatest pop superstar.

title: D13: District 13
description: Paris, 2013. Elite officer and martial arts expert Damien faces his most dangerous mission: recovering a weapon of mass destruction stolen by a powerful gang in the walled-off District 13.

title: Danger Zone
description: An American mining engineer (Billy Zane, "Titanic") gets involved in a civil war and international conspiracy in Africa. Featuring Robert Downey Jr.

title: Daniel's Gotta Die
description: After his father dies, Daniel Powell travels to the Cayman Islands to try to reconnect with the rest of his family. His plan hits a snag though when his siblings decide to try to kill him for his inheritance. Trapped, he'll learn what family means - even if it kills him.

title: Dark Signal
description: Deep in the heart of the isolated Welsh valleys, an eerie hush spreads throughout the deserted wilds. Stranded and terrified, single mother, Kate, finds herself entangled in an ill-thought-out plan: a midnight robbery about to take a dangerous turn.

title: Darkness Falls
description: After his wife's suicide, Detective Jeff Anderson becomes convinced that she has been murdered. Obsessed with his investigation, he finds out that his wife was the victim of a team of father-and-son serial killers and sets out to stop them.

title: Darkness of Man
description: An Interpol operative is assigned to protect young Jayden, the son of an informant killed in a routine raid gone wrong. Years later, he finds himself once again protecting Jayden from a group of merciless gangs in an all-out turf war.

title: Date Movie
description: Hopeless romantic Julia Jones (Alyson Hannigan), has finally met the man of her dreams, the very British Grant Funkyerdoder (Adam Campbell).

title: Daybreakers
description: As the human population nears extinction, vampires must capture and farm every remaining human, or find a blood substitute before time runs out. However, a covert group of vampires makes a remarkable discovery, one which has the power to save the human race.

title: Dead Man Down
description: When the body of a gang member is discovered in the freezer of crime boss Alphonse's (Terrence Howard) mansion - a clear message has been sent… or has it?

title: Dead Zone
description: An elite team of soldiers who, to stop the collapse of humanity, descend on a radiation-poisoned town and perform the ultimate stealth mission using high-tech armor and weapons.

title: Dear Zoe
description: When Tess and her family suffer an unimaginable loss, she finds support from a surprising source: her biological father - a lovable slacker from the wrong side of the tracks - and the charming but dangerous juvenile delinquent next door.

title: Death of Me
description: A dream vacation in the South Pacific becomes a torturous nightmare in Death of Me, a high stakes horror from director Darren Lynn Bousman.

title: Deep Space
description: Two years ago, a deep space mining vessel went dark and has been drifting through space since. Though the suspicion is that the crew killed each other, what truly happened is a mystery and why they would kill each other even less clear.

title: Demonic
description: A group of teenage ghost hunters travel to a supposedly haunted house in an attempt to summon spirits from the dead. After performing a Seance, something goes drastically wrong and they are violently killed over the course of the night.

title: Demonic
description: Demonic is a supernatural possession horror which follows a young woman who unleashes a terrifying demon as she enters the mind of her comatose, serial killer mother...

title: Derailed
description: On a hijacked train carrying bio-weapons, a secret agent (action icon Jean-Claude Van Damme) must become a one-man army to stop the terrorists and save everyone on board.

title: Destination Wedding
description: Forced to tolerate each other for a few days, two cynical wedding guests strike an unexpected alliance.

title: Detachment
description: A substitute teacher who drifts from classroom to classroom finds a connection to the students and teachers during his latest assignment.

title: Diplo: The Mighty Dinosaur
description: When his vibrant jungle home begins to vanish into a strange, colourless void, Diplo, a small but courageous young Diplodocus, sets out on a daring quest across time and space to uncover the truth behind the mysterious force stealing their world.

title: Discovering Canary Islands
description: Discovering Islands is an adventure reality series that uncovers some of the most incredible and extraordinary myths in the world by totally immersing the contestants in local culture and traditions.

title: Dog Days
description: “What is it about dogs that brings us so much joy?”  Lives are about to change forever, when human and canine paths intertwine in sunny Los Angeles. There’s Elizabeth, a news anchor in her 30’s, who not only having to deal with a bad breakup, is struggling to cheer up her depressed dog Sam.

title: Don't Say A Word
description: When Dr. Nathan Conrad's daughter is kidnapped, a secret held by one of his catatonic patients may be his only hope.

title: Double Blind
description: After a drug trial goes wrong, seven test subjects learn that falling asleep means death. Trapped in a remote facility, panic sets in as they turn on each other. Claire must lead the group, find a way out, and stay awake to survive.

title: Dragons Forever
description: Three successful Hong Kong lawyers are hired by a chemical company of questionable ethics and must eventually make a difficult decision when their employer's motives become clear.

title: Drift
description: In '70s Australia, two brothers battle killer waves, small town prejudice, and a ruthless biker gang to kick start the modern surf industry.

title: Drive
description: DRIVE is the story of a Hollywood stunt driver by day (Ryan Gosling), a loner by nature, who moonlights as a top-notch getaway driver-for-hire in the criminal underworld. He finds himself a target for some of LA's most dangerous men after agreeing to aid the husband of his beautiful neighbour.

title: Drive Angry
description: Milton is mad, bad and Hell-bent on achieving his goal. He’s breaking all the rules, but what are they gonna do – not let him back in?

title: Due Justice
description: An attorney with a military past hunts down the gang who killed his wife and took his daughter.

title: Earth to Echo
description: Tuck, Munch and Alex are a trio of inseparable friends who long for adventure. One day the boys find a cryptic signal on their phones and convinced that it is part of something bigger they set out on a quest to find the source.

title: East West 101
description: “East West 101” centers on Zane Malik — a brilliant detective whose ability to connect with people helps him solve crimes. Malik is an Arab and proud of it, but as a Muslim detective in a post-9/11 world where just to be an Arab is to arouse suspicion and fear.

title: Edge of War
description: A series of incidents around the world lead to greater conflict, placing the superpowers at one another's throats. Armies march, bombs rain down, soldiers storm the beaches. One family is caught up in the conflict, can they survive as total war is declared and nuclear weapons are unleashed?

title: Eismayer
description: Inspired by true events, David Wagner's acclaimed drama EISMAYER tells the story of a secretly gay Military officer whose tough façade conceals a clandestine double life.

title: El Gringo
description: An American crosses the border into Mexico with a bullet in his arm and $2.3 million in cash, looking to head to Acapulco and retire on the beach. But he discovers quickly that executing his plan is easier said than done.

title: Eliminators
description: Martin Parker (Scott Adkins), a highly trained former DEA agent, is hiding in the witness protection program in London with his young daughter, Carly. His world is turned upside down when a group of thugs break into his home looking for hidden contraband.

title: Ellie and Abbie (and Ellie's Dead Aunt)
description: School captain Ellie (Sophie Hawkshaw) has a serious crush on her classmate Abbie (Zoe Terakes), and is worrying over inviting her to the Year 12 formal.

title: Emperor
description: Emperor, the son of an African king and a slave on an American plantation, can no longer tolerate the atrocities committed by whites against blacks.

title: Empire State
description: A New Yorker, takes up a job as a security with the Empire State Armoured Truck Company after failing to secure a job with the NYPD. After discovering that he is able to use his position to his advantage, he is drawn into an elaborate scheme to rob his company, resulting in the largest cash heist.

title: Enchantimals: City Tails Main Street
description: Sage and Patter are reunited with their friends in Wonderwood City, and they’ve just discovered a whole new place to explore in Main Street! Join the Enchantimals as they encounter a baking showdown, facing fears at the doctor's office, baby besties on the loose, and an epic bestie balloon chase!​

title: Enchantimals™ Tales from Everwilde
description: Meet the Enchantimals and their animal besties.

title: End of days
description: Arnold plays hard-luck ex-cop Jericho Cane, who unwittingly finds himself caught in a terrifying struggle between the human Incarnation of evil and an innocent young woman chosen to be the mother of the Antichrist!

title: Enemy Within
description: When a Japanese fighter pilot crash-lands on the tiny remote Hawaiian island of Ni'ihau, he is met with courtesy and traditional Hawaiian hospitality from the locals.

title: Enhanced
description: A young woman with enhanced abilities finds herself hunted down by a sinister government organization. But when an even stronger enhanced serial killer emerges on the scene, agents and mutants are forced to question their allegiances.

title: Enigma
description: March 1943 and the heroic code breakers at Bletchley Park face their worst nightmare when Nazi U Boats unexpectedly change their communication codes, placing an allied ship with 10,000 passengers in lethal danger.

title: Epic Movie
description: Two of the warped writers of Scary Movie now set their parodic sights on the largest genre of them all: Hollywood’s big-budget, special effects-laden, blockbuster franchise films.

title: Escape Plan
description: When a structural-security authority finds himself incarcerated in a prison he designed, he has to put his skills to escape and find out who framed him.

title: Escape Plan 2
description: Years after Ray Breslin fought his way out of the escape-proof prison called "The Tomb," he's organized a new top-notch, for-hire security force. But when one of his team members goes missing he must now decipher a way to break into the world's best hidden prison...

title: Escape Plan 3
description: The third and final installment of the unstoppable franchise, Escape Plan 3 sees screen legend Sylvester Stallone (The Expendables) kick this explosive action tale into high gear.

title: Escape Room
description: To celebrate his 30th Birthday, Tyler and his friends try out the latest in harmless fun, locking themselves in an exclusive escape room loaded with ominous clues. With their time ticking away, the group notices that the mysterious puzzles are becoming increasingly difficult and increasingly deadly.

title: Evening
description: An all-star cast of the greatest actresses of our time - including Vanessa Redgrave, Meryl Streep, Toni Collette, Claire Danes, Natasha Richardson and Glenn Close - come together in this passionate and heartwarming story.

title: Evidence
description: A terrifying take on found-footage-horror, this chilling film revolves around a team of detectives (Stephen Moyer: True Blood and Radha Mitchell: London has Fallen), who attempt to piece together what happened at the scene of a brutal massacre...

title: EVO
description: From the hottest supercars to everyday rides, this series explores every car that graces the road — all for the thrill of driving.

title: Facing Ali
description: Ten boxers who faced legendary champion Muhammad Ali in the ring recount their epic battles against the world champion. With George Foreman, Joe Frazier, Ken Norton, more.

title: Fair Game
description: FAIR GAME is a riveting action-thriller based on the autobiography of real-life undercover CIA operative VALERIE PLAME (Naomi Watts), whose career was destroyed and marriage strained to its limits when her covert identity was exposed by a politically motivated press leak.

title: Fanboys
description: A group of Star Wars fans travel to Skywalker Ranch to steal a copy of "The Phantom Menace" so that their terminally ill friend can see it before it's released in cinemas several months later.

title: Fast Food Nation
description: The hit satirical mockumentary taking a deep dive into the health issues and social consequences of America's love affair with fast food.

title: Fast Forward
description: Fast Forward is a five-episode documentary series that looks into the future through emerging technologies aimed to tackle some of the most vital challenges that the world is facing today.

title: Fear of Rain
description: Fear of Rain is a twisty, unsettling and terrifying horror thriller starring Katherine Heigl (Knocked Up, Firefly Lane), Madison Iseman (Jumanji franchise, Annabelle Comes Home) and Harry Connick Jr. (PS. I Love You), that will keep you guessing whether there is real horror hiding next door.

title: Fear the Night
description: Follows Iraqi war veteran Tess, as she prepares to strike back after a group of home invaders attack during her sister's bachelorette party, and she discovers that they are hellbent on not leaving any witnesses behind.

title: Fighting Demons
description: Ex-boxer and former alcoholic, Vian, just got out of prison after serving time for a fatal accident and is desperate for a fresh start. He moves in with his sister Bethley and her son with the understanding that he will not drink at all.

title: Film Stars Don't Die In Liverpool
description: Liverpool, 1978: What starts as a vibrant affair between a legendary femme fatale, the eccentric Academy Award®-winning actress Gloria Grahame, and her young lover, British actor Peter Turner (Bell), quickly grows into a deeper relationship, with Turner being the person Gloria turns to for comfort.

title: Filth
description: Bruce Robertson, a bigoted and corrupt policeman, is in line for a promotion and will stop at nothing to get what he wants. Enlisted to solve a brutal murder and threatened by the aspirations of his colleagues, Bruce sets about ensuring their ruin.

title: Firehouse Dog
description: Hollywood's most pampered pooch gets lost during a commercial shoot and ends up as the mascot for a local fire station.

title: Flight 7500
description: A flight from Los Angeles to Tokyo is rocked by turbulence—and a terrifying force is unleashed in this spine-chilling journey into fear from the director of The Grudge.

title: Flypaper
description: A man caught in the middle of two simultaneous robberies at the same bank desperately tries to protect the teller with whom he's secretly in love.

title: Fog of War
description: At the height of World War II, an American pilot is ordered to spy on his fiancée's family who are suspected of being traitors. Starring John Cusack.

title: Forever In My Heart
description: Jenna and Charlie found love in Ireland but their dreams drove them apart. Five years later, they reunite and Jenna has to decide where her heart belongs—back home or in the Emerald Isle.

title: Forever Lulu
description: A schizophrenic romantic tracks down her college sweetheart to help her find their son, given up for adoption, much to the dismay of his new wife. Starring Melanie Griffith and Patrick Swayze

title: Fortress
description: Fortress is an all-out-action cyber thriller from the producers of Lone Survivor and The Irishman and starring the action powerhouse Bruce Willis, Escape Plan II’s Jesse Metcalfe, One Tree Hill’s Chad Michael Murray and Shannen Doherty (90210, Charmed).

title: Frank & Penelope
description: A tale of love and violence when a man on his emotional last legs finds a savior seductively dancing in a run-down strip club. And a life most certainly headed off a cliff suddenly becomes redirected - as EVERYTHING is now worth dying for.

title: Free Birds
description: On a quaint, family-owned farm, a giant turkey flock lives a quiet, corn-stuffed life. All everyone cares about is feeding time and grazing in the sun and being in “Turkey Paradise.” Everyone, that is, except for Reggie, a whipsmart turkey who is an outcast among his flock.

title: Freeheld
description: Diagnosed with terminal cancer, decorated New Jersey detective Laurel Hester (Julianne Moore) wishes to leave her pension benefits to domestic partner Stacie Andree (Elliot Page).

title: From A House On Willow Street
description: For desperate petty crooks Hazel and her boyfriend Ade, kidnapping is their last chance to finally get a normal life. Their well-chosen target: a filthy rich diamond distributor's young and innocent daughter. For this reason, after six weeks of careful and meticulous planning...

title: Frozen Ground
description: An Alaska State Trooper partners with a young woman who escaped the clutches of serial killer Robert Hansen to bring the murderer to justice. Based on actual events.

title: G-Loc
description: In a world on the brink of environmental collapse, mass migration to neighbouring planet, Rhea, is humanity's final hope for survival.

title: Gambit
description: Harry Deane is a man with a plan. Art curator for media tycoon Lord Lionel Shahbandar, Harry devises an elaborate plot to con Shahbandar into purchasing a fake Monet painting.

title: Genius
description: Nicole Kidman and Colin Firth star in this stirring drama about the friendship between Thomas Wolfe and editor Maxwell Perkins (who discovered F. Scott Fitzgerald and Ernest Hemingway).

title: Ghoster
description: An inquisitive girl and her father must unravel the secrets of Echoville Manor which has held the world's cutest spirit Ghoster captive for 50 years, before Yuto the ghost dragon wipes them all out in his quest for immortality.

title: Giant Little Ones
description: Franky and Ballas have been best friends since childhood. They are high school royalty: handsome, stars of the swim team and popular with girls. They live a perfect teenage life – until the night of Franky's 17th birthday party, when they're involved in an incident that changes their lives forever.

title: Girl Most Likely
description: Kristen Wiig stars as Imogene, once a promising young New York playwright whose promise has fizzled, thanks to a crisis of confidence. Heavily in denial about being dumped by her society boyfriend, Imogene uses her skill for drama to stage an elaborate fake suicide as an appeal for his sympathy.

title: Girls Girls Girls
description: Best friends Mimmi and Ronkko discover the highs and lows of love and desire when they find themselves welcomed into a new social circle. Whilst Mimmi experiences the earth moving effects of first love, Ronkko is on a quest to find pleasure.

title: Glassland
description: John returns home one morning to find his mother, Jean, unconscious from an alcohol overdose.  When Jean is offered an opportunity to recover, John is forced to offer his services to a petty criminal to help pay for his mother’s rehab.

title: Global Child - Travel with Purpose
description: Augusto explores the world through the best experiences as he shares uplifting life lessons with global friends.

title: Gloria Bell
description: Gloria (Julianne Moore) is a free-spirited divorcée who spends her days at a straight-laced office job and her nights on the dance floor, joyfully letting loose at clubs around Los Angeles. After meeting Arnold (John Turturro) on a night out, she finds herself thrust into an unexpected new romance.

title: Glumpers
description: The Glumpers are a gang of friends who live together in their home which becomes a kind of nuclear reactor where even a small interaction between its particles can cause a chain reaction with disastrous consequences.

title: God's Own Country
description: Johnny Saxby (Josh O'Connor) works long hours on his family's remote farm in the north of England. He numbs the daily frustration of his lonely existence with nightly binge-drinking at the local pub and casual sex.

title: God's Soldier
description: An Orphaned Child with a price on her head seeks refuge in a Chapel run by a beautiful Nun, but all is not what it seems. High Octane action as they flee the clutches of a Rogue CIA Agent.

title: Good Luck Chuck
description: Meet Charlie Logan, he's a good luck charm and women are guaranteed to find true love after they sleep with him.  But what seems like a blessing feels like a curse when he meets Cam, the girl of his dreams.

title: Good People
description: A debt-ridden couple take the cash they find in a dead tenant’s apartment. But they soon become the target of a deadly adversary – the thief who stole it.

title: Goodbye Lover
description: In sun-dappled Los Angeles, sly, sexy and unscrupulous Sandra Dunmore zealously pursues a much bigger piece of the good life. On the way up Sandra may have to step on a few toes--in her stiletto heels. But that doesn't make her bad.

title: Gook
description: Eli and Daniel, two Korean American brothers, own a struggling shoe store and have an unlikely friendship with Kamilla, a street wise 11-year-old African American girl. Kamilla ditches school, Eli stresses about the store, and Daniel tries to have a good time.

title: Gordon Ramsay's Passion for Flavour
description: The superstar chef as never seen before – not the renowned hothead – but the thoughtful young chef who caught the attention of the world with his extraordinary talent and personality.

title: Gosford Park
description: In 2001, Robert Altman (MASH, The Long Goodbye) took the unexpected step into Agatha Christie territory with Gosford Park, a murder-mystery whodunit set in an English country house starring a host of British acting greats and with an Oscar-winning screenplay by Downton Abbey creator Julian Fellowes.

title: Gotti
description: GOTTI follows infamous crime boss John Gotti’s rise to become the “Teflon Don” of the Gambino Crime Family in New York City. Spanning three decades and recounted by his son John Jr., GOTTI examines Gotti’s tumultuous life as her and his wife attempt to hold the family together...

title: Gracie and Pedro: Mission Impossible
description: Meet Gracie and Pedro, two family pets who couldn't be more different. Gracie is a purebred pampered pooch, whilst Pedro is a brazen, rescue cat, and their brawling is about to have disastrous consequences!

title: Grave Halloween
description: Miko and her college friends head into Suicide Forest. Filming their journey, strange things start to happen; angry murmurs and sightings of ghosts warn there are those who do not want them there.

title: Greener Grass
description: GREENER GRASS is a hilariously deadpan hellscape of competitive suburbia with a boldly stylized absurdist chain of events that unfurls with increasing fervour after one soccer mom gifts another her infant daughter just to be polite.

title: Gretel & Hansel
description: A long time ago in a distant fairytale countryside, a young girl (Sophia Lillis) leads her little brother (newcomer Samuel J. Leakey) into a dark wood in desperate search of food and work, only to stumble upon a nexus of terrifying evil.

title: Guardians of the Tomb
description: An innocent discovery of a well-preserved mummified Emperor from 200 B.C. China unearths a two thousand-year-old nightmare, a secret that should have remained buried.

title: Guess Who
description: A sarcastic father (Bernie Mac) has plenty to say about his daughter wanting to marry a white boy (Ashton Kutcher).

title: Gunner
description: When ruthless drug traffickers kidnap his children, ex-special forces operative Lee Gunner embarks on a violent life-or-death mission. With his unique skills and nothing to lose, he'll take on an army to bring his family home.

title: Guy Ritchie's The Covenant
description: Guy Ritchie’s The Covenant follows US Army Sergeant John Kinley (Jake Gyllenhaal) and Afghan interpreter Ahmed (Dar Salim). After an ambush, Ahmed goes to Herculean lengths to save Kinley’s life.

title: HairStyle, The Talent Show
description: ‘HairStyle, The Talent Show’ is a new hairstyling format created by Shine Iberia (A Banijay Company) in which 10 of the nation's top hairstylists compete in a series of cut, color and styling challenges to become the next big name in the USA hairstyling industry.

title: Halloween
description: Michael Myers is released from the mental institution where he was committed for 17 years, and goes on a rampage to find his younger sister. No one is safe. Remake of the 1978 film directed by John Carpenter.

title: Hamburger Hill
description: The men of Bravo Company are facing a battle that's all uphill… up Hamburger Hill. Fourteen war-weary soldiers are battling for a mud-covered mound of earth so named because it chews up soldiers like chopped meat. They are fighting for their country, their fellow soldiers and their lives.

title: Handsome Devil
description: Ned, the bullied outsider, and Conor, a new boy and star athlete, are forced to room together at their cloistered boarding school. Conor is drafted into the senior rugby team, whose actions dominate school life and whose privilege and entitlement have made Ned's life to date at the school a misery.

title: Hangman
description: Decorated homicide detective Ray Archer (Al Pacino) partners with criminal profiler Will Ruiney (Karl Urban) to catch one of the city's notoriously vicious serial killers, who is playing a twisted version of murder inspired by the children's game Hangman.

title: Hara-Kiri: Death of a Samurai
description: A poverty-stricken Samurai seeks revenge after discovering his friend's fate, igniting a tense showdown against the House of a feudal lord.

title: Harold & Kumar Get the Munchies
description: Harold & Kumar Get the Munchies is a hilarious, outrageous road trip. Our heroes go on an epic journey they’ll never remember, to get a burger they’ll never forget. In one wild night, they’ll go further, stoop lower and get higher than ever before!

title: Haunt
description: An introvert teen befriends his new neighbor, and together the couple begin to explore the haunted house that his family has just purchased.

title: Havoc
description: A group of wealthy Los Angeles teenagers try to become part of the "gangsta" lifestyle but soon run into trouble when they come face to face with a real gang of Latino drug dealers.

title: Heartbreakers
description: Max and Page are a mother and daughter con team with a devious routine. Max targets wealthy men, lures them into marriage and then Page seduces them, leaving Max to discover their infidelity and reap the huge divorce settlements which tide them over until they target their next victim.

title: Heartless
description: This gritty Faustian tale set in the East End of London follows Jamie, a troubled young man with a birthmark on his face, which has left him feeling isolated and fearful, hiding from the world outside. He lives in the East End of London, an area notorious for its violent hooded gangs.

title: Heathers: The Musical
description: Based on the 1989 cult classic film starring Winona Ryder and Christian Slater, and recorded live in its original London home, The Other Palace.

title: Hector and the Search for Happiness
description: Hector is an eccentric yet irresistible London psychiatrist in crisis: his patients are just not getting any happier. He’s going nowhere. Then one day, armed with buckets of courage and an almost child like curiosity child-curiosity...

title: Heidi: Rescue of the Lynx
description: When eight-year-old Heidi finds and rescues an injured lynx cub from a trap, she names him Pepper and secretly nurses him back to health. But as the cub's playful antics draw unwanted attention, Heidi learns of industrial plans that threaten not just the cub, but the entire Alpine ecosystem.

title: Heist
description: Francis 'Pope' Silva is a popular, soon to be retiring casino owner and feared mafia boss. When one of his employees Luke Vaughn desperately needs cash for his daughter's much needed operation...

title: Hell's Kitchen USA
description: In this five-time Emmy-nominated reality show, celebrity chef Gordon Ramsay roasts aspiring restauranteurs as they compete for the opportunity to run one of his eateries. Contains strong language.

title: Hellboy: The Crooked Man
description: Stranded in a remote community tormented by witchcraft, Hellboy must hunt down the source of this evil - a demon known only as 'The Crooked Man'.

title: Herd
description: When a woman trying to outrun her past ends up trapped between a zombie outbreak and warring militia groups, she must fight to find her way back home.

title: Hierarchy
description: As adopted brothers prepare for the biggest and most dangerous heist of their lives, they find themselves caught in a high-stakes game of survival against a relentless foreign mafia, vengeful ties, and a determined police force.

title: High Crimes
description: A woman's life becomes embroiled in a huge military cover-up when it's revealed her husband is not who he says he is.

title: High Ground
description: Young Aboriginal man Gutjuk joins forces with bounty hunter Travis to track down Baywara, the most dangerous warrior in the Australian outback.

title: Holy Water
description: A rural Irish village will never be the same again after a group of bachelors hijack a truck full of Viagra pills as part of a get-rich-quick scheme. With special ops on their case, the boys hide the loot down the Church's Holy Well... only for it to seep out into the town's water supply.

title: Home Again
description: Reese Witherspoon stars as Alice Kinney in HOME AGAIN a modern and heartwarming romantic comedy. Recently separated from her husband (Michael Sheen, Passengers), Alice decides to start over and move back to Los Angeles with her two young daughters as she struggles to get a new career off the ground.

title: Honeytrap
description: Honeytrap is a tragic teen romance, set in South London and inspired by true events. It tells the story of fifteen year-old Layla who gets sucked into gang activity and sets up the boy who's in love with her to be killed.

title: Honour
description: An urban thriller set in London with Paddy Considine and Aiysha Hart. After a failed attempt at an honour killing at the hands of her family, Mona is forced to go on the run. The family, enlist the services of a bounty hunter to trawl through the streets of London to track her down.

title: Hope Gap
description: Annette Bening, Bill Nighy and Josh O’Connor shine in William Nicholson’s intimate portrait of a family crisis.

title: Horns
description: Ig Perrish is accused for the violent killing of his girlfriend. After a hard night of drinking, Ig awakens, hungover, to find horns growing out of his head; they have the ability to drive people to confess sins.

title: Hostile
description: Juliette, a lone survivor of an apocalyptic era, fights to survive against hunger, thirst, a broken leg and strange, disturbing creatures that only come out at nighttime.

title: Hot Ones
description: Host Sean Evans asks his celebrity guests questions while they attempt to complete rounds of chicken wings coated in spicy hot sauce.

title: Hot Pursuit
description: An uptight and by-the-book cop (Reese Witherspoon) tries to protect the sexy and outgoing widow (Sofia Vergara) of a drug boss as they race through Texas pursued by crooked cops and murderous gunmen.

title: Hot Wheels City
description: In a world of wheels, all tracks lead to Hot Wheels City! Strap in with Chase and Elliot, two brothers who spend their days racing the streets in their favorite Hot Wheels.

title: House at the End of the Street
description: Elissa and her mother move to a new town only to find that they are living next door to a house where a young girl murdered her parents.

title: House of Bodies
description: As incarcerated serial-killer Henry Lee Bishop (Peter Fonda, Easy Rider, 3:10 to Yuma, Ghost Rider) serves his sentence on Death Row, strange happenings arise in his former home.

title: House of Darkness
description: Hap (Justin Long) drives Mina (Kate Bosworth) home to her mysterious estate after a night of drinking. Hap gets more than he bargained for when unexpected occurrences offset his attempts at a romantic connection with this mysterious object of his desire.

title: House of Ho
description: This multigenerational docusoap follows the Hos, a Houston-based Vietnamese-American family whose multimillion-dollar empire epitomizes the “American Dream".

title: Hunter
description: When Rick Hunter, a renegade cop who takes justice into his own hands, partners with the stunning and rebellious Sgt. McCall, they set out to crack down on L.A.'s slimiest criminals.

title: Hyena Road
description: Three different men, three different worlds, three different wars – all stand at the crossroads of modern warfare. It's a murky world in which they must save lives - but all is not as it seems

title: I Am Wrath
description: Golden Globe winner John Travolta returns to the action genre with a hard as nails performance as a man with nothing left to lose, seeking bloody vengeance! Unemployed engineer Stanley Hill witnesses the brutal murder of his wife Vivian who was attacked by thugs in a parking garage.

title: I Can Only Imagine
description: It's the song that brings ultimate hope to so many...often in the midst of life s most challenging moments.

title: I Could Never Be Your Woman
description: An upbeat and acerbic romantic comedy featuring stellar cast: Michelle Pfeiffer, Paul Rudd, Saoirse Ronan, Jon Lovitz, Stacey Dash, Fred Willard, Sarah Alexander, Tracey Ullman, Henry Winkler.

title: I Feel Pretty
description: A woman struggling with insecurity wakes from a fall believing she is the most beautiful woman on the planet. Her new confidence empowers her to live fearlessly, but what happens when she realizes her appearance never changed?

title: I Kill Giants
description: Barbara Thorson is a teenage girl who escapes the realities of school and a troubled family life by retreating into her magical world of fighting evil giants.

title: I Picked Up A Celebrity On the Street
description: Contract worker Lee Yeon Seo daydreams about teaching her manager a lesson but accidentally acts out her vengeful fantasy on the top Hallyu star, Kang Joon Hyuk in a twist of events.

title: I Think We're Alone Now
description: Del (Peter Dinklage) is alone in the world. Literally. After the human race is wiped out, he lives in a small, empty town, methodically going from house to house, collecting batteries and other useful items, and burying the dead...

title: I Want You Back
description: Peter and Emma thought they were on the precipice of life’s biggest moments – marriage, kids, and houses in the suburbs – until their respective partners dumped them.

title: I Wrecked My House
description: You need a licence to drive a car but you don’t need a licence to own a home! I Wrecked My House is a home renovation series that features homeowners who have literally wrecked their houses and need to be rescued.

title: I've Never Wanted Anyone More
description: Charming, passionate, and totally irresponsible Werther (Douglas Booth) meets lovely Charlotte (Alison Pill) by chance, and her allure and commitment to her impressive, stable fiancé Albert (Patrick J. Adams) turns Werther’s life upside down.

title: I.T
description: A high-tech revenge thriller from the writer of 'Terminator 1 & 2'. Mike Regan (Pierce Brosnan) is a self-made man who has it all: a gorgeous wife, a beautiful teenage daughter, and a sleek, state-of-the-art smart home.

title: If I Stay
description: A chronicle of a fatal car accident involving 17-year-old musician Mia and her boyfriend.

title: Imperial Dreams
description: A 21-year-old reformed gangster's devotion to his family and his future is put to the test when he is released from prison and returns to his old stomping grounds in Watts, Los Angeles.

title: Impuratus: The Devil's Confession
description: A police detective Clayton Douglas (Tom Sizemore) is summoned to a remote hospital to witness a mysterious Civil War veteran's outrageous death-bed confession that forces him to accept the supernatural.

title: In from the Side
description: In from the Side' is the story of an adulterous affair between two members of a fictional South London gay rugby club. The film explores the multiple types of connections that can occur within a large group of gay men in a team sports environment…

title: In Hell
description: A man must survive a prison where hardened criminals battle to the death for the wardens' entertainment. Starring movie icon Jean-Claude Van Damme.

title: In the Blood
description: The death of his safe cracking grandfather has landed Johnny as the only one left alive who can open a safe for a degenerate crew of violent gangsters, but he's just a junkie with little more on his mind than getting that next fix.

title: In The Electric Mist
description: Louisiana Detective Dave Robicheaux (Tommy Lee Jones) is on the hunt for a serial killer, where he encounters Hollywood star Elrod Sykes (Peter Sarsgaard) and local crime kingpin Baby Feet Balboni (John Goodman). As Dave gets closer to the murderer, the murderer gets closer to Dave and his family.

title: In-Law Wedding Wars
description: A must-see wedding show with a fantastic twist, In-Law Wedding Wars is the all-new series where soon-to-be-weds hand over total control of their big day to one of their mothers!

title: Incendies
description: Canadian twins Jeanne and Simon, are left two envelopes in their mother's will asking them to find a brother and father they never knew they had.

title: Incoming
description: The International Space Station is now a prison - the ultimate black site. No one's getting out. And no one knows it's there. But when the imprisoned terrorists take over the Station and turn it into a missile aimed at Moscow, only a shuttle pilot and a rookie doctor can stop them.

title: IncrediTales
description: Cinderella, Snowhite, Rapunzel, Robin Hood... We all love their stories but have you ever wondered what their lives might be like behind their fairytales?

title: Infini
description: Humanity has become the victim of mass overpopulation and the line between middle class and poverty no longer exists. Whit Carmichael has accepted a high-risk security job that requires off-world travel using Slipstream.

title: Inhabitants
description: A young woman moves in with her lapsed Catholic boyfriend, only to discover that they're being haunted by the vengeful ghost of his childhood youth minister.

title: Innocence
description: Beckett (Sophie Curtis) is a beautiful young teenager that is still mourning the loss of her mother. She's moved to the Upper West Side of Manhattan with her father Miles (Linus Roache) and is set to begin school at Hamilton, an exclusive prep school.

title: Inside Man
description: Based on true events, a disgraced police detective seeking redemption by going undercover to expose a violent crime syndicate. But as he sinks deeper into the mob, the price for absolution may be higher than he can afford.

title: Instrument of War
description: Instrument Of War is an harrowing yet uplifting true story about survival against seemingly impossible odds. When U.S. B-24 bomber pilot Clair Cline is shot down and captured in northern Germany, one war ends and another begins -- to keep hope alive.

title: Interview With A Hitman
description: Trust no one. Feel nothing. Never lose - this is the mantra that has helped a ruthless Eastern European assassin rise to the pinnacle of his profession. Raised in the harsh slums of Romania, Viktor (Luke Goss) knows the value of life more than most, which makes him the perfect killer.

title: Into the Blue
description: Paul Walker and Jessica Alba heat up the screen as two divers who dream of finding hidden treasure. When they take some friends (Scott Caan, Ashley Scott) on an extreme sport adventure, the last thing they expect to see below the water is a legendary pirate ship rumored to contain millions in gold.

title: Into the Forest
description: In the not-too-distant future, two young women, Nell (Ellen Page) and Eva (Evan Rachel Wood) must struggle to survive after a mysterious continent-wide power cut.

title: Iron Chef
description: "Iron Chef" is an innovative cooking competition from Japan combining the excitement of a one-on-one sports competition with gourmet cooking.

title: Iron Fury
description: In 1944, a young lieutenant leads a courageous group of Russian soldiers in a German POW camp, plotting a daring escape from captivity in a half-dest

title: Iron Sky
description: The Nazis set up a secret base on the dark side of the moon in 1945 where they hide out and plan to return to power in 2018.

title: Iron Sky - The Coming Race
description: Twenty years after the events of 'Iron Sky', the former Nazi Moonbase has become the last refuge of mankind. Earth was devastated by a nuclear war but buried deep under the wasteland lies a power that could save the last of humanity or destroy it once and for all.

title: It Lives Inside
description: An Indian-American teen struggling with her cultural identity unwittingly releases a demonic entity that grows stronger by feeding on her loneliness.

title: Jane Got a Gun
description: JANE GOT A GUN is the story of Jane Hammond, a young mother living in a secluded ranch on the vast New Mexico prairie. When her family’s life is threatened by a conniving gang of outlaws led by the nefarious John Bishop (McGregor).

title: Jeepers Creepers
description: An uneventful road trip home turns into a journey straight from Hell for two unsuspecting college kids, Trish and Darry. A heartstopping high-speed pursuit down a deserted highway leads to a terrifying discovery: their pursuer has more in store for them than they ever imagined.

title: Jeepers Creepers: Reborn
description: The Horror Hound festival is a big deal, and now, it’s coming to Louisiana for the very first time – the excitement is immense. The geeks, freaks and die-hard horror fans are coming from far and wide to experience the fear and the fun.

title: Jenny's Wedding
description: Jenny Farrell has led an openly gay life - except with her conventional family. When she finally decides to start a family and marry the woman they thought was just her roommate, the small, safe world the Farrells inhabited changes forever.

title: JFK
description: John F. Kennedy in Dallas, Texas, in 1963. What he learns leads him to suspect that there is more to the story than the public is being told.

title: Jimmy P
description: A troubled Native American veteran forms an extraordinary friendship with his maverick French psychoanalyst as they try to find a cure to his suffering.

title: Jiu Jitsu
description: NICOLAS CAGE is back and this time he’s got a sword and an alien invasion knocking at his door!

title: Joe
description: Gary, a young lad who is subject to constant physical abuse by his alcoholic father, turns up at Joe’s workplace one day, asking for work. Joe takes him in, but it soon becomes clear that the benevolent boss has his own demons to face down...

title: Joe Somebody
description: Tim Allen is Joe, a guy whose life has been steadily changing for the worse.  When the office bully goes too far, Joe decides it's time to turn himself from a nobody into a somebody.

title: Joy Ride
description: Two brothers on a cross-Country driving trip make the mistake of playing a practical joke on a mentally deranged trucker, and pay dearly for the prank when he becomes a homicidal stalker.

title: JT LeRoy
description: Truth really is wilder than fiction in this captivating retelling of one of the literary world’s most infamous hoaxes. Laura Albert writes as her “avatar,” a disenfranchised young queer man named JT LeRoy.

title: Jumper
description: The epic adventures of a man who discovers that he possesses the exhilarating ability to instantly teleport anywhere in the world he can imagine.

title: Just for the Summer
description: Teacher Penelope Campbell loves visiting her Grandma Dot every summer – despite her constant attempts to find Penelope a man! This year, she bumps into her childhood sweetheart Jason Humphrey, who explains his grandmother is desperate to pair him off, too.

title: Just Getting Started
description: An action comedy in the vein of MIDNIGHT RUN about an ex-FBI agent (Jones) and an ex-mob lawyer in the witness protection program (Freeman) having to put aside their petty rivalry on the golf course to fend off a mob hit.

title: Just My Luck
description: Sexy Manhattanite Ashley is known as the luckiest woman around, but after a chance romantic encounter with down-and-out Jake, she realizes that she's swapped her fortune for his.

title: Justin and the Knights of Valour
description: Set in a magical world that children still dream of, JUSTIN AND THE KNIGHTS OF VALOUR is about the determination of a boy to fulfil his dream. A heart-warming story about friendship, honour and courage, filled with adventure, action and fun.

title: K-9: Legend of the Lost Gold
description: When Kassie and her friends stumble across an old, broken pocket watch they begin an unexpected journey to unlock the secret of the legendary Garrison Gold. They'll have to solve riddles and follow clues to find the lost treasure. Kassie is about to go on the adventure of a lifetime!

title: K-PAX
description: When a man arrives in New York claiming to be from the planet K-Pax, the police turn him over to a psychiatrist. His behaviour might be unusual and his claims unbelievable, but the truth may be even stranger yet...

title: Keasha's Perfect Dress
description: Keasha owns a wedding dress store. Costumers come every day and with the help of her employee Aeron she helps them to find their perfect dress

title: Khumba
description: Khumba is a fantastic family adventure with voice talent from Liam Neeson, Catharine Tate, Richard E Grant, Steve Buscemi and more.

title: Kidnap
description: One peaceful afternoon in the park spirals into a living nightmare for single mother Karla (Halle Berry) as she spots her son being dragged off by a stranger. With no time to spare waiting for the police, she jumps into her car and risks everything to chase down the kidnappers.

title: Kill Switch
description: Set in a future version of the world, the video game style plot follows an experiment for unlimited energy, harnessing parallel universes, which goes wrong. Chased by drones and soldiers, pilot and physicist Will Porter must race through an imploding world to get the Redivider box to a tower...

title: Kill The Irishman
description: Oscar®-winner Christopher Walken, Val Kilmer, and Ray Stevenson star in KILL THE IRISHMAN, the true story of a tough Irish thug working for mobsters in Cleveland during the 1970s.

title: Killers
description: Spencer Aimes is just your average, undercover, super-assassin accustomed to a life of flashy sports cars and even flashier women. But when he meets Jen Kornfeldt, a fun-loving computer tech, he finds true love… and happily trades international intrigue for domestic bliss.

title: Killing Season
description: Two veterans of the Bosnian War - one an American named Benjamin Ford , the other a former Serbian soldier, Emil Kovac  - engage in a tense, action-packed cat and mouse game, against the backdrop of America’s most forbidding and remote landscape.

title: Kim's Rude Awakenings
description: Join domestic diplomats, Kim and Mike, as they attempt to overhaul the country’s rudest and messiest families. Sticklers for order and cleanliness, these two firecrackers are determined to clean up our acts, our homes, and our heads.

title: KIN
description: KIN, a pulse-pounding crime thriller with a sci-fi twist, is the story of an unexpected hero destined for greatness. Chased by a vengeful criminal and a gang of otherworldly soldiers, a recently released ex-con and his adopted teenage brother are forced to go on the run with a weapon...

title: King of California
description: An unstable dad who after getting out of a mental institution tries to convince his daughter that there's Spanish gold buried somewhere under suburbia.

title: Knowing
description: Nicolas Cage stars in KNOWING, a gripping action-thriller of global proportions about a professor who stumbles on terrifying predictions about the future and sets out to prevent them from coming true. Rose Byrne and Lara Robinson also star in director Alex Proyas' riveting feature.

title: L.O.V.E.
description: If we were to ask people to name one thing money couldn’t buy… Some would say happiness, some would say health and some would say love. For Azra and Kerem, love was all they had. They met at the Sports Academy and never left each other.

title: Lair
description: Corey Johnson stars alongside Oded Fehr in this tense horror movie.

title: Landscape With Invisible Hand
description: In the near future, when an occupying alien species' bureaucratic rule and advanced technology leaves most of Earth impoverished and unemployed, two teenagers hatch a risky plan to ensure their families' futures.

title: Lars and the real girl
description: Extremely shy Lars strikes up an unconventional relationship with a doll he finds on the Internet. On the advice of a doctor, his family and neighbours go along with his delusion.

title: Lassie: A New Adventure
description: The most famous dog in cinema history returns in a thrilling new family adventure!

title: Last Knights
description: In an age of honour and justice by the sword, Raiden is a fallen warrior who must rise up against a corrupt and sadistic ruler to avenge Bartok, his dishonoured master.

title: Last Man Down
description: After civilization succumbs to a deadly pandemic and his wife is murdered, John Wood, a special forces soldier abandons his duty and becomes a recluse in the Nordic wilderness. Years later, a wounded woman appears on his doorstep.

title: Last Signal
description: When a meteor shower unexpectedly ravages her hometown, Lera's father finds ingenious ways to communicate with her from aboard the space station Mira.

title: Last Survivors
description: A father and son, who have been living off grid for 20 years, encounter an outsider who threatens to destroy the utopia they've built.

title: Laws of Attraction
description: High-powered divorce lawyers Audrey Woods and Daniel Rafferty have seen love go wrong in all its worst scenarios—how bad could their chances be?

title: Leaves of Grass
description: After being told his twin brother has been murdered, teacher Bill returns to his hometown, only to find his scheming brother is actually alive and well, and is actually plotting against a local crime lord - with a little help from Bill.

title: Left Behind
description: A small group of survivors are left behind after millions of people suddenly vanish and the world is plunged into chaos and destruction. Trapped at 30,000 feet, veteran airline pilot Ray Steele must fight to protect the passengers that remain on his flight...

title: Left Behind: Rise of the Antichrist
description: After millions of people vanish and the world falls into chaos, the only light is a charismatic new leader who rises to become head of the U.N. But does he bring hope for a better future? Or is it the end of the world?

title: Legend
description: In a land where beauty is preserved by the innocence of those who live there, two young people become entangled in the ongoing battle between good and evil.

title: Level Up
description: Cold and precise, Ahn Dan Te, is the no-nonsense director of Yoo Seong CRC, a company which specializes in the restructuring and resurrecting of companies on the brink of failure.

title: Life among Mountains and Rivers
description: Escape the humdrum of the city and experience the picturesque countryside for a romantic getaway.  China is home to countless beautiful villages and diverse ethnic cultures which are spread across the east, west, south, north and central regions.

title: Life of a King
description: Ex-felon, Eugene Brown, establishes a Chess Club for inner city teenagers in Washington, D.C.

title: Like Minds
description: After the shotgun death of schoolboy Nigel Colby, seventeen-year-old roommate Alex Forbes is placed in a juvenile remand centre.

title: Lingokids: Educational Songs for Kids
description: Learn English with Lingokids! These videos offer a perfect introduction to English for young learners. Children will enjoy singing along and getting to know the loveable Lingokids characters as they learn English.

title: Linoleum
description: When a satellite falls from orbit and crashes into the home of a suburban family, the father seizes the opportunity to fulfill his dream of becoming an astronaut by re-building it into his own rocket ship. Surreal events begin to unfold around him, causing him to question his own reality.

title: Lionheart
description: Jean-Claude Van Damme stars as Lyon Gaultier, a member of the French Foreign Legion who deserts his post in order to come to America and help the family of his murdered brother. Lyon takes up the sport of bare-knuckle fighting but with the Foreign Legion hot on his trail, will he ever find peace?

title: Lizzie
description: LIZZIE is a dark, psychodrama based on the infamous 1892 axe murder of the Borden family in Fall River, Massachusetts.

title: Locke
description: LOCKE is the story of one man’s life unravelling in a tension-fuelled 90-minute race against time. Ivan Locke has the perfect family, his dream job, and tomorrow should be the crowning moment of his career.

title: LoliRock
description: LoliRock follows the journey of young Iris, a spirited teenage girl with a beautiful voice and an unending desire to help others. When Iris joins the girl band LOLIROCK, her life is changed forever, as a new world of music, mystery and magical powers is revealed.

title: London Heist
description: After Jack Cregan (Craig Fairbrass - Rise of the Footsoldier) and his men rob a London money depot, their haul is stolen from them and Cregan's father is murdered. Cregan thinks he's found the killer, but the truth is never simple.

title: Lonely Hearts
description: In this thrilling crime drama, two homicide detectives track down Martha Beck and Raymond Martinez Fernandez, a murderous pair known as the "Lonely Hearts Killers." Starring Salma Hayek, John Travolta, James Gandolfini, Jared Leto and more.

title: Looking Glass
description: After the death of their daughter, grieving couple Ray and Maggie buy a motel in the middle of nowhere, hoping to start a new life.

title: Lost Solace
description: Spence Cutler never felt empathy or guilt. However, a fateful encounter with a new drug is about to give him a dose of too much reality, and he takes a mind-bending trip down the psychedelic highway of consciousness to come face to face with his own morality and his own twisted soul.

title: Louie
description: Have you ever dreamed of exploring an island or travelling to the moon? Do you yearn to race cars or talk to friendly bears? No problem! Everything is possible with Louie! With his and Yoko´s help, you´ll learn how to draw while having fun!

title: Love & Other Drugs
description: A womanizing Viagra salesman with no sense of direction or responsibility falls in love with a free-spirited woman.

title: Love is Strange
description: Ben (John Lithgow) and George (Alfred Molina) finally tie the knot after living together for 40 years. But when George is fired from his job and they're unable to pay rent, the pair are forced to temporarily live apart.

title: Love on Harbor Island
description: When Seattle interior designer Lily Summers returns to her hometown to help her Aunt Maggie run her marina-side bed and breakfast, she meets Marcus, the handsome seaplane pilot whose life’s work delivering rescue dogs helps Lily discover that home really is where the heart is.

title: Love Revolution
description: Gong Ju Young is a 17-year-old high school student who thinks he has found love at school when he falls in for Wang Ja Rim at first sight. But winning her heart won’t be easy. Persistence is the key, Gong Ju Young thinks – and, over time, Wang Ja Rim starts to open up to her classmate.

title: Love Sarah
description: Three generations of women, led by Mimi will need to overcome grief, doubts and differences to honour the memory of their beloved Sarah, while embarking on a journey to establish a new bakery in Notting Hill, a place filled with love, hope and colourful pastries from all over the world.

title: Love, Rosie
description: Rosie and Alex have been best friends since age six. As they dream of travelling the world, they decide to leave their small British town for Boston together to attend university. But fate has other plans...

title: Loving Vincent
description: Vincent Willem van Gogh is undoubtedly one of the most famous and influential figures in the history of Western art. Yet during his lifetime Vincent struggled with poverty and depression, dying at only 37 years old.

title: Made for You, with Love
description: The owner of a second hand wedding dress business breathes new life into used dresses, making dreams come true for brides unable to afford pricey gowns. But when she meets the perfect guy, she’s afraid to give her own heart a second chance at love.

title: Magazine Dreams
description: Killian Maddox is consumed by his dream of becoming a world famous bodybuilder and one day gracing the cover of fitness magazines.

title: Magic Beyond Words
description: An inspiring look at JK Rowling's rise to become one of the most influential writers-from her humble beginnings, as an imaginative young girl and awkward teenager, to the loss of her mother and the genesis of the Harry Potter phenomenon.

title: Maja Ma
description: Pallavi Patel is the quintessential, middle aged, devoted housewife who is equally famous for her dance as she is for her cooking. But what happens when a rumor about her threatens to disrupt her middle-class family’s ethos on the eve of her son Tejas’ engagement to a rich, non-resident Indian girl?

title: Make Up Stars
description: Makeup contest series presented by the dazzling Pilar Rubio. Eight contestants compete armed with gloss, shadows and blush, judged by MUA David Molina and designer and influencer Camila Redondo.

title: Making a Model with Yolanda Hadid
description: Yolanda Hadid and her trusted team of experts will put aspiring teen models and their "momagers" through an intensive eight-week training program focused on the physical, mental, and emotional wellness that it takes to build a sustainable brand.

title: Maniac
description: The terrifying story of a lone serial killer who stalks women before scalping them to add to his collection of mannequins.

title: Mapplethorpe
description: Matt Smith stars in this shocking biopic chronicling the journey of the infamous 'bad boy' photographer, Robert Mapplethorpe. Following him as an artist growing up in 1950's Queens, New York.

title: Maps to the Stars
description: Led by the child-star Benjie, we witness the convoluted world of selfish celebrities and their minions, all of whom are about to be manipulated by Agatha, Benjie’s tormented sister.

title: Marrying Millions
description: Marrying Millions follows six couples who are deeply in love and hoping to marry, but come from completely different worlds. Regular people are whisked off their feet and plunged into a high-end life of riches

title: Mary and The Witch's Flower
description: Young Mary follows a mysterious cat into the nearby forest and discovers an old broomstick and the strange Fly-by-Night flower, a rare plant that blossoms once every seven years. Together, the flower and the broomstick whisk Mary above the clouds, and far away to Endor College, a school of magic...

title: Mary Shelley
description: The tempestuous romance that inspired one of Gothic literature’s most influential works is brought to life in Mary Shelley, a luscious and moving period drama starring Elle Fanning and directed by Haifaa al-Mansour (Wadjda).

title: Masterminds
description: David Ghantt is a simple man stuck in a monotonous life. Every day he drives an armored car, transporting millions with no escape in sight. The only bit of excitement is his crush Kelly Campbell, who lures him into the scheme of a lifetime.

title: Matchday
description: Discover what happens inside the FC Barcelona dressing room, experience how the matches are lived, enjoy the victories with the team, suffer the defeats from within, share free time with the players...

title: Matter of Respect
description: After their grandfather’s death, the Kılıç family moves to Istanbul to start anew. But when Hasan’s dream jewelry store is robbed before opening, tragedy strikes and he takes his life.

title: Matthews
description: Considered by many to be one of the greatest athletes of all time, Sir Stanley Matthews’ footballing skill, sportsmanship and pioneering spirit placed him light years ahead of his time.

title: Max Winslow and the House of Secrets
description: Five teens are invited to the home of an eccentric billionaire to compete in a game to win his mansion. The night takes a dark turn when they become trapped in the house and are forced to face off against each other and an evil AI entity who controls everything in the house including their fate.

title: Maximum Security
description: Jack (Dolph Lundgren Aquaman / Creed 2) is a former CIA contractor who now oversees a team of elite thieves. One night in a small Mexican town, they flawlessly execute an intricate heist. On the way to a lucrative payout the Mexican authorities suddenly apprehend them.

title: May the Best House Win
description: As the saying goes, “home is where the heart is”, but for four house-proud strangers it’s much more than this; it’s also the chance to compete in the ultimate contest May The Best House Win.

title: Maya the Bee
description: Maya is a busy little bee, ready to leave her hive and live in the meadow, free like a bee. The world is just too big and too fascinating to remain confined to the restricted life of the hive.

title: Maya the Bee: The Golden Orb
description: When a bored Maya and Willi bust out of winter lockdown early, they are catapulted headfirst into a top secret mission! Entrusted with the care of a sacred seed, Maya and Willi team up with their old pal's Arnie and Barnie to deliver the seed to its new home atop the mysterious Bonsai Mountain.

title: McVeigh
description: A psychological thriller exploring the deadliest act of domestic terrorism in U.S. history orchestrated by army veteran Timothy McVeigh.

title: Medical Detectives
description: Forensic experts and investigators piece together clues and evidence to solve the most puzzling criminal cases in this true-crime docuseries.

title: Medici
description: In 15th-century Renaissance Florence, the visionary Medici dynasty flexes its power in politics and the arts, risking its rivals' lethal opposition. Starring Richard Madden, Dustin Hoffman and more.

title: Meet Dave
description: Seeking a way to save their doomed world, a crew of tiny, human-looking aliens arrives on Earth in the perfect disguise--a spaceship shaped like an ordinary man.

title: Mia and Me: The Hero of Centopia
description: When Mia discovers that her magical gem is part of a prophecy, she is transported through the power of an ancient book into the land of Centopia, a world of wonder now under threat from a poisonous and monstrous enemy known as Toxor.

title: Mid90s
description: Written and directed by Jonah Hill, Mid90s follows Stevie, a thirteen-year-old in 90s-era LA who spends his summer navigating between his troubled home life and a group of new friends that he meets at a Motor Avenue skate shop.

title: Mig Said
description: Mig Said is a beautiful animated collection of poetic ales about discovering the world. Asking and answering questions like “What can a white bear have in common with a black bear?” and “Do we only make friends with people similar to ourselves?”

title: Mile 22
description: In a visceral modern thriller from the director of Lone Survivor, Mark Wahlberg stars as James Silva, an operative of the CIA’s most highly-prized and least-understood unit.

title: Miliki Family
description: Baby Miliki explores the world with his adventure companion, Grandad Miliki, who adds musical fun to the most mundane situations.

title: Million Pound Movers
description: With the number of millionaire homeowners rising, the high-end removals industry in the UK is booming. Million Pound Movers goes behind closed doors to meet the wealthy clients moving priceless objects, plus the firms tasked with completing the job.

title: Mimicus
description: Han Yu Seong (Yoo Young Jae) is a talented but reserved student at Daehan Performing Arts High School, often misunderstood as aloof. When rumors spread that he's copying Ji Su Bin's (Kim Yoon Woo) style, tensions rise as both students harbor hidden secrets.

title: Mini's First Time
description: A rebellious girl hooks up with an escort agency, where her stepfather is a client.

title: Miracle That We Met
description: Song Hyeon Cheol (Kim Myung Min) is a financial industry hotshot. To outsiders, his kindly wife Seon Hye Jin (Kim Hyeon Joo) seems like the luckiest woman alive. But that sadly isn’t the case.

title: Mirrors
description: From the director of The Hills Have Eyes comes the terrifying story of troubled ex-cop who must save his family from an unspeakable evil that is using mirrors as a gateway into their home.

title: Miss Meadows
description: A story centered on a proper elementary school teacher who moonlights as a vigilante.

title: Missing Persons
description: Follows a special police department which deals with cases where people have disappeared.

title: Mississippi Grind
description: Gerry (Ben Mendelsohn) is a talented but struggling poker player, about to be swallowed up by his unshakable gambling habit, when his luck begins to change after he meets the young, charismatic Curtis (Ryan Reynolds).

title: Mob Town
description: In early 1957, Sgt. Ed Croswell (David Arquette - 'Scream'), a police officer in the small town of Apalachin, New York, had stopped Carmine Gilante (Gino Cafarelli - 'The Irishman'), an accused member of a Mafioso group led by Joe Barbara.

title: Molang
description: Molang is an affectionate, humorous look at the relationship between an eccentric, joyful, and enthusiastic rabbit, and a shy, discreet, and emotional little chick. The series explores Molang and Piu Piu’s everyday life with warmth and humor.

title: Monk Little Dog
description: Monk is a jovial little dog who obstinately tries his best but always fails! When thins aren’t working out for Monk, catastrophes follow. Things can get totally out of control real fast! Director/creator: Sungjae Kim, Natalys Raut Sieuzac, Suhoon Kim

title: Monster
description: Based on the life of Aileen Wuornos, a Daytona Beach prostitute who became a serial killer.

title: Monster High: 13 Wishes
