description: It’s a new school year at Monster High, and the little sister of Clawdeen Wolf, Howleen, is determined to be more fangtastic than ever. Her dream of popularity turns out to be easier than anyone imagined when she stumbles upon a genie named Gigi Grant who grants her not 3, but 13 wishes!

title: Monster High: Adventures of the Ghoul Squad
description: Get ready for a voltageous time! The ghouls are back like you’ve never seen them before in this action-packed adventure!

title: Monster High: Boo York, Boo York
description: It’s fright lights, big city when the Monster High™ ghouls head to Boo York! Cleo de Nile™ is invited to attend a fancy gala celebrating the return of a magical comet and, of course, she brings along her beast friends.

title: Monster High: Friday Night Frights
description: School spirit couldn't be higher as Monster High is racing toward the championship in the most ghoultastic sport ever, Skulltimate Roller Maze! But when the competing team at Granite City High start to play dirty, the Ghoulfriends have to join the team and save the day and the championship!

title: Monster High: Frights, Camera, Action!
description: When Draculaura™ is led to believe she's the rightful heir to the vampire throne, she and her best ghoulfriends are whisked away to Transylvania for a royal coronation to die for. But they soon discover the hunt for the queen is not over yet...

title: Monster High: Ghouls Rule!
description: Monster High: Ghouls Rule unearths an old conflict between "Normies" and monsters - and things are about to get scary! For years  students at Monster High were warned that Halloween was a night to stay inside and avoid conflict at all costs.

title: Monster High: Great Scarrier Reef
description: When the ghouls get pulled into the school pool, they find themselves transported to a world of coral and florals—a wild underwater wonderland! But Lagoona is not there to see the sights— she’s on mission of the heart, as she realizes she has come home!

title: Monster High: Haunted
description: Lurk what's waiting for the Monster High ghouls when they bring their killer fashion to the howlways of the spooktacular Haunted High!

title: Monster High: New Ghoul in School
description: 'New Ghoul at School'  follows newcomer Frankie Stein from her first day at the school and shows how she becomes one of the most popular ghouls around.

title: Monster High: Scaris, City of Frights
description: When Clawdeen Wolf gets the chance to apprentice for the legendary fashion designer Madame Ghostier, she and her best ghoul friends immediately pack their bags and hop on a plane to beautiful Scaris, France.

title: Monster High: The Howliday Special
description: Draculaura has a fright idea when her dad lectures her class on human holidays!

title: Monster High: Welcome to Monster High
description: MONSTERS once lived in hiding—even from each other—because they were afraid they would be in danger if humans knew they existed. But Draculaura, the daughter of Dracula, along with her best ghoulfriends, dreamt of a school where everyone was welcome and accepted for who they are.

title: Monster High: Why Do Ghouls Fall In Love
description: As the epic Sweet 1600th of Draculara™ approaches, she’s got two crush-worthy guys out to steal her heart (literally) before the big event in this freaky fabulous movie!

title: Monster High:Electrified
description: When Clawdeen dreams of opening a salon made for monsters and normies, Frankie has the perfect place – an abandoned power station outside town. But the idea sparks negative voltage when Moanica plots to ruin the whole thing, and replace the celebration with something a little more…

title: Monte Carlo
description: Grace (Selena Gomez) is an ordinary girl who becomes an accidental princess when a family summer trip to Paris turns into the fantasy of a lifetime. Living like royalty, Grace, along with her two best friends, discovers who she really is – by assuming another person’s identity.

title: Moonstruck
description: In this classic romantic comedy, a Brooklyn widow (Cher) is ready to get married again. Only this time, she plans on doing it right, even if she has to say “yes” to a man she doesn’t really love.

title: Mosley
description: To save his family, Mosley, must embark on an epic journey to find the legendary Uprights... but what he unexpectedly finds will unlock a secret revealing his true nature. With large and layered themes, Mosley tells a timeless adventurous tale of family, love and hope!

title: Mother's Day
description: There are only a few days left before the Mother’s Day, as several families have to come to terms with how they’ll be spending the big day.

title: Mouk
description: Mouk and Chavapa are two globe-trotters: they travel around the world riding their bikes! From Tokyo to New York, from Australia to Madagascar and through Greece, these two friends meet inhabitants from all over the planet…

title: Mr. Morgan's Last Love
description: From the day Pauline (Clemence Poésy) lends him a helping hand on the bus, the stubborn and weary Matthew Morgan (Sir Michael Caine) stumbles back to happiness.

title: Mutant X
description: A fugitive geneticist and four of his "creations" search for others of their kind while attempting to stay a step ahead of a morally ambiguous government agent.

title: My Awkward Sexual Adventure
description: In this laugh out loud romantic-comedy, uptight accountant Jordan Abrams proposes to his long-term girlfriend, pushing her to reveal the painful truth: he’s terrible in bed.

title: My Days of Mercy
description: A powerful and heart-wrenching tale of finding love in the least-likely of places. Academy Award nominee Elliot Page ('Inception', 'The Umbrella Academy') and Kate Mara (TV's 'House of Cards') star in the highly compelling and moving romantic drama, 'My Days of Mercy'.

title: My First Barbie: Happy DreamDay
description: Sing along with Barbie, Barbie, Teresa, and Renee in this musical adventure as they plan the biggest surprise birthday party ever for Barbie’s sister, Chelsea. “Bigger than JUST a birthday, we have to plan a DREAMDAY!”

title: My Policeman
description: A tale of forbidden romance and changing social conventions, "My Policeman" follows the relationships between three people — policeman Tom, teacher Marion and museum curator Patrick — and their emotional and complex journey that spans decades.

title: My Super Ex-Girlfriend
description: A man who dumps his long-time girlfriend discovers his ex is a superhero, and she’s out for revenge.

title: My Teenage Wedding
description: Everyone thinks they’re too young to get married, but they don’t care! Convinced that their love is the forever kind, these teens will stop at nothing to walk down the aisle.

title: Naked Fashion
description: You’ve never seen a red carpet takedown like this before! Join the opinionated and outspoken panelists of Naked Fashion as they literally strip the worst dressed celebrities of their fashion crimes…

title: Native
description: A signal from the other side of the universe is received by a hive-like society. Two scientists, Cane and Eva, are chosen to leave home and journey many light years to find and colonise the distant world that sent this transmission.

title: Naughty
description: In order to prevent the construction of a skyscraper in an urban forest, Elya, a young environmental activist, accepts a challenge from the mega wealthy developer: If after spending seven days with him, she doesn't fall for him, he'll stop the project.

title: NEDS
description: From acclaimed Director Peter Mullan comes NEDS, the story of a young man’s journey from prize winning schoolboy to knife carrying teenager.

title: Night Raiders
description: Night Raiders is a relentless and thought-provoking, dystopian thriller from executive producer Taika Waititi, which stars Alex Tarrant  and Amanda Plummer.

title: Night Train
description: In this tightly crafted action thriller, a single mother struggling to survive agrees to run black market medical supplies in her legendary pick-up truck, "Night Train", with the FBI in hot pursuit.

title: Nine Lives
description: When work-obsessed real-estate mogul, Tom Brand (Kevin Spacey) suffers a magical accident that leaves him trapped inside the body of his 11-year-old daughter’s cat, he realizes he has to put his family first if he ever hopes to regain his human form.

title: Ninja
description: American born Casey has dedicated his life to studying the ancient art of Ninjutsu in Japan. Casey’s training is put to the test when his Sensei asks him to return to New York to protect the legendary Yoroi Bitsu, an armored chest that contains the weapons of the last Koga Ninja.

title: Ninja: Shadow Of A Tear
description: Scott Adkins returns as Casey Bowman, who is now  the sensei of a successful dojo, married to the beautiful Namiko, and expecting their first baby. But when Casey returns home one day to find someone has brutally killed Namiko, bereft, Casey has only one thing left to live for... Revenge.

title: Nitram
description: Nitram lives with his mother and father in suburban Australia in the Mid 1990s. He lives a life of isolation and frustration at never being able to fit in. That is until he unexpectedly finds a close friend in a reclusive heiress, Helen.

title: Noah
description: Academy Award® winner Russell Crowe stars as Noah, a man chosen by God for a great task before an apocalyptic flood destroys the world.

title: Nocebo
description: A fashion designer (Eva Green) suffers from a mysterious illness that confounds her doctors and frustrates her husband (Mark Strong) - until help arrives in the form of a Filipino nanny (Chai Fonacier) who uses traditional folk healing to reveal a horrifying truth.

title: Nothing Like the Holidays
description: The far-flung members of the Rodriguez family converge at their parents' home to face what may be their last Christmas together in this heart-warming holiday comedy.

title: Nuts Nuts Nuts
description: Nuts is an obsessed, clumsy blue squirrel. He lives with other animals ina crazy, lively, funny and sometimes absurd world. Wherever he goes, he causes disasters...

title: Odd Thomas
description: Based on the best-selling novel by Dean Koontz, Odd Thomas is not like other 20 year old boys; he has the clairvoyant ability to see dead people!

title: Oggy and the Cockroaches
description: Oggy’s life in his pretty little house would be a dream if it weren’t for three nasty cockroaches bent on turning it into a living hell. It’s explosive and hilarious…it’s Oggy and the Cockroaches!

title: On a Wing and a Prayer
description: In this extraordinary true story of faith and survival, "On A Wing and A Prayer" follows passenger Doug White’s (Dennis Quaid) harrowing journey to safely land a plane and save his entire family from insurmountable danger after their pilot dies unexpectedly mid-flight. Heather Graham also stars.

title: On Halloween
description: A journalist goes in search of the truth after a series of brutal deaths and disappearances lead back to an urban legend about a serial killing clown that has stalked the woods of Century Park for over a hundred years.

title: Only the Brave
description: All men are created equal… then, a few become firefighters. Only the Brave, based on the true story of the Granite Mountain Hotshots, is the heroic story of one unit of local firefighters that through hope, determination, sacrifice, and the drive to protect families...

title: Open 24 Hours
description: FrightFest Presents a close quarters, suspense filled horror.

title: Open Water
description: 15 miles from land. One million square miles of ocean. No one knows they're missing. Daniel and Susan are about to embark on the dive of a lifetime - an underwater tour of the Caribbean. But when the couple surface, the dive boat is nowhere to be seen.

title: Operation Avalanche
description: 1967: the height of the Cold War. The CIA suspects there is a Russian mole inside of NASA, sabotaging the Apollo program. They send two young agents on a mission to go undercover, posing as documentary filmmakers, there to capture NASA's race to the moon.

title: Operation Blood Hunt
description: A World War II horror, which sees occult expert, Reverend Conte, lead a team of outcast soldiers to a remote South Pacific island. Tasked with investigating the disappearance of several marine corps battalions stationed there in 1944, initial intelligence points towards the Japanese Imperial Army.

title: Operation Overlord
description: A week before storming the beaches of Normandy, two US Soldiers infiltrate an abandoned complex to rescue a prisoner of war from the clutches of the Nazi regime.

title: Origin Wars
description: CONTAINS FLASHING IMAGES: Set in the future in a time of interplanetary colonisation, Sy (Kellan Lutz), a mysterious drifter, meets Kane (Daniel MacPherson), a lieutenant working for an off-world military contractor – EXOR.

title: Our Better World
description: The world faces many challenges today, ranging from pollution to overpopulation.  But as long as one keeps searching for solutions, all's not lost.

title: Out for a Kill
description: Steven Seagal ("Exit Wounds") stars as a university professor who becomes embroiled in a foiled Chinese cocaine deal. Wrongly imprisoned, he escapes to take his revenge and prove his innocence.

title: Out Of The Furnace
description: Russell and his younger brother Rodney are living in the economically-depressed Rust Belt and have always dreamed of escaping and finding better lives.

title: Outlaws
description: An impassioned group of men and women make the decision to risk it all for family, faith, and country. This film unfolds the (hidden) true story of 1920's Cristeros War - a war by the people of Mexico against the atheistic Mexican government.

title: Outpost 11
description: Outpost 11 is the story of a group of soldiers stationed on a remote Arctic outpost. One day the warning light goes off unexpectedly and their world is plunged into chaos, as they become prey to an unknown enemy.

title: Overboard
description: Unjustly fired by a spoilt and selfish yacht owner, Kate gets payback when he falls overboard and wakes up with amnesia...

title: Overdosed
description: The troubling turmoil of the deadly American opioid crisis unfolds in the small rural town of Petersburg, West Virginia, the state hardest hit by this epidemic.

title: Panama
description: An ex-marine is hired by a defense contractor to travel to Panama to complete an arms deal. In the process he becomes involved with the U.S. invasion of Panama, and learns an important lesson about the true nature of political power.

title: Panda: Call of the Wild
description: This documentary features two giant pandas as main characters. Through their challenging experiences of being released into the wild and their growth, it encapsulates the achievements of China's giant panda conservation, showcasing the country's exemplary rescue of this globally renowned species.

title: Parallel
description: A group of friends stumble upon a mirror that serves as a portal to a "multiverse", but soon discover that importing knowledge from the other side in order to better their lives brings increasingly dangerous consequences.

title: Paris Hilton's My New BFF Dubai
description: International hotel heiress, socialite, and reality TV star, PARIS HILTON, journeys to the United Arab Emirates to film the latest version of her hit show, MY BFF. Having already picked new BFF’s from the US and the UK, the celebutante is now headed to the glittering city of Dubai.

title: Pennywise: The Story of IT
description: Exploring the 1990 mini-series, based on Stephen King's iconic novel IT, this documentary tells a story heard by few and showcases a wealth of behind-the-scenes footage and photos seen by even fewer.

title: Personal Shopper
description: Written and directed by Olivier Assayas (Clouds of Sils Maria), Personal Shopper stars Kristen Stewart, Lars Eidinger and Anders Danielsen Lie. An ethereal and mysterious ghost story starring Kristen Stewart as a high-fashion personal shopper to the stars who is also a spiritual medium.

title: Phantom
description: The haunted Captain of a Soviet submarine holds the fate of the world in his hands. Forced to leave his family behind, he is charged with leading a covert mission cloaked in mystery.

title: Pig Killer
description: Inspired by the true story of serial killer Robert 'Willy' Pickton, Pig Killer follows a pig farmer who, with his giant hog Balthazar and bizarre accomplices, slaughters 49 women and terrorizes Vancouver’s dark underbelly - until his gruesome crimes are uncovered.

title: Pinocchio
description: Live-action adaptation of the beloved story of a wooden puppet named Pinocchio who magically comes to life.

title: Piper
description: Liz and her daughter Amy move to Hamelin where a dark secret in Liz's past is uncovered by the restless spirit of the Pied Piper, who seeks out those who have gotten away with a crime, and punishes them by taking away their children.

title: Planet Dune
description: A crew on a mission to rescue a marooned base on a desert planet turns deadly when the crew finds themselves hunted and attacked by the planet's apex predators: giant sand worms.

title: Playhouse
description: In a remote Scottish castle, an irreverent writer faces terrifying consequences when his daughter falls prey to an evil curse lurking within the walls.

title: Playing for Keeps
description: Playing For Keeps is a romantic comedy about a former soccer star who returns home to put his life back together. Looking for a way to rebuild his relationship with his son, he gets roped into coaching the boy’s soccer team.

title: Playing it Cool
description: A screenwriter working on a script for a romantic movie is having a hard time because he is a little jaded when it comes to love since his mother abandoned him when he was a boy.

title: Plus One
description: Longtime single friends Alice & Ben agree to be one another's plus ones as they power through an endless parade of hilarious and insufferable weddings

title: Poetry Sans Frontiers
description: "Poetry Sans Frontiers" is a cross-cultural exchange program launched by CGTN that breaks the language boundaries through the narration and poetry recitation of different countries and characters, employs poetry to tell the story of beautiful love, genuine friendship...

title: Point and Shoot
description: In 2006, Matt VanDyke, a timid 28-year-old with Obsessive Compulsive Disorder, left Baltimore. He bought a motorcycle and a video camera and began a three-year, 35,000-mile motorcycle trip through Northern Africa and the Middle East.

title: Polaroid
description: From the Producer of IT and IT: Chapter Two. High school loner Bird Fitcher has no idea what dark secrets are tied to the mysterious Polaroid vintage camera she stumbles upon, but it doesn't take long to discover that those who have their picture taken meet a tragic end.

title: Police Story: Lockdown
description: Jackie Chan stars as Wen, a cop with a history of violence, whose reunion with his daughter exposes a high-stakes hostage plot.

title: Polly Pocket
description: When 11 year-old Polly Pocket shrinks to four inches tall, she discovers a world of adventures where the smallest person can make the biggest difference!

title: Polly Pocket: Adventures in Rio
description: Polly and her friends head off to Rio de Janeiro where they find a lost cat that belongs to a Brazilian dancer and then embark on a tropical journey to reunite the cat with its owner.

title: Poltergeist
description: In this terrifying take on a classic, a suburban family tormented by inter-dimensional spirits must save their daughter from being lost to the ghosts forever!

title: Posh Pawn
description: This exclusive documentary series goes behind the scenes with the kings of high-end pawn broking with unprecedented access to industry experts and extraordinary clients.

title: Postman Pat: The Movie
description: Postman Pat, a mail carrier, lives an idyllic life in the quaint British town of Greendale. When a national talent TV show comes to town, Pat enters.  But when he comes face-to-face with the temptations of money – can he resist?

title: Pressed
description: Seeing no other option, Brian decides to go all in and invests his remaining savings into a short-term drug deal, promised to yield the funds necessary to preserve his high-flying lifestyle.

title: Primal
description: A hunter (Nicolas Cage) must fight for his life on a ship when his deadly animals—including a rare white jaguar—are set loose by a dangerous criminal out to kill everyone on board.

title: Prime
description: A career driven professional from Manhattan is wooed by a young painter, who also happens to be the son of her psychoanalyst.

title: Proximity
description: Close Encounters of the Third Kind' meets 'Independence Day'. Earth is in danger and a loner named Isaac holds the key to unravelling the mystery that will expose the truth behind alien abduction.

title: Pumpkin Reports
description: Max Green’s new brother and sister are aliens sent to Earth as the advance party for an invasion - and he’s the only one who can stop them turning humans into unwilling slave-gardeners.

title: Puppy Love
description: Despite a dreadful first date, two dog owners with opposite personalities are forced to continue seeing each other when their dogs hit it off, and puppies end up on the way. But maybe puppy love isn't all that's in the cards for this couple!

title: Push
description: Riveting Sci-Fi action-thriller Push is set in a deadly world of psychic espionage where the ability to move objects using only the mind, see the future, create new realities and kill without ever touching the victim can turn a person into a lethal weapon - or a target.

title: Pushing Tin
description: Fueled by caffeine and machismo, a rivalry ensues between Nick and Russell. The one-upmanship becomes a contest of wits and wills, where stress is the great equalizer and bravado is the lowest common denominator...

title: Queen of the Desert
description: Gertrude Bell, a daughter of wealthy British parents, has no interest in the social life of the London elite. Balls, receptions, and the British aristocracy bring her only boredom.

title: Ratchet & Clank
description: Get ready for an action adventure of GALACTIC PROPORTIONS! Ratchet is the last of his kind, a foolhardy Lombax who grew up without a family. Clank is a pint-sized robot with more brains than brawn.

title: Reasonable Doubt
description: After being involved in a fatal hit and run incident Assistant DA Mitch Brody must prosecute an innocent man. Due to some inconclusive evidence Brody manages to throw the case, however he quickly realizes the man he thought to be innocent could just be the most dangerous man he has ever met.

title: Red Corner
description: In this provocative thriller, an American (Richard Gere) on a business trip in China is framed for a brutal murder and soon finds himself at the mercy of a foreign court system he doesn't understand. Can he find the true killer before it’s too late?

title: Red Dawn
description: The citizens of Spokane, a small town in Washington state, awaken to the sight of North Korean paratroopers dropping from the sky. The U.S.A. has been invaded and their hometown is the initial target. Without warning, the town is unable to fight back and finds itself under enemy occupation.

title: Redcon-1
description: After a zombie apocalypse spreads from a London prison, the UK is brought to its knees. The spread of the virus is temporarily contained but, without a cure, it's only a matter of time before it breaks its boundaries and the biggest problem of all... any zombies with combat skills are now enhanced.

title: Redeeming Love
description: Sold into prostitution as a child, Angel knows nothing but betrayal. Can her heart ever be mended? Based upon the novel by Francine Rivers.

title: Redirected
description: Lock Stock And Two Smoking Barrels’ meets ‘The Hangover’ in the outrageous action comedy Redirected, starring Hollywood hard man Vinnie Jones. Redirected tells a story of four friends turned first-time robbers – John, Ben, Tim and Michael – who accidentally get stranded in a middle-of-nowhere...

title: Relative Strangers
description: On a mission to locate his birth parents, a tightly wound professional (Ron Livingston, "The Conjuring") is befuddled to find that his biological parents aren't exactly upper class. With Neve Campbell, Danny DeVito and Kathy Bates.

title: Renegade
description: Reno Raines, a tough, young street cop, is framed for a murder he didn't commit. Fleeing from the only system of justice he knows, Raines takes to the streets as a modern-day bounty hunter.

title: Renegade Gunfighter
description: A man trains himself to become the best shot in the West in order to get rid of a gang of killers in his home town who murdered his parents.

title: Renegades
description: When a retired Green Beret soldier is murdered by an international drug gang in London, four of his veteran SAS comrades set out to avenge him, dispensing their own brand of justice on the streets of London.

title: Resistance
description: The story of world-famous mime Marcel Marceau (Jesse Eisenberg), who worked with the French Resistance to save the lives of ten thousand orphans from the Nazis during World War II.

title: Resistance
description: 1944, when the women from a Welsh village find their husbands are missing, they must work with a German platoon to survive.

title: Resurrecting the Champ
description: Samuel L. Jackson plays a boxer who has fallen on hard times and become homeless. He crosses paths with a small-time sports journalist (Josh Harnett) who's looking for the article that will catapult him to fame: he finds his opportunity in the figure of the champion who's now living on the streets.

title: Rev
description: A young thief with a history of grand theft auto becomes an informant and helps police bring down a criminal enterprise involved in the smuggling of hundreds of exotic super cars.

title: Revenge Note
description: Ho Goo Hee (Kim Hyang Gi) is a quiet, sweet girl who is constantly bullied by the other students, partly because her name sounds like the word “fool.” Ji Hoon (Park Solomon) is a brooding, popular boy who reluctantly comes to her rescue more times than he would like.

title: Revolver
description: Conman and hotshot gambler Jake Green has spent the last seven years in prison, taking the rap for a crime he did not commit. Now he’s out and itching for revenge against crime boss and casino owner Dorothy Macha.

title: Rex
description: Rex is based on the true-life story of young Marine Corporal Megan Leavey whose unique discipline and bond with her military combat dog saved many lives during their deployment in Iraq.

title: Rich Man, Poor Woman
description: A man who can’t distinguish faces meets a woman who is unforgettable. Lee Yoo Chan (Suho) is the founder and CEO of the IT company Next In, which has become the most desirable place to work.

title: Ride On
description: Action legend Jackie Chan (Vanguard, Rush Hour, Police Story) is back in an action-packed and heart-warming tribute to the world of stunts which made him an international superstar. Luo (Chan) is a washed-up stuntman whose glory days are far behind him.

title: Righteous Kill
description: The story begins with highly decorated Detectives Turk and Rooster of the NYPD facing a retirement which neither of them are ready for.  Before they can hang up their badges, they are called to investigate the murder of a notorious pimp, who appears to have ties to a case they solved years before.

title: Riptide
description: The cases of a private investigations agency run by two Vietnam War veterans and their computer geek friend from high school, armed with toughness, their own helicopter, and the third's technical ability.

title: Rise of the Jurassic
description: A young scientist and her team arrive at a mysterious island, looking for answers as to what happened to her father who disappeared there years ago. What they find is beyond what any of them expected.

title: Risen
description: Disaster unfolds in Badger, a farming town in the state of New York when a meteor strike contaminates the air, turning it toxic. People begin to die. The entire town drop dead - plants, animals, and humans.

title: River
description: After refusing to obey a senior surgeon, John Lake, an American volunteer doctor in Laos, is instructed to take a leave of absence. To regroup, he travels to a remote island in the south of Laos.

title: Road
description: Stunning action, candid race day scenes and a gripping narrative, Road is the story of two generations of one family that have been united by tragedy.

title: Rob1n
description: When a robotics expert channels the grief of losing his 11-year-old son into building 'Robin', a series of horrific events makes it clear Robin wants his creator all to himself.

title: Robin's Wish
description: Robin's Wish is the final word in the story of what really happened to Robin Williams at the end of his life, it reveals the beauty and power behind the mind of one of the greatest entertainers of all time.

title: Rocket Jo
description: In the city of Ultrapolis, informed by his fellow pigeons, Randolf is fighting swindlers and crime. He transforms into a mysterious, comical and lovable hero named Pigeon Boy. He may be more Charlie Chaplin than Batman or Superman but he does his best to catch criminal…

title: Romance and Cigarettes
description: A down-and-dirty' musical set in the world of working-class New York, tells a story of a husband's journey into infidelity and redemption.

title: Runaway Jury
description: Set in New Orleans, this is the story of a mysterious man, Nick Easter. Nick gets himself not only on the jury of a landmark case against a gun manufacturer, but as the foreman, in an attempt to influence the other jury members to vote a certain way.

title: Runner Runner
description: Princeton grad student Richie, believing he’s been swindled, travels to Costa Rica to confront online gambling tycoon Ivan Block. Richie is seduced by Block’s promise of immense wealth, until he learns the disturbing truth about his benefactor...

title: Running with the Devil
description: When a cocaine shipment is compromised to the dismay of the Cartel's ringleader, The Boss (Barry Pepper) orders his most trusted Man (Laurence Fishburne) and another master drug trafficker, The Cook (Nicolas Cage), on a dangerous journey to audit the company's supply chain.

title: Ruth & Alex
description: When Ruth and Alex opt to put their apartment on the market over one crazy weekend, they discover that finding a new apartment is not about winding down...

title: Ruthless
description: A high school coach, whose teenage daughter was murdered, takes matters into his own hands by going after the men who kidnap his student for their human trafficking operation.

title: Sabotage
description: Sabotage, an action thriller that follows one of the best assault teams on the planet, an elite special operations team of ten DEA agents.

title: Safe
description: When ex-Government agent Luke Wright exposes the Russian mafia for rigging an illegal fight, they seek revenge on his family and threaten to kill anyone close to him.

title: Saints & Soliders 2: Airborne Creed
description: On August 15th 1944, the 517th Parachute Regimental Combat Team (PRCT) jumped over the south of France. In their effort to complete the mission and rendezvous with their unit, three isolated paratroopers come across a group of French resistants in desperate need.

title: Saints and Soldiers - Battle of the Tanks
description: Germany, May 1945, deep in the Harz Mountains a U.S. tank crew discovers a platoon of Germans preparing to ambush U.S. supply trucks. A deadly game of cat and mouse quickly unfolds as the Americans find themselves out-gunned and out-manned by three German tanks.

title: Sam & Kate
description: Starring Academy Award®-winners Dustin Hoffman and Sissy Spacek, Sam & Kate is a heartwarming, multi-generational family story bringing together four people who are given a second chance at love, and life.

title: Samaritan
description: Twenty years ago, Granite City’s hometown hero, Samaritan, was reported dead after a fiery warehouse battle with his rival, Nemesis. Most in the city believe he perished in the fire, but one young boy holds out hope that Samaritan still lives!

title: Sanctuary
description: The enigmatic Dr. Helen Magnus (AMANDA TAPPING) recruits an insightful forensic psychiatrist Will Zimmerman (ROBIN DUNNE) to join her in the quest to track, study and protect the strange, and often terrifying creatures that secretly populate our world.

title: Savage Justice
description: Newly engaged Shelby John (Jack Huston) and Ruby Red want a fresh start after their struggles with addiction, but when Shelby discovers his beloved Ruby dead on their porch, he embarks on a vengeful killing spree of the dealers who supplied her.

title: Say When
description: Megan (Keira Knightley) panics when her boyfriend proposes and hides out in the home of her new teenage friend Annika (Chloë Grace Moretz).

title: Scales: Mermaids are Real
description: Mermaids Are Real! Siren Phillips has lived her whole life thinking she's an ordinary girl, but on the eve of her twelfth birthday she learns that she is far from ordinary.

title: Scarborough
description: In a once-glamorous Scarborough hotel, away from prying eyes, two couples come to terms with the impossibility of their forbidden love.

title: Scarred City
description: In this gripping crime thriller, a young cop is placed on a special police squad that acts as a ruthless vigilante unit. Starring Stephen Baldwin ("The Usual Suspects") and Tia Carrere ("Wayne's World").

title: Scenes of a Sexual Nature
description: This British comedy stars an incredible home-grown cast including Tom Hardy, Ewan McGregor, Catherine Tate, Mark Strong, Hugh Bonneville, Andrew Lincoln and Adrian Lester. On the lush green lawns of London's Hampstead Heath, a variety of couples sort through their romantic dilemmas.

title: Scoop
description: An American journalism student in London scoops a big story, and begins an affair with an aristocrat as the incident unfurls.

title: Sea Level
description: Pup, a bamboo shark, discovers egg sacs while playing around the ocean with his friends. When he sees human poachers stealing the eggs from his reef, Pup makes it his mission to save his family.

title: Season of the Witch
description: Fourteenth century knights transport a suspected witch to a monastery, where monks deduce her powers could be the source of the Black Plague.

title: Seduced and Abandoned
description: A "meta-documentary" from James Toback and Alec Baldwin, about their attempts to raise money for another film—one with no title or script, just a star.

title: Settlers
description: Following ecological disaster, a family from Earth do what they must to survive on a desolate Mars homestead.

title: SEVE - Artist, Fighter, Legend
description: Seve Ballesteros was an artist, a golfing Picasso. He was a fighter; against back injury, rivals on the golf course, a disintegrating swing, and finally cancer.

title: Seven Cemeteries
description: A recent parolee (Danny Trejo) gets a Mexican witch to resurrect his old posse so that they can help him save a woman's ranch from a ruthless drug lord.

title: Shade
description: In the shadowy criminal underbelly of illegal gambling, top-notch con men Vernon (Stuart Townsend), Miller (Gabriel Byrne) and Tiffany (Thandiwe Newton) join forces with fellow player Jennings (Jamie Foxx) to take down some big scores.

title: Shark Lake
description: A black market animal trafficker releases one of his most treasured exotic species into serene Lake Tahoe for ‘safe-keeping’ while he serves a prison sentence. However this isn’t so safe for the locals, who begin to become part of the food chain at an unbelievable rate.

title: Sharknado
description: When a freak tornado swamps Los Angeles, thousands of man-eating sharks are sucked into the swirling vortex, terrorizing the waterlogged populace and flooding the city with shark-infested seawater.

title: Sharknado 2: The Second One
description: Fin Shepard and his ex-wife April are flying to New York City when their plane enters the most unnatural of storms and is battered by airborne sharks.

title: Sharknado 3: Oh Hell No!
description: When Fin and April head to Florida, they are quickly warned of trouble ahead as the Sunshine State is overcome with strong winds and a dangerous tumult of rain....

title: She's Funny That Way
description: Isabella, a young Hollywood starlet, recalls how the actions of charming Broadway director, Arnold, changed her life forever.

title: Short Term 12
description: Short Term 12 is told through the eyes of Grace (Brie Larson), a twenty-something supervisor at a foster-care facility for at-risk teenagers. Passionate and tough, Grace is a formidable caretaker of the kids in her charge, and in love with her long-term boyfriend, Mason (John Gallagher Jr.).

title: Shutter
description: A newly married couple discovers disturbing, ghostly images in photographs they develop after an eerie accident in which they believe they may have hit a young girl with their car.

title: Siberian Education
description: A violent crime drama starring John Malkovich and Peter Stormare. In a forgotten corner of Siberia run by a community of criminals, two boys are taught to live by a ruthless moral code.

title: Silk Stalkings
description: Best friends Rita and Chris are a pair of homicide detectives who battle crime in glitzy Palm Beach, Fla. Starring Mitzi Kapture and Rob Estes.

title: Simply Irresistible
description: Beautiful restaurant owner Amanda Shelton (Sarah Michelle Gellar) is falling head over heels for handsome, hard-driving executive Tom Bartlett (Sean Patrick Flanery). Unfortunately, Tom is too busy to recognize that he's met the girl of his dreams--until Amanda puts him under her tantalizing spell!

title: Sin City 2: A Dame to Kill For
description: In a town where justice doesn't prevail, the desperate want vengeance and ruthless murderers find themselves with vigilantes on their heels. Their paths cross in Sin City’s famous Kadie's Club Pecos.

title: Sleepless
description: When Las Vegas cop Vincent Downs (Jamie Foxx) and his partner Sean (Tip “T.I.” Harris) rob a cocaine shipment bound for a drug-dealing casino boss (Dermot Mulroney), the desperate businessman retaliates by kidnapping Vincent’s son (Octavius J. Johnson

title: Slow West
description: Michael Fassbender (Xmen: Days of Future Past, Twelve Years A Slave) stars in Slow West, the story of a 17 year old boy named Jay (Kodi Smit-mcPhee; Dawn of the Planet of the Apes) who travels from Scotland to Colorado in pursuit of the woman he loves.

title: Smart Home Nation
description: Showcasing the incredible technologies that are transforming the way we live, Smart Home Nation offers a VIP tour of the most amazing automated homes on the planet. It’s an infinitely customizable fantasy world—with great tips for making any home just a little bit smarter

title: Smother
description: After being fired from his job, an everyday guy faces pressure from his wife about having a baby, while having to deal with his suffocating mother, who has decided to move in with the couple.

title: Snitch
description: In the fast-paced action thriller SNITCH, Dwayne Johnson stars as a father whose teenage son is wrongly accused of a drug distribution crime and is looking at a mandatory minimum prison sentence of 10 years.

title: Snow White & The Red Shoes
description: A magic curse turns seven boastful princes into dwarfs until they can find a princess who would restore their appearance with a kiss. At the same time, nearby Snow White finds a pair of magic shoes that can transform her appearance at will. Based on the fairytale by the Brothers Grimm.

title: So I Married the Anti-Fan
description: Superstar celebrity Hoo Joon (Choi Tae Joon) meets his match in spunky magazine reporter Lee Geun Young (Choi Sooyoung) at the opening ceremony of a new nightclub.

title: Some Girl
description: In this riotous romantic comedy, four flighty women look for long-term relationships in 1990s Los Angeles. Starring Juliette Lewis ("August: Osage County"), Giovanni Ribisi ("Avatar") and Michael Rapaport ("Deep Blue Sea").

title: Somebody I Used To Know
description: On a trip to her hometown, workaholic Ally spends a whirlwind night with her ex-boyfriend Sean which makes her question all the past choices she's made. Ally decides she has to Sean back...which gets much more complicated when she meets his fiancé.

title: Sound of Freedom
description: In this global box office sensation, an ex-federal agent embarks on a dangerous journey to rescue a victim of child trafficking from a terrible fate.

title: Speed Kills
description: Based on the true story of one of Miami’s most notorious businessmen and gangster's, SPEED KILLS is a high-octane thriller, described as “The Wolf of Wall Street on Water.”

title: Spooks: The Greater Good
description: When charismatic terrorist Adem Qasim escapes from MI5 custody during a high profile handover, legendary operative Harry Pearce, Head of Counter-terrorism, is blamed. Disgraced and forced to resign, Harry disappears without a trace.

title: Spree
description: Meet Kurt Kunkle, a 23-year-old rideshare driver so desperate for social media attention, he'll stop at nothing to go viral. Kurt comes up with a plan to broadcast a killing spree as a shortcut to infamy.

title: Spring
description: A young man in a personal tailspin flees the US to Italy, where he sparks up a romance with a girl hiding a dark secret.

title: Sputnik
description: At the height of the Cold War, a Soviet spacecraft crash lands after a mission gone awry, leaving only one survivor. After a renowned psychologist is brought in to evaluate the cosmonaut's mental state, it becomes clear that something alien has come back to Earth with him.

title: Spy Game
description: From the Director of Top Gun and Enemy of the State comes an unbelievable action-thriller set against a world of global intrigue, starring Academy Award winners Robert Redford and Brad Pitt.

title: St. Agatha
description: St Agatha is a twisted horror thriller which pushes the boundaries of the “nunsploitation” genre from Darren Lynn Bousman, the director of SAW II, III and IV.

title: Stardog and Turbocat
description: Launched into space by his scientist owner in 1969, loyal dog Buddy crash lands in the present-day in a small town where pets are ruthlessly rounded up by animal-hating cop Peck.

title: Stay
description: A thriller about a psychologist whose suicidal client makes bizarre predictions that--to the psychologist's mounting terror-- begin to come true. The shrink must race against time to save everything he loves before it disappears.

title: Still Alice
description: Alice Howland, happily married with three grown children, is a renowned linguistics professor who starts to forget words. When she receives a devastating diagnosis, Alice and her family find their bonds tested.

title: Stir of Echoes
description: A man with the gift of prescience becomes obsessed with the ghost of a young woman who was raped, murdered and buried in his basement by two high school football jocks.

title: Stolen
description: Director Simon West and Nicolas Cage team-up for the first time since the 1997 blockbuster CON AIR for STOLEN, a unique fast paced action thriller that takes place during 10 frantic hours on Mardi Gras day in New Orleans.

title: Stone
description: Academy-Award winner Robert De Niro and Academy-Award nominee Edward Norton deliver powerful performances as a seasoned corrections official and a scheming inmate whose lives become dangerously intertwined in this thought-provoking drama.

title: Stone Creek Killer
description: A small-town police chief pursues a serial killer with help from a psychic, while fighting to prove his own innocence and facing his demons both past and present.

title: Stowaway
description: A tenacious party girl fights to survive after three thieves commandeer her luxury yacht.

title: Straight A's
description: Pressured by his deceased mother's ghost to return home to the family he abandoned, a former addict grabs a bag of pills and a sack of marijuana and hits the road to Louisiana.

title: Strange Weather
description: A poignant, lyrical drama about a mother who, in an effort to deal with the death of her son, travels the back roads of the Deep South to settle a score.

title: Street Kings
description: When evidence implicates a veteran LAPD cop in the execution of a fellow officer, he is forced to go up against the cop culture he's been a part of his entire career.

title: Submerged
description: A young woman and her friends, who've been targeted by kidnappers, must do everything they can to survive after their limo is forced off the road and plunged into a canal.

title: Suburbicon
description: Directed by George Clooney, SUBURBICON is a cold-blooded thriller set in the peaceful streets of suburbia. Here, the picket-fenced homes and manicured lawns look like the perfect place to raise a family...

title: Suburra
description: Hidden in the shadows of the Colosseum, the Suburra district was the criminal underbelly of Ancient Rome, home to the city’s darkest secrets. In modern times, crime and corruption has spread deep inside the city where everything - even the priesthood - can be bought for a price.

title: Suitable Flesh
description: After murdering her young patient, a once-esteemed psychiatrist helplessly watches her life spiral into a nightmarish maelstrom of supernatural hysteria and gruesome deaths, all linked to a seemingly unstoppable ancient curse.

title: Suite Francaise
description: France 1940. As Hitler’s armies take control of Paris and bring total occupation to France, Lucile (Michelle Williams) awaits news from her husband who is being held a prisoner of war.

title: Sunshine Cleaning
description: Once the high school cheerleading captain who dated the quarterback, Rose Lorkowski (Amy Adams) now finds herself a 30-something single mother working as a maid.

title: Super
description: Mild-mannered Frank D'Arbo decides to enter the world of crime fighting superheroes when his wife, Sarah, leaves him for local drug dealer Jacques.

title: Supercell
description: Aspiring storm-chaser William is determined to continue his father's legacy by chasing the most dangerous supercell tornado ever seen.

title: Surrounded
description: In search of a gold mine, ex-soldier Mo Washington heads west. When an ambush forces her to take an outlaw captive, a battle ensues in the harsh wilderness. Directed by Anthony Mandler, starring Letitia Wright, Jamie Bell, and Michael K. Williams.

title: Survivor
description: SURVIVOR is a gripping thriller about State Department employee Kate Abbott, newly posted in the American embassy in London. Kate is charged with stopping terrorists from getting into the U.S. which puts her directly in the line of fire.

title: Switched
description: Tired of being bullied, Cassandra Evans prays that her nemesis, Katie Sharp, the queen bee of social media, would know what it's like to walk a day in her shoes. Her prayer is answered in an unexpected way when they get "Switched."

title: Take Down
description: Take Down focuses on the wayward offspring of international billionaires, sent by their parents to a tough-love school on a remote British island. When the school is taken hostage by a group of sophisticated kidnappers, the kids take the situation into their own hands.

title: Tale of Tales
description: SIMULTANEOUS RELEASE. IN CINEMAS AND WUAKI TV! From the bitter quest of the Queen of Longtrellis, to two mysterious sisters who provoke the passion of a king, to the King of Highhills obsessed with a giant Flea, these tales are inspired by the fairytales by Giambattista Basile.

title: Team Hot Wheels: Origin of Awesome
description: Meet Gage, Wyatt, Brandon and Rhett.  Kids born to ride.  Separately, they are seriously skilled racers, but together they become TEAM HOT WHEELS!

title: Ted Bundy American Boogeyman
description: Ted Bundy stalks the highways of gritty 70s America. FBI agents lead the largest manhunt in history to apprehend America's most infamous serial killer.

title: Teen Spirit
description: From the producer and musical team that brought you award-winning sensation LA LA LAND, comes TEEN SPIRIT. Fuel-injected with chart-topping pop anthems, ELLE FANNING takes centre stage in this uplifting Cinderella story about growing up, dreaming big, and finding your voice.

title: Tell It to the Bees
description: When mill worker Lydia is abandoned by her philandering husband, she struggles to look after herself and her son Charlie. Local doctor Jean is one of the few to help and a friendship develops that blossoms into a romance that will scandalise the town.

title: Tell no one
description: After his critically-acclaimed directorial debut, Mon Idole (Whatever You Say), French actor Guillaume Canet now brings us Tell No One, based on American writer Harlan Coben's bestselling thriller.

title: Telmo and Tula, Arts & Crafts
description: In this new session of Telmo and Tula, our little friends will teach us, easily and with materials available to everyone, how to make crafts and toys in the most fun and simple way possible.

title: Telmo And Tula, Little Cooks
description: Telmo & Tula is a very fun animated series in which children learn to cook the best breakfasts, sandwiches, salads and desserts in a safe and entertaining way. Telmo and Tula will teach children how fun it is to prepare delicious meals step by step.

title: Terminus
description: Following a near-fatal accident, David Chamberlain makes an unprecedented discovery that will not only determine the fate of his family, but of mankind.

title: That Awkward Moment
description: When Mikey is dumped by his girlfriend, his best friends Jason and Daniel make a pact to remain single with him until he gets back into the whirlwind of the New York dating game.

title: The 6th Friend
description: Six college best friends throw their own private graduation party that goes terribly wrong when an uninvited guest arrives.

title: The Affair
description: Liesel Landauer and her friend Hana are linked by a lifelong relationship and an exceptional house built by the architect Von Abt for Liesel and her husband Viktor in Czechoslovakia in the early 1930s.

title: The American
description: Based on a true story, The American follows one of the select few Americans, Joy Womack (Talia Ryder), to be admitted into the prestigious, but punishing, Russian Bolshoi Ballet School, where she is tutored by the vaunted Tatiyana Volkova (Diane Kruger).

title: The Arrival
description: Radio astronomer Zane Zaminsky (Charlie Sheen) believes he's picked up a cosmic noise that signals extraterrestrial intelligence. His desperate search for answers leads him to Mexico and a mysterious power plant, where is arrested for the murder of a scientist.

title: The Art Beat
description: The series focuses on the life and work of leading contemporary Chinese artists.

title: The Assistant
description: An assistant to a powerful movie mogul grows increasingly aware of the questionable behaviour of her boss toward her female peers.

title: The Babadook
description: Six years after the violent death of her husband, Amelia (Essie Davis) is at a loss. She struggles to discipline her ‘out of control’ 6 year-old, Samuel (Noah Wiseman), a son she finds impossible to love. Samuel’s dreams are plagued by a monster he believes is coming to kill them both.

title: The Baker
description: A hitman’s new rural life is threatened when his old bosses come to town. An action-packed comedy starring Damian Lewis.

title: The Bell Witch Haunting
description: The Robertson County Sheriff's Department released found footage of what was thought at first to be a murder suicide, is now believed to be the return of a centuries old demon responsible for America's most famous paranormal event.

title: The Best Man
description: Mercenaries seize control of a remote resort hotel during a wedding and it's up to the best man, the groom and their drunken best friend to stop the terrorists and save the hostages.

title: The Big Short
description: When the banks committed the greatest fraud in US history, four outsiders risked it all to take them down. Based on the unbelievable true story and best-selling book from the author of The Blind Side and Moneyball, critics are calling The Big Short “brilliant and explosive”...

title: The Big Ugly
description: Neelyn (Vinnie Jones), the loyal enforcer for crime boss Harris (Malcolm McDowell), takes care of people that disrupt Harris’s illicit business.

title: The Big Wedding
description: With an all-star cast led by Robert DeNiro, Katherine Heigl, Diane Keaton, Amanda Seyfried with Susan Sarandon and Robin Williams, THE BIG WEDDING is an  romantic comedy about a charmingly modern family trying to survive a weekend wedding celebration that has the potential to become a family fiasco.

title: The Body
description: A crucified body dated back to the first century A.D is uncovered at an ancient cave in Jerusalem. Trouble ensues as word spreads.

title: The Bookshop
description: 1959. Florence Green (Emily Mortimer), a free-spirited widow, puts grief behind her and risks everything to open up a bookshop - the first such shop in the sleepy seaside town of Hardborough, England...

title: The Boondock Saints
description: The ultra-violent, cult-classic thriller set in the depths of Boston's criminal underworld. After inadvertently taking out a pair of Russian Mafiosi, two Irish Catholic brothers believe they have found their calling.

title: The Bridge
description: The iconic Øresund Bridge, which stands in the strait between southern Sweden and Denmark, connects the cities of Copenhagen and Malmö.

title: The Buddy Holly Story
description: Buddy Holly laid the foundations for a generation of popular music with his ground-breaking combination of country music and rhythm & blues.

title: The Burial
description: When a handshake deal goes sour, a funeral home owner enlists a charismatic attorney to help save his family business. Tempers flare and laughter ensues as the unlikely pair bond while exposing corporate corruption and racial injustice.

title: The Butterfly Effect 2
description: After his girlfriend, Julie, and two best friends are killed in a tragic auto accident, Nick struggles to cope with his loss and grief. Suffering from migraine-like seizures, Nick soon discovers that he has the power to change the past with his memories

title: The Captive
description: Eight years after the disappearance of Cassandra, some disturbing incidents seem to indicate that she's still alive. Police, parents and Cassandra herself, will try to unravel the mystery of her disappearance.

title: The Carrier
description: When a devastating infection spreads across the entire world causing chaos and collapsing civilisation as we know it, the only safe place is in the air...

title: The Case for Christ
description: An investigative journalist and self-proclaimed atheist sets out to disprove the existence of God after his wife becomes a Christian.

title: The Clovehitch Killer
description: A picture-perfect family is shattered when the work of a serial killer hits too close to home.

title: The Cold Light of Day
description: THE COLD LIGHT OF DAY is an adrenaline fuelled action thriller starring British star Henry Cavill (Superman: Man of Steel, Immortals) alongside Hollywood action legend Bruce Willis (Die Hard) and Sigourney  Weaver (Avatar).

title: The Commish
description: From parenthood to crime cases, Police Commissioner Tony Scali takes it day-to-day with humor and an unorthodox style of bending the rules. Starring Emmy-winner Michael Chiklis.

title: The Cutter
description: A determined detective (Chuck Norris) sets out to rescue an aged diamond cutter from the hands of a murderous thief in this action-packed thriller.

title: The Daltons
description: Unshackle your laughing gas, put your ball and chain away, take a prison break and get ready to escape with the Daltons!

title: The Darkest Hour
description: Five young people find themselves stranded in Moscow, fighting to survive in the wake of a devastating alien attack.

title: The Day Time Ended
description: A futuristic solar home in the far desert was supposed to be their refuge from urban crime.  To their horror, the family discovers they're caught in a mind-boggling time warp caused by mysterious aliens with a sinister secret.

title: The Deep Dark
description: Miners are forced to take a professor underground with them, to take samples for his measurements. After a landslide prevents them from going back up, they discover a crypt from another time, unknowingly waking up a bloodthirsty creature.

title: The Devil Conspiracy
description: A powerful biotech company has breakthrough technology allowing them to clone history's most influential people with just a few fragments of DNA. Behind this company is a cabal of Satanists that steals the shroud of Christ putting them in possession of Jesus' DNA.

title: The Diary of a Teenage Girl
description: A teen artist living in 1970s San Francisco enters into an affair with her mother's boyfriend...

title: The Disappearance of Eleanor Rigby
description: This beautifully honest portrait of love follows the once happily married couple Conor and Eleanor. After being torn apart by tragedy, the couple find themselves strangers longing to reclaim the passion and life they once shared.

title: The Double
description: An edge-of-your-seat espionage thriller, starring Richard Gere and Topher Grace as ex-CIA and FBI agents, trying to find the killer of a US senator, which bears the hallmark of an infamous Soviet assassin, thought to be dead.

title: The Dreamers
description: The tumultuous political landscape of Paris in 1968 is the backdrop as three young cineastes are drawn together through their passion for film.

title: The Engineer
description: Based on the true story of the manuhunt for Hamas bomb-maker Yahya Ayyash aka "The Engineer" who sent waves of suicide bombers to busy civillian areas. The story follows the Mossad and Shin Bet, led by head agent Etan and a team of special operatives who work to eliminate him.

title: The Escape Artist
description: Will is a talented junior barrister of peerless intellect and winning charm who specializes in spiriting people out of tight legal corners. But when his talents acquit a notorious prime suspect in an horrific murder trial, that brilliance comes back to bite him with unexpected and chilling results.

title: The Escort
description: Desperate for a good story, a sex-addicted journalist throws himself into the world of high-class escorts when he starts following a Stanford-educated prostitute.

title: The Escorts
description: Guy Carter is an unemployed architect struggling to make ends meet. With bills pilling up, his wife Anne finds a job posting on Craigslist for a driver and sends Guy, against his will, for the job.

title: The Exorcists
description: To save his family a father hires three expert exorcists to get rid of the demon possessing his child.

title: The Expatriate
description: When former CIA agent Ben Logan finds himself suddenly targeted for termination by the Agency, he is propelled into a frenzied, action-packed race against the clock for his life, with the only person left who wants or needs him alive: the 15 year-old daughter he barely knows.

title: The Family Man
description: Investment broker, Jack (Nicolas Cage), finds his fast-lane lifestyle turned upside down when he wakes up in an alternate suburban universe where his sports car and girlfriend have become a mini-van and wife. He soon finds himself at a crossroad between his high-power career and the woman he loves.

title: The Final Cut
description: In the future, a man with access to people's memories finds his life at risk when he discovers a dark secret.

title: The Flock
description: A hyper-vigilant employee of the department of public safety (Richard Gere) who, while training his young female replacement, has to track down a missing girl who he is convinced is connected to a paroled sex offender he is investigating.

title: The Flowers Of War
description: An American, trapped amidst the Japanese invasion of Nanking in 1937, seeks refuge in a church with a group of schoolchildren and courtesans.

title: The Fountain
description: Two immortally linked souls transcend the boundaries of time and space, one desperately searching for the answers that will save the other, and deliver the promise of eternal life.

title: The Gates
description: London, 1890s. William Colcott has been sentenced to death by Electric Chair. Upon his final hours, he curses the prison he resides in.

title: The Giants - Hawaii’s sumo legends
description: We follow the epic lives of sumo legends who made it from humble beginnings in Hawaii, to becoming the first foreigners to rise to the highest ranks in sumo.

title: The Girl Next Door
description: A young man is smitten with the beautiful girl who moves in next door, and then discovers she is an ex-porn star.

title: The Goddess of Revenge
description: Kang Hae Ra (Kim Sa Rang) has become one of the nation’s hottest influencers. But when she finds herself wrapped up in an unfounded scandal, Hae Ra wants revenge. Cha Min Joon (Yoon Hyun Min) is not a man to be trifled with.

title: The Good Lie
description: Orphaned during the Sudanese Civil War, a group of young refugees are given the opportunity to leave their camp and resettle in America.

title: The Good Neighbor
description: A pair of mischievous high school kids create the illusion of a haunting on an unsuspecting elderly neighbor while keeping his every reaction under surveillance. A series of coincidences leads to tragedy.

title: The Grand Seduction
description: Brendan Gleeson is Murray, a once proud fisherman who now, along with his former colleagues in the harbour of Tickle Head are out of work and forced to live off welfare.

title: The Grey Zone
description: Steve Buscemi ("Fargo") and Michael Stuhlbarg ("Call Me by Your Name") star in this harrowing true story of the Jewish prisoners who staged the only armed revolt at Auschwitz.

title: The Guvnors
description: A former leader of a violent gang is dragged back to his past ways by a brutal young rival.

title: The Happytime Murders
description: An innovative film that incorporates influences from multiple genres to create a hilarious hybrid of film noir, crime drama, and cop buddy picture — with a healthy dose of R-Rated profanity and humor.

title: The Heist
description: It was a stroke of genius, but now the perfect crime is turning into a perfect disaster.

title: The Hero of Colour City
description: A diverse band of crayons strive to protect not only their magical multihued homeland but the imagination of children everywhere from a terrifying monster.

title: The Hole
description: From director Joe Dante comes a family-friendly adventure that explores the fears and secrets buried in the mind of kids.

title: The House of Tomorrow
description: 16-year-old Sebastian Prendergast has spent most of his life with his Nana in their geodesic dome home tourist attraction where she raises him on the futurist teachings of her former mentor Buckminster Fuller...

title: The Human Centipede (First Sequence)
description: Two pretty American girls on a road trip across Europe end up alone in the woods at night when their car breaks down in rural Germany. As they search for help they find an isolated house. Offering to call them a taxi the houses owner Dr. Heiter, a retired surgeon, invites the girls inside...

title: The Human Centipede 2 (Full Sequence)
description: To escape his dreary existence, Martin loses himself in the fantasy world of the cult horror film The Human Centipede, fetishizing the meticulous surgical skills of the gifted Dr. Heiter, whose knowledge of the human gastrointestinal system inspires Martin to attempt the unthinkable.

title: The Human Centipede 3 (Final Sequence)
description: Re-uniting the stars of the first two films The Human Centipede 3 (Final Sequence) is the finale the worlds sickest horror franchise deserves. Nasty, revolting, and utterly deplorable.

title: The Humanity Bureau
description: In the near future, natural disasters, famine and war have ripped America apart, creating the police state of New America.

title: The Hurricane
description: From Oscar nominated director Norman Jewison (Moonstruck, In the Heat of the Night) comes a tense biographical drama based on the true story of Rubin 'Hurricane' Carter (Oscar winner Denzel Washington), a man who rose up from his troubled childhood to become a boxing champion.

title: The Hustle
description: Josephine Chesterfield (Anne Hathaway) is a glamorous, seductive Brit with a penchant for defrauding gullible wealthy men. Into her well-ordered world bursts Penny Rust (Rebel Wilson), an Aussie who is as free-form and fun-loving as Josephine is calculated and cunning.

title: The Iceman
description: The Iceman is the story of real-life mob hitman Richard "The Iceman" Kuklinski, who was reportedly responsible for over 200 murders. .

title: The Immigrant
description: Marion Cotillard, Joaquin Phoenix, and Jeremy Renner star in the story of Ewa, a recent immigrant to America who falls prey to a charming but wicked man who forces her into prostitution.

title: The Intergalactic Adventures of Max Cloud
description: When video-game enthusiast, Sarah (Isabelle Allen), is transported into her favorite game, she finds herself on an intergalactic prison, home to the most dangerous villains in the galaxy.

title: The Internship
description: Billy (Vince Vaughn) and Nick (Owen Wilson) are salesmen whose careers have been torpedoed by the digital world. Trying to prove they are not obsolete, they defy the odds by talking their way into a coveted internship at Google, along with a battalion of brilliant college students.

title: The Kindred
description: A woman suffering from amnesia pieces together the events that led to her father's suicide, only to be haunted by the ghosts of children that she begins to suspect were murdered by him.

title: The King Loves
description: Power, friendship or love? Wang Won (Im Siwan) is the Crown Prince during the Goryeo Dynasty who harbors an extreme lust for power. His childhood friend, Wang Rin (Hong Jong Hyun), is his trusted ally and bodyguard.

title: The King Of Comedy
description: A struggling comedian gambles his uncertain future on a crazy scheme to ransom his way onto television by kidnapping a popular talk show host.

title: The Krays: Gangsters Behind Bars
description: Fascinated by the Krays, Steve Wraith earns their trust through letters and visits, only to be groomed into their outside affairs. Using rare correspondence, calls, and interviews, this film reveals the terrifying power of the Krays—even behind bars.

title: The Last Days of Frankie the Fly
description: Dennis Hopper ("Easy Rider") stars as a low-level mob man who dreams of changing his life and winds up trying to help a drug-addicted porn queen become a legitimate actress. Featuring Michael Madsen, Daryl Hannah and Kiefer Sutherland.

title: The Last Full Measure
description: Thirty four years after his death, Airman William H. Pitsenbarger, Jr. Pits is awarded the nations highest military honor, for his actions on the battlefield.

title: The Last Legion
description: As the Roman empire collapses, young Romulus Augustus must leave the city and set out for a dangerous journey to Britain to locate his last legion of supporters.

title: The Last Scout
description: After the earth is destroyed by war, a scout team of astronauts searches the universe for an habitable place to save the human race.

title: The Last Witch Hunter
description: Centuries ago, the mighty warrior Kaulder (Vin Diesel) vanquished the all-powerful Witch Queen, but in the moments before his death he was cursed with immortality.

title: The Legend Of Hercules
description: In the epic origin story the legend of Hercules,  a half-god, half-man blessed with extraordinary streng. Betrayed by his stepfather, the king, and exiled and sold into slavery because of a forbidden love,  Hercules must use his formidable powers.

title: The Light Between Oceans
description: Based on the bestselling novel by M.L. Stedman and from acclaimed director Derek Cianfrance, The Light Between Oceans is a beautiful and heart-breaking reminder of the infinite power of love and the lengths that we’ll go to in order to protect it.

title: The Little Mermaid
description: In this "half-fish" out-of-water animated adventure, a mermaid princess makes a bargain with a sea witch to become human.

title: The Little Vampire
description: From the screenwriters of Chicken Run and The Addams Family, comes The Little Vampire: a fantastic adventure that you can really sink your teeth into!

title: The Lost Daughter
description: A young woman follows a mysterious melody onto a remote tidal island. When she crosses back over at the next low tide, she emerges into a world where 25 years have passed.

title: The Love Witch
description: Elaine, a beautiful young witch, is determined to find a man to love her. In her gothic Victorian apartment she makes spells and potions. She then picks up men and seduces them, but her spells work too well, leaving her with a string of hapless victims.

title: The Man in the White Van
description: A true-crime, Hitchcockian thriller set in 1970's Florida; an ominous white van stalking a young girl leads to a terrifying Halloween nightmare.

title: The Man with the Iron Heart
description: THE MAN WITH THE IRON HEART, is a story about one of the most dangerous figures in the Nazi regime, and the brave men and women of the Resistance, who sought to take him down.

title: The Man Without a Face
description: A drama film about a young boy who befriends a disfigured recluse in a small coastal town; and helps him overcome his fear of society and confront his past.

title: The Marker
description: Convicted for manslaughter, troubled young criminal Marley spends his time behind bars struggling to come to terms with the grief and guilt of his crime. Upon his release, he determines to set things rights by finding and protecting his victim’s daughter Cristina...

title: The Midnight Meat Train
description: A New York photographer hunts down a serial killer who butchers his victims on subway trains. Starring Bradley Cooper, based on Clive Barker's short story.

title: The Miseducation of Cameron Post
description: After being caught with another girl in the back seat of a car on prom night, Cameron is shipped off to a conversion therapy centre that treats teens "struggling with same-sex attraction".

title: The Missing Sister
description: When Sharon finally tracks down her missing sister Raven, she’s elated to be back together – until she begins to suspect that Raven isn’t her sister at all, but rather an opportunistic imposter.

title: The Monster Beneath Us
description: When her estranged husband James suddenly dies, Grace and their son Charlie are forced to move to his country estate, where they both struggle to adapt to a new lifestyle. At first, Grace doesn’t take much notice when Charlie mentions he has a new friend who lives in the basement.

title: The Mortal Instruments: City of Bones
description: Clary Fray thinks she is just an ordinary teenager living in Brooklyn, but everything changes one night when in a downtown club she encounters the mysterious and charismatic Jace , and witnesses a shocking murder.

title: The Mother/Daughter Experiment: Celebrity Edition
description: The Mother/Daughter Experiment: Celebrity Edition features six mother/daughter pairs who will air their dirty laundry in order to repair their broken relationships. Pairs include Kim Richards and her daughter Kimberly Jackson.

title: The Neon Demon
description: Dark horror thriller; when aspiring model Jesse (Elle Fanning) moves to Los Angeles to embark on her career, her youth and vitality are devoured by a group of beauty-obsessed women who will use any means necessary to get what she has in The Neon Demon, the new film from Nicolas Winding Refn.

title: The Next Girl
description: A young woman is abducted by a strange group of human traffickers who use drug and trauma based mind control to turn women into living dolls. Trapped in a waking nightmare she fights for a way to escape, to avoid becoming the next victim.

title: The Nightingale
description: Set in 1825. A young Irish convict woman chases a British officer through the rugged Tasmanian wilderness, bent on revenge for a terrible act of violence he committed against her family.

title: The Ninth Gate
description: Johnny Depp unlocks the gates of hell in the tense thriller directed by Roman Polanski. After a rare-book dealer (Depp) is hired to locate the last copies of a demonic manuscript, he's swept into a web of theft, murder, and terrifying satanic rituals.

title: The Nutcracker
description: Nine-year-old Mary lives in a home filled with lovely things and loneliness. Bothered by bratty brother Max and neglected by well intentioned, but distracted, parents, she yearns for companionship. On Christmas Eve, Mary's Uncle Albert arrives with the gift of a wooden nutcracker doll…

title: The Old Woman with the Knife
description: Based on the bestselling novel of the same name, this adrenaline-charged revenge thriller follows legendary female assassin Hornclaw (Lee Hye-yeong), a veteran killer with a knack for taking out society's worst.

title: The Order
description: Martial arts icon Jean-Claude Van Damme stars as a playboy criminal thrust into a dangerous world of ancient evil when he must investigate the disappearance of his archaeologist father. With Oscar winner Charlton Heston and Sofia Milos.

title: The Other
description: After years of struggling with infertility, Robin and Daniel, realize their dreams of parenthood by bringing Kathelia, a mute orphan, with a dark and mysterious past into their home.

title: The Painted
description: A suburban family’s summer plans are unexpectedly interrupted when they are called to a deceased relative's estate, where they begin to unravel the secrets that haunt the premises.

title: The Party's Just Beginning
description: A darkly humorous and moving coming of age story written, directed and starring Karen Gillan.

title: The Pig Farmer
description: When a local cop and an overzealous social-worker follow clues on missing persons cases around town, stomach-turning discoveries are unearthed on a pig farm, where the town butcher has been slaughtering more than livestock.

title: The Price We Pay
description: After a pawn shop robbery goes askew, two criminals take refuge at a remote farmhouse to try to let the heat die down, but find something much more menacing.

title: The Prince
description: Bruce Willis, John Cusack and Jason Patric face off in this action-packed thriller. A retired assassin is drawn back into the life he gave up when his daughter is kidnapped. To rescue her, he must confront his former rival.

title: The Princess
description: Princess Diana's story is told exclusively through contemporaneous archive creating a bold and immersive narrative of her life and death. It also illuminates how the public's attitude to the monarchy was, and still is.

title: The Problem With People
description: Honouring his father's last wish to reunite with the American side of his family, Irishman Ciáran (Colm Meaney) calls his cousin, Barry (Paul Reiser), out of the blue with the offer for him to visit his homeland.

title: The Promise
description: It is 1914. As the Great War looms, the mighty Ottoman Empire is crumbling. Constantinople, the once vibrant, multicultural capital on the shores of the Bosporus, is about to be consumed by chaos.

title: The Protector
description: After the kidnapping of a wealthy tycoon's daughter, maverick NYPD cops Jackie Chan and Danny Aiello are sent to find leads in Hong Kong, but they find themselves beset by the local kingpin, who will stop at nothing to protect his drug empire.

title: The Railway Man
description: Eric Lomax was one of thousands of Allied prisoners of war forced to work on the construction of the Thai/Burma railway during WW2. Years later, he met Patti and fell in love. Discovering that the young Japanese officer who haunted her husband was still alive, she faced a terrible decision.

title: The Ravine
description: When an unspeakable crime rocks a peaceful community, family and friends are left to wonder if they overlooked the murderer among them or if there might be more to the story. Inspired by true events.

title: The Re-Education of Molly Singer
description: In college, attorney Molly Singer (Britt Robertson) was the life of every party. Now, she's about to be fired because she can't leave her hard-partying ways behind.

title: The Real Charlie Chaplin
description: A look at the life and work of Charlie Chaplin in his own words featuring an in-depth interview he gave to Life magazine in 1966.

title: The Reef
description: A ferocious shark stalks a group of friends seeking safety after a shipwreck.

title: The Reef: Stalked
description: After Nic and Annie witness the horrific murder of their sister, they try to escape the trauma by traveling to a remote Pacific Island with two close friends for a kayaking adventure. But within hours of arriving, the women are attacked far from land by a great white shark.

title: The Rewrite
description: Once upon a time, screenwriter Keith Michaels was on top of the world. But now, he’s divorced, broke and hasn’t written a hit film in years. His attitude slowly begins to turn when he meets Holly, a single mum.

title: The Rider
description: After suffering a near fatal head injury, a young cowboy undertakes a search for new identity and what it means to be a man in the heartland of America.

title: The Rifleman
description: The Rifleman pays stark witness to the horrors and brutality of WWI, as seen through the eyes of an innocent 17-year-old farm-boy, turned soldier.

title: The Rise
description: Battered, bruised and under arrest, Harvey Miller sits in a police interview room facing interrogation. Denying nothing, Harvey agrees to tell his version of events in full. We take in his release from prison a month earlier and the malevolent, unjust act that put him there.

title: The Ritual
description: Father Theophilus Riesinger and Father Joseph Steiger, the former struggling with his faith and the latter dealing with his past, work together to complete a series of exorcisms on Emma Schmidt, a young woman who's allegedly experiencing demonic possession.

title: The Ritual Killer
description: A troubled detective embarks on a hunt for a serial killer who murders according to a brutal tribal ritual.

title: The sea of trees
description: Arthur Brennan treks into Aokigahara, known as The Sea of Trees, a mysterious dense forest at the base of Japan's Mount Fuji where people go to commit suicide.

title: The Secret of Sinchanee
